################################################################################
PAKET: 7zip
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/7zip/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere 7-Zip...
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "7-Zip"
Sub_PrepareSetup
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_LinkFolder
Sub_Registry

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)

Set $Arch$ = "-x64"
if GetSystemType = "x86 System"
  Set $Arch$ = ""
endif

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /passive /i "%ScriptPath%\data\7z$Version$$Arch$.msi"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\7-Zip File Manager.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif
endif

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "7-Zip File Manager"
  target: "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\7-Zip\7zFM.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "7-Zip File Manager"

[Sub_Registry]
Registry_AddFileAssociation /Sysnative
Registry_Setup /Sysnative
if RegKeyExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\{23170F69-40C1-2702-2600-000001000000}")
  Registry_Cleanup /Sysnative
endif

[Registry_AddFileAssociation]
openkey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\.7z]
set ""="7-Zip.7z"
openkey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\7-Zip.7z]
set ""="7z Archive"
openkey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\7-Zip.7z\DefaultIcon]
set ""="%ProgramFiles64Dir%\7-Zip\7z.dll,0"
openkey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\7-Zip.7z\shell\open\command]
set ""='"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\7-Zip\7zFM.exe" %1'

[Registry_Setup]
openkey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\{23170F69-40C1-2702-2601-000001000000}]
set "DisplayIcon" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\7-Zip\7zFM.exe"

[Registry_Cleanup]
deletekey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\{23170F69-40C1-2702-2600-000001000000}]

################################################################################
ENDE: 7zip/install.ins
################################################################################

[Actions]

  Sub_HandleExitCode
  Sub_LinkFolder
  Registry_Cleanup /SysNative
endif

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
"%ScriptDrive%\tools\autoit\msiRemove_withLog.exe" "7-Zip"

################################################################################
PAKET: abacom-splan-8
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/abacom-splan-8/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Abacom sPlan 8...
DefVar $AppdataPath$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Hostname$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Abacom sPlan 8"
DosInAnIcon_mkdir
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub_Setup
Sub_LinkFolder

[DosInAnIcon_mkdir]
mkdir "%CurrentProfileDir%\Documents"

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))
Set $AppdataPath$ = "\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\installer\%installingProdName%"

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[Sub_Setup]
if not(FileExists($AppdataPath$ + "\Setup_sPlan80.exe"))
  LogError "Fatal: Installer not found!"
  IsFatalError
endif

WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode

if FileExists($AppdataPath$ + "\Update_sPlan80.exe")
  WinBatch_SetupUpdate
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

[WinBatch_Setup]
"$AppdataPath$\Setup_sPlan80.exe" /silent /nocancel /norestart

[WinBatch_SetupUpdate]
"$AppdataPath$\Update_sPlan80.exe" /silent /nocancel /norestart

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Cleanup

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "False"
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_Cleanup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "sPlan 8.0"
delete_element "Deinstallation von sPlan 8.0"

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "sPlan 8.0"

ENDE: abacom-splan-8/install.ins

[WinBatch_Uninstall]

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Adobe CS5 Design Standard...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $ProductKey$

DefVar $fn$

[Aktionen]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Adobe CS5"
Sub_ValidateConfig
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_Copy
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_Serialize
LinkFolder_Cleanup
Files_Delete

[Sub_ValidateConfig]
Set $ProductKey$ = composeString(splitString(GetProductProperty("productkey", ""), "-"), "")
if ($ProductKey$ = "")
  LogError "Fatal! No product key found"
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
else
  Set $Arch$ = "x86"
endif
Set $fn$  = "%opsiTmpDir%\adobe-cs5-design-std\Build\CS5 " + $Arch$ + ".msi"

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\CS5 $Arch$\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\adobe-cs5-design-std\"
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\adobe_prtk.exe" "%opsiTmpDir%\adobe-cs5-design-std\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /quiet /i "$fn$" ALLUSERS=1 /Lime C:\msi_log.txt

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_Serialize]
DefVar $Output$
Set $Output$ = takeFirstStringContaining(GetOutStreamFromSection('DosInAnIcon_Serialize'), "Return Code")
Set $Output$ = trim(takeString(1, splitString($Output$, "=")))
comment "Return Code: " + $Output$
if not($Output$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $Output$
endif

[DosInAnIcon_Serialize]
"%opsiTmpDir%\adobe-cs5-design-std\adobe_prtk.exe" --tool=ReplaceSN --serialize=DesignSuiteStandard-CS5-Win-GM --serial=$ProductKey$

[LinkFolder_Cleanup]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Adobe Application Manager"

[Files_Delete]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\adobe-cs5-design-std\"

WinBatch_Update
Sub_HandleExitCode
DosInAnIcon_DeleteTask
Sub_LinkFolder
Registry_Setup /SysNative
Registry_FixName /SysNative
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)

if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "6.1") < "0"
  LogError "Fatal! Adobe Acrobat Reader requires Windows 7 or newer."
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\AcroPro.msi" EULA_ACCEPT=YES SUPPRESS_APP_LAUNCH=YES AgreeToLicense=Yes /passive

[WinBatch_Update]
msiexec /update "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\AcroRdrDCx64Upd_$Version$.msp" /passive /norestart

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "1641" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 1641 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_INITIATED
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[DosInAnIcon_DeleteTask]
schtasks /Delete /TN "Adobe Acrobat Update Task" /F

[Registry_DisableUpdate]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Adobe\Acrobat Reader\DC\FeatureLockDown]
Set "bUpdater" = REG_DWORD:0
Set "bUpdateToSingleApp" = REG_DWORD:0
Set "bProtectedMode" = REG_DWORD:0
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Adobe\Acrobat Reader\DC\FeatureLockDown]
Set "bUpdater" = REG_DWORD:0
Set "bUpdateToSingleApp" = REG_DWORD:0
Set "bProtectedMode" = REG_DWORD:0

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Setup

if FileExists("%CommonProgramsDir%\Adobe Acrobat.LNK")
  LinkFolder_CleanupStartmenu
endif

if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Adobe Acrobat.LNK")
  LinkFolder_CleanupDesktop
endif

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Adobe Acrobat Reader.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif
endif

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Adobe Acrobat Reader"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Adobe\Acrobat DC\Acrobat\Acrobat.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_CleanupStartmenu]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Adobe Acrobat"

[LinkFolder_CleanupDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Adobe Acrobat"

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Adobe Acrobat Reader"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Adobe\Acrobat DC\Acrobat\Acrobat.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Adobe Acrobat Reader"

[Registry_Setup]
openkey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Adobe\Acrobat Reader\DC\FeatureLockDown\cServices]
; disable "search for updates" button
set "bUpdater"=REG_DWORD:0
; For everything from now: 1 = disable
; Disables all service access except those features controlled by the other preferences.
set "bToggleAdobeDocumentServices"=REG_DWORD:1
; Disables Adobe Send for Signature (formerly EchoSign).
set "bToggleAdobeSign"=REG_DWORD:1
; Disables preferences synchronization.
set "bTogglePrefsSync"=REG_DWORD:1
; Disables 3rd party connectors.
set "bToggleWebConnectors"=REG_DWORD:1

openkey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Adobe\Acrobat Reader\DC\FeatureLockDown\cSharePoint]
; Disable SharePoint connector
set "bDisableSharePointFeatures"=REG_DWORD:1

openkey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Adobe\Acrobat Reader\DC\FeatureLockDown\cCloud]
; Toggles the Adobe Send and Track plugin for Outlook
set "bAdobeSendPluginToggle"=REG_DWORD:1

openkey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Adobe\Acrobat Reader\DC\FeatureLockDown]
; disable auto update
set "bUpdater"=REG_DWORD:0
; Disable product upsell
set "bAcroSuppressUpsell"=REG_DWORD:1
; Disable the sign out UI
set "bDisableSignOut"=REG_DWORD:1
; disable update on app open
set "bUpdateToSingleApp"=REG_DWORD:0

[Registry_FixName]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\Installer\Products\68AB67CA130133017706CB5110E47A00]
Set "ProductName" = REG_SZ:"Adobe Acrobat Reader (64-bit)"
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\{AC76BA86-1031-1033-7760-BC15014EA700}]
Set "DisplayName" = REG_SZ:"Adobe Acrobat Reader (64-bit)"

################################################################################
PAKET: airserver
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/airserver/install.ins
################################################################################

; Doku: meta/AirServer_Deployment_Guide_for_Windows.pdf
; Download: http://support.airserver.com/customer/en/portal/articles/2129752-new-is-there-a-msi-installer-of-the-latest-build-

[Initial]
Message=Installiere AirServer Universal...
DefStringList $Result$
DefStringList $Result2$
DefVar $ActiveSetupVersion$
DefVar $AirPlayValues$
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $ArchRegistry$
DefVar $Auth$
DefVar $Autostart$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $GoogleCastValues$
DefVar $MiracastValues$
DefVar $Password$
DefVar $ProductKey$
DefVar $SlowNetwork$
DefVar $SlowNetworkValue$
DefVar $Update$
DefVar $Version$
SetLogLevel=7

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "AirServer Universal"
include_insert "%ScriptDrive%\tools\scripts\report-error-init.inc.ins"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_SetAuthType
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_SlowNetwork
Sub_AirPlay
Sub_GoogleCast
Sub_Miracast
Sub_LinkFolder

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
; ----------------
; ON UPDATE CHANGE ONLY THIS LINE
; ---------------
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion",  GetProductMap)
; Filter Windows XP
if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "5.1") = "0")
  LogError "Windows XP is not supported."
  IsFatalError
endif
; Determinate the system architecture
Set $Arch$ = "x86"
if (GetSystemType = "64 Bit System")
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
  Set $ArchRegistry$ = "64"
endif
; Check if product key is set
Set $ProductKey$ = GetProductProperty("productkey", "")
if ($ProductKey$ = "")
  LogError "Fatal! No product key found!"
  IsFatalError
endif
Set $Autostart$ = GetProductProperty("autostart", "False")
Set $SlowNetwork$ = GetProductProperty("SlowNetwork", "False")

[Sub_SetAuthType]
; Set the authentication parameter
if (GetProductProperty("auth", "Frage") = "Keine")
  Set $Auth$ = "PASSWORDTYPE=NONE"
endif
if (GetProductProperty("auth", "Frage") = "Standardpasswort")
  Set $Password$ = GetProductProperty("password", "12345")
  Set $Auth$ = 'PASSWORDTYPE=PASSWORD PASSWORD="' + $Password$ + '"'
endif
if (GetProductProperty("auth", "Frage") = "Benutzerdefiniert")
  Set $Auth$ = "PASSWORDTYPE=USERCONFIGURABLE"
endif
if (GetProductProperty("auth", "Frage") = "Frage")
  Set $Auth$ = "PASSWORDTYPE=ASKME"
endif
if (GetProductProperty("auth", "Frage") = "Passcode")
  Set $Auth$ = "PASSWORDTYPE=PASSCODE"
endif

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /passive /i "%ScriptPath%\data\AirServer-$Version$-$Arch$.msi" PIDKEY=$Productkey$ CHECKFORUPDATES=FALSE ALLOWNAMING=FALSE AUTOSTART=$Autostart$ $Auth$

[Sub_CheckUpdate]
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "<", "10.0")
  Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", "Auf dem System ist keine kompatible Windows Version installiert. Erforderlich ist mindestens Windows 10 oder neuer.")
  Sub_ReportError
  LogError "Fatal: No compatible Windows version installed. Only compatible with Windows 10 or higher."
  IsFatalError
endif

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "setup"
]

[WinBatch_InstallUpdate]
wusa "%ScriptPath%\data\updates\$Update$" /quiet /norestart

[Sub_SlowNetwork]
Set $SlowNetworkValue$="0"
Set $ActiveSetupVersion$ = "1"
if $SlowNetwork$ = "True"
  Set $SlowNetworkValue$="1"
endif
if RegVarExists("HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\Airserver","Version")
  Set $ActiveSetupVersion$ = getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\Airserver","Version")
  Set $ActiveSetupVersion$ = calculate($ActiveSetupVersion$+"+1")
endif
Registry_ActiveSetup

[Registry_ActiveSetup]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\Airserver]
set "StubPath"='reg add "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\App Dynamic\Airserver$ArchRegistry$" /v SlowNetwork /d $SlowNetworkValue$ /t REG_DWORD /f'
Set "Version"="$ActiveSetupVersion$"

; -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Configuration option to activate or deactivate AirPlay, GoogleCast and Miracast.
; -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[Sub_AirPlay]
if (GetProductProperty("AirPlay", "true") = "true")
  Set $AirPlayValues$ = "1"
  Registry_AirPlay /SysNative
else
  Set $AirPlayValues$ = "0"
  Registry_AirPlay /SysNative
endif

[Registry_AirPlay]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\App Dynamic\AirServer]
Set "FeatureAirPlay" = REG_DWORD:$AirPlayValues$

[Sub_GoogleCast]
if (GetProductProperty("GoogleCast", "true") = "true")
  Set $GoogleCastValues$ = "1"
  Registry_GoogleCast /SysNative
else
  Set $GoogleCastValues$ = "0"
  Registry_GoogleCast /SysNative
endif

[Registry_GoogleCast]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\App Dynamic\AirServer]
Set "FeatureGoogleCast" = REG_DWORD:$GoogleCastValues$

[Sub_Miracast]
if (GetProductProperty("Miracast", "true") = "true")
  Set $MiracastValues$ = "1"
  Registry_Miracast /SysNative
else
  Set $MiracastValues$ = "0"
  Registry_Miracast /SysNative
endif

[Registry_Miracast]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\App Dynamic\AirServer]
Set "FeatureMiracast" = REG_DWORD:$MiracastValues$

; -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_HandleExitCodeVC]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "1638" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 1638 ERROR_PRODUCT_VERSION
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[Initial]
Message=Installiere 1 Dummy Paket...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $AddPath$
DefVar $AddPath2$
DefVar $Name$
DefVar $Name2$
DefVar $Params$
DefVar $Params2$
DefVar $InstallParamMSI$
DefVar $LogPath$
DefVar $Log$
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $act$
DefVar $pwd$
DefVar $dir$
DefVar $fn$
DefVar $fn2$
DefVar $Text$
DefVar $LinkBase$
DefVar $LinkFolder$
DefVar $LinkTo$
DefVar $LinkName$
DefVar $WinstRegKey$
DefVar $RebootFlag$
DefVar $RebootAfter$
DefVar $SingleFile$
DefVar $CopyPath$
Encoding=UTF-8

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "1 Dummy Paket"
Sub_Remove
; Setup all variables
Sub_PrepInstall
; This will copy files, if we are using the opsiTmpDir
Sub_CheckCopy
if GetProductProperty("installMethod", "Normale .exe") = "Normale .exe"
  ; Normal Setup
  Sub_Install1
else
  if GetProductProperty("installMethod", "Normale .exe") = "Normale .msi"
    ; MSI-Setup
    Sub_Install2
  else
    if GetProductProperty("installMethod", "Normale .exe") = ".msi im usercontext"
      ; MSI-Setup usercontext
      Sub_Install3
    else
      if GetProductProperty("installMethod", "Normale .exe") = "Setup 1, Reboot, Setup 2"
        ; Install 2 programms with restart after the first one
        Sub_Install4
      endif
    endif
  endif
endif
; Create/Remove a Link
Sub_Link
; This will delete all copied files and reboot if wanted
Sub_AfterInstall

[Sub_Remove]
if GetProductProperty("removeBefore", "False") = "True"
  Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
endif

[Sub_PrepInstall]
; Variable can be used for system dependent dirs or filenames
Set $Arch$ = "x86"
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
endif

; Path to \data ("%ScriptPath%\data"   or   "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%")
; If you want to copy files set $dir$ to "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%"
Set $dir$ = "%ScriptPath%\data"
if GetProductProperty("copyInstaller", "False") = "True"
  Set $dir$ = "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%"
endif

; If you are in "copymode" you can specify if to copy a single file (true) or the whole folder (false)
Set $SingleFile$ = GetProductProperty("copySingleFile", "True")

; Change this to the dir names between \data\.. and ..\installer.exe. Use a final "\"!!
; Ok: "\dir1\dir2\dir3\"   or    "\"   or   "\this\"
; NOT ok: "\this"   or   "this"   or   "this\"   or   ""   or   "\dir1\dir2"   or   "dir1\dir2"   or   "dir1\dir2\"
Set $AddPath$ = GetProductProperty("addPath", "\")
; Use this for installmethod 4
Set $AddPath2$ = GetProductProperty("addPath2", "\")

; Change this to the full installer name, like "installer.exe" or "this.is.an.installer-1.0.msi"
Set $Name$ = GetProductProperty("installerName", "")
; Use this for installmethod 4
Set $Name2$ = GetProductProperty("installerName2", "")

; Full path + installer
Set $fn$ = $dir$ + $AddPath$ + $Name$
; Used for installmethod 4
Set $fn2$ = $dir$ + $AddPath2$ + $Name2$

; Use this for all parameters, like "/S" or "/SILENT /NOCANCEL /NORESTART" or "ALLUSERS=1"
Set $Params$ = GetProductProperty("installParameter", "")
; Use this for installmethod 4
Set $Params2$ = GetProductProperty("installParameter2", "")

; Set this to "1" if you want to reboot after the setup
Set $RebootAfter$ = "0"
if GetProductProperty("rebootAfter", "False") = "True"
  Set $RebootAfter$ = "1"
endif
; Change this for different MSI installer modes (/passive, /quiet, /qn)
Set $InstallParamMSI$ = GetProductProperty("msiInstallParameter", "/passive")

; Path to the MSI Log File
Set $LogPath$ = "%opsiLogDir%\%installingProdName%_MSI.log"
Set $Log$ = "/L*V " + "$LogPath$"

[Sub_Link]
; common_startmenu, common_programs, common_startup, common_desktopdirectory
Set $LinkBase$ = GetProductProperty("linkBase", "common_programs")
; Name for the subfolder, can be empty
Set $LinkFolder$ = GetProductProperty("linkFolder", "")
; Name of the Link
Set $LinkName$ = GetProductProperty("linkName", "")
; Path to the programm
Set $LinkTo$ = GetProductProperty("linkPath", "")

if GetProductProperty("linkSetup", "nicht anlegen") = "anlegen"
  ; Create a link
  LinkFolder_Setup
else
  if GetProductProperty("linkSetup", "nicht anlegen") = "löschen"
    ; Delete a link
    LinkFolder_RemoveLink
  else
    if GetProductProperty("linkSetup", "nicht anlegen") = "Ordner löschen"
      ; Delete the whole directory
      LinkFolder_RemoveDir
    endif
  endif
endif

[Sub_PrepareReboot]
;Needs restart after patch is installed
;To check if we were before or after the reboot, this regKey is needed.
Set $WinstRegKey$ = "HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\"+"%installingProdName%"
Set $RebootFlag$ = GetRegistryStringValue32("["+$WinstRegKey$+"] "+"RebootFlag")

[Sub_Install1]
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode

[Sub_Install2]
WinBatch_SetupMSI
Sub_HandleExitCodeMSI

[Sub_Install3]
Sub_PrepareSetup3
DosInAnIcon_Userdel
DosInAnIcon_Useradd
Sub_RunSetup
DosInAnIcon_Userdel
Sub_HandleExitCode

[Sub_Install4]
Sub_PrepareReboot
; This part will be installed first
if (not($RebootFlag$ = "1"))
  WinBatch_Setup
  Sub_HandleExtiCode
  Set $RebootFlag$ = "1"
  Registry_SaveRebootFlag /32bit
  opsiservicecall_Reinstall
  Sub_ImmReboot
endif
; This will be installed after a reboot
WinBatch_Setup2
Sub_HandleExtiCode
Registry_RemoveBootFlag /32bit

[Sub_CheckCopy]
; Only copy files, if we are using the opsiTmpDir
if (strPos($fn$, "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%") > "0")
  Set $CopyPath$ = "%ScriptPath%\data" + $AddPath$ + $Name$
  if ($SingleFile$ = "false")
    DefVar $SubPath$
    Set $SubPath$ = strPart($AddPath$, "1", strLength($AddPath$))
    Set $CopyPath$ = "%ScriptPath%\data\" + strPart($SubPath$, "0", strPos($SubPath$, "\"))
  endif
  Files_Copy
endif

[Sub_AfterInstall]
; We can always delete Files, it will simply do nothing if there are no files.
Files_Cleanup
if $RebootAfter$ = "1"
  Sub_Reboot
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se $CopyPath$ "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"$fn$" $Params$

[WinBatch_Setup2]
"$fn2$" $Params2$

[WinBatch_SetupMSI]
msiexec $InstallParamMSI$ /i "$fn$" $Params$ $Log$

[Sub_PrepareSetup3]
Set $act$ = "opsiSetupAdmin"
Set $pwd$ = randomstr

[DosInAnIcon_Userdel]
net user "$act$" /delete
rmdir /s /q "%ProfileDir%\$act$"

[DosInAnIcon_Useradd]
net user "$act$" "$pwd$" /add
net localgroup Administratoren /add "$act$"

[Sub_RunSetup]
DefStringList $res$
Set $res$ = getOutStreamFromSection("ExecWith_Setup '%ScriptDrive%\tools\AutoIt3.exe'")
if count($res$) = "1"
  DefVar $e$
  Set $e$ = takeString(0, $res$)
  Comment "setup exit code: " + $e$
  if not($e$ = "0")
      if ($e$ = "1614") or ($e$ = "3010")
        ; This will cause a reboot after we finished all of the script.
        $RebootAfter$ = "1"
        ;ExitWindows /Reboot
      else
        LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $e$
        IsFatalError
      endif
  endif
else
  LogError "Fatal: Setup did not return exit code!"
  IsFatalError
endif

[ExecWith_Setup]
; http://msdn.microsoft.com/library/ee942965%28v=VS.100%29.aspx
; return exit code via stdout as winst cannot read exit codes from ExecWith
$exitcode = RunAsWait("$act$", @ComputerName, "$pwd$", 1, 'msiexec $InstallParamMSI$ /i "$fn$" $Log$')
if not @error then
  ConsoleWrite($exitcode)
endif

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder $LinkBase$
set_subfolder $LinkFolder$
set_link
  name: $LinkName$
  target: $LinkTo$
end_link

[LinkFolder_RemoveDir]
set_basefolder $LinkBase$
delete_subfolder $LinkFolder$

[LinkFolder_RemoveLink]
set_basefolder $LinkBase$
set_subfolder $LinkFolder$
delete_element $LinkName$

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_HandleExitCodeMSI]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

; Use when script should be restarted after reboot
[Sub_ImmReboot]
ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot

; Use after a finished installation
[Sub_Reboot]
ExitWindows /Reboot

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "setup"
]

[Registry_SaveRebootFlag]
openKey [$WinstRegKey$]
set "RebootFlag" = "$RebootFlag$"

[Registry_RemoveBootFlag]
deletekey [$WinstRegKey$]

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

################################################################################
PAKET: albert-dummy-angebot
DATEI: remove.inc.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/albert-dummy-angebot/remove.inc.ins
################################################################################

DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Path$
DefVar $Uninstaller$
DefVar $Parameter$
DefVar $InstallParamMSI$
DefVar $MSICode$
DefVar $SearchTerm$

Sub_PrepUninstall
if GetProductProperty("uninstallMethod", "Pfad mit .exe") = "Pfad mit .exe"
  ; Check if uninstaller exists, then remove
  Sub_Uninstall1
else
  if GetProductProperty("uninstallMethod", "Pfad mit .exe") = "MSI-Code"
    ; MSI remove with MSI-Code
    Sub_Uninstall2
  else
    if GetProductProperty("uninstallMethod", "Pfad mit .exe") = "Pfad mit .msi"
      ; MSI remove with Path
      Sub_Uninstall3
    else
      if GetProductProperty("uninstallMethod", "Pfad mit .exe") = "AutoIt MSI Suche"
        ; MSI remove with AutoIt
        Sub_Uninstall4
      else
        if GetProductProperty("uninstallMethod", "Pfad mit .exe") = "Einfach Ordner löschen"
          ; Just remove the files
          Sub_Uninstall5
        endif
      endif
    endif
  endif
endif

[Sub_PrepUninstall]
; Path, has to end with "\"
Set $Path$ = GetProductProperty("uninstallPath", "")
; Uninstaller, like "unins000.exe"
Set $Uninstaller$ = GetProductProperty("uninstallName", "unins000.exe")
; Parameter, like "/SILENT"
Set $Parameter$ = GetProductProperty("uninstallParameter", "/SILENT")
; Change this for different MSI uninstaller modes (/passive, /quiet, /qn)
Set $InstallParamMSI$ = GetProductProperty("uninstallMSIParameter", "/passive")
; The MSI-Code
Set $MSICode$ = GetProductProperty("msiCode", "")
; Search term for the AutoIt-MSI uninstaller
Set $SearchTerm$ = GetProductProperty("msiSearch", "")

[Sub_Uninstall1]

Set $RebootFlag$ = ""
if RegKeyExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%")
  Set $RebootFlag$ = getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%", "RebootFlag")
endif

if not($RebootFlag$ = "1")
  if FileExists("%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Allplan\Allplan 2026\Prg\Allplan_2026.exe")
    WinBatch_Uninstall /WaitForProcessEnding "Allplan_2026_0_3_Installer.exe"
    Sub_HandleExitCode
    Sub_LinkFolder
    Set $RebootFlag$ = "1"
    Registry_SaveRebootFlag /SysNative
    opsiservicecall_Uninstall
    ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot
  endif
else
  Registry_RemoveBootFlag /SysNative
  Files_Cleanup
endif

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
"%CommonAppdataDir%\Package Cache\{8af5732d-adba-4dd4-ae2b-ba6c32b76478}\Allplan_2026_0_3_Installer.exe" /uninstall /quiet

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Allplan 2026.LNK")
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Allplan 2026"

[Registry_SaveRebootFlag]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]
Set "RebootFlag" = REG_SZ:"$RebootFlag$"

[Registry_RemoveBootFlag]
DeleteKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]

[opsiservicecall_Uninstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "uninstall"
]

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%CommonAppdataDir%\Nemetschek\Allplan\2026\"
delete -sf "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Allplan\Allplan 2026\"

if not(GetProductProperty("custommsi", "") = "")
    set $CustomMSI$ = GetProductProperty("custommsi","")
    set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))
    Files_CopyCustom
    WinBatch_SetupCustom

    WinBatch_Setup
    Sub_HandleExitCode
    if not($Licence$ = "")
      WinBatch_SetupPro
    endif

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
    "Hostname"
]

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code

comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
    ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[PatchTextFile_DisableUpdate]
GoToBottom
setValueByKey "ad.security.update_type" "1"

[DosInAnIcon_Firewall]
netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name="AnyDesk"
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="AnyDesk" profile=private enable=yes protocol=any dir=in action=allow program="%ProgramFiles32Dir%\AnyDeskMSI\AnyDeskMSI.exe"
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="AnyDesk" profile=domain enable=yes protocol=any dir=in action=allow program="%ProgramFiles32Dir%\AnyDeskMSI\AnyDeskMSI.exe"

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "False"
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]

delete_element "AnyDesk MSI"

DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/autodesk-autocad/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Autodesk AutoCAD...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $File$
DefVar $Version$
DefVar $Path$
DefVar $Hostname$
encoding=utf8

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Autodesk AutoCAD"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub_Setup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))
Set $Version$ = GetProductProperty("version", "")
if $Version$ = ""
  LogError "Fatal: No version configured. Please selecet the version you want to install."
endif
Set $Arch$ = "x86"
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
endif

Set $Path$ = "%installingProdName%\" + $Version$ + "\" + $Arch$ + "\"

if not(FileExists("\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\installer\" + $Path$ + "\Img\Setup.exe"))
  LogError "Fatal: Installer not found! Please check the folder structure!"
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_Setup]
if not(FileExists("%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Img\Setup.exe"))
  Files_Copy
  LogError $Version$
  LogError $Arch$
  Set $File$ = "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Img\Autodesk AutoCAD " + $Version$ + " " + $Arch$ + ".ini"
  ExecWith_PatchIniFile "%ScriptDrive%\tools\AutoIt3.exe" winst /letThemGo
  Set $File$ = "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Img\Img" + $Arch$ + ".ini"
  ExecWith_PatchIniFileImg "%ScriptDrive%\tools\AutoIt3.exe" winst /letThemGo
  opsiservicecall_Reinstall
  ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot
else
  WinBatch_Setup
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  ExecWith_Install "%ScriptDrive%\tools\AutoIt3.exe" winst /letThemGo
  Sub_Update
  Files_Cleanup
  LinkFolder_Cleanup
endif

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "setup"
]

[ExecWith_PatchIniFileImg]
IniWrite("$File$", "SETUP", "ADMIN_IMAGE_LOCATION", "")

[ExecWith_PatchIniFile]
IniWrite("$File$", "SETUP", "ADMIN_IMAGE_LOCATION", "")
IniWrite("$File$", "SETUP", "NETWORK_LOG_PATH", "H:\Autodesk\Autodesk AutoCAD $Version$ $Arch$\Log\")

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "\\$Hostname$\appdata\installer\$Path$\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Img\Setup.exe" /W /q /I Img\Autodesk AutoCAD $Version$ $Arch$.ini /language de-de

[Sub_Update]
if FileExists("%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Img\Updates\")
  WinBatch_Update
  Sub_HandleExitCodeUpdate
  ExecWith_Install "%ScriptDrive%\tools\AutoIt3.exe" winst /letThemGo
endif

[WinBatch_Update]
"%ScriptPath%\AutodeskUpdates.exe" "%installingProdName%" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Img\Updates\"

[ExecWith_Install]
If WinExists("", "1024 x 768") Then
  ControlClick("", "1024 x 768", "[CLASS:Button; INSTANCE:1]")
EndIf

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "1641" or $ExitCode$ = "1642" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 1641 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_INITIATED
  ; 1642 ERROR_PATCH_TARGET_NOT_FOUND
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_HandleExitCodeUpdate]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "-8")
  ;  0 = Success
  ; -1 = Some error, see log file "C:\opsi.org\log\AutodeskUpdates-%installingProdName%.log"
  ; -2 = No CmdLine parameter
  ; -4 = Error creating the log file
  ; -8 = Installation was most likely successful, but there was an error with at least one update.
  ;      This could also mean that a newer version was already installed.
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[LinkFolder_Cleanup]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Autodesk Desktop-App"
delete_element "Autodesk AutoCAD $Version$"
delete_element "Autodesk ReCap"
delete_element "Autodesk ReCap Photo"
delete_element "DWG TrueView $Version$ - English"

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

; SILENT UNINSTALL:
; Source: https://silentinstallhq.com/autodesk-autocad-2023-silent-install-how-to-guide/
; ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Uninstalling AutoCAD 2023 can be a bit of a challenge for several reasons, including killing processes, stopping services and deleting folder directories. I highly recommend you run the commands in the order listed below:
;
; 1. Autodesk Material Library 2023 Silent Uninstall
[WinBatch_Uninstall_ADML2023SU]
MsiExec.exe /x {8E133591-B0FD-4DB0-B60E-FB593CAF72B0} /qn

; 4. Autodesk Save to Web and Mobile Silent Uninstall
[WinBatch_Uninstall_ADSTWAMSU]

; 5. Autodesk AutoCAD 2023 Silent Uninstall
[WinBatch_Uninstall_ADAC2023SU]

; 6. AutoCAD Open in Desktop Silent Uninstall
[WinBatch_Uninstall_ACOIDSU]

; 7. Autodesk AutoCAD Performance Feedback Tool 1.3.12 Silent Uninstall
[WinBatch_Uninstall_ADACPFTSU]

; 8. Autodesk App Manager Silent Uninstall

copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

if FileExists("%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Autodesk\webdeploy\production\6a0c9611291d45bb9226980209917c3d\FusionLauncher.exe")
  WinBatch_SetupUpdate
  Sub_HandleExitCode
else
  WinBatch_Setup
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Fusion Admin Install.exe" --quiet

[WinBatch_SetupUpdate]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Fusion Admin Install.exe" --process update --quiet

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
   if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Autodesk Fusion.LNK")
     LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
   endif
endif

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Autodesk Fusion"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Autodesk\webdeploy\production\6a0c9611291d45bb9226980209917c3d\FusionLauncher.exe"
  icon_file: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Autodesk\webdeploy\production\6a0c9611291d45bb9226980209917c3d\Fusion360.ico"
  end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]

set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Autodesk Fusion"

[Registry_Setup]
openkey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\AutodeskFusion360]
set "DisplayIcon" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Autodesk\webdeploy\production\6a0c9611291d45bb9226980209917c3d\Fusion360.ico"
set "DisplayName" = REG_SZ:"Autodesk Fusion 360"
set "DisplayVersion" = REG_SZ:"$Version$"
set "InstallLocation" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Autodesk\webdeploy\production\6a0c9611291d45bb9226980209917c3d\FusionLauncher.exe"
set "Publisher" = REG_SZ:"Autodesk"
set "UninstallString" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Autodesk\webdeploy\production\6a0c9611291d45bb9226980209917c3d\FusionLauncher.exe"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

  LogError "Fatal: setup requires at least 50GB free disk space!"
  IsFatalError
endif

Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))

Set $RebootFlag$ = ""
if RegKeyExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%")
  Set $RebootFlag$ = getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%", "RebootFlag")
endif

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[Sub_Setup]
if not($RebootFlag$ = "1")
  Files_Copy
  WinBatch_Setup
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  Set $RebootFlag$ = "1"
  Registry_SaveRebootFlag /SysNative
  opsiservicecall_Reinstall
  ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot
endif

Sub_Database
Sub_CopyExtras
Sub_LinkFolder
Registry_RemoveBootFlag /SysNative
Files_Cleanup

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\setup.exe" -q

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Registry_SaveRebootFlag]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]
Set "RebootFlag" = REG_SZ:"$RebootFlag$"

[Registry_RemoveBootFlag]
DeleteKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "setup"
]

[Sub_Database]
if GetProductProperty("database", "False") = "True"
  DosInAnIcon_CreateDatabase
endif

sqllocaldb create SteelConnections2026

[Sub_CopyExtras]
if GetProductProperty("template", "False") = "True"
  Files_CopyTemplates
endif

if GetProductProperty("project", "False") = "True"
  Files_CopyProjects
endif

[Files_CopyTemplates]
copy -s "\\$Hostname$\appdata\%installingProdName%\*.rte" "%CommonAppdataDir%\Autodesk\RVT 2026\Templates\"

[Files_CopyProjects]
copy -s "\\$Hostname$\appdata\%installingProdName%\*.rvt" "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Autodesk\Revit 2026\Projects\"

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Revit 2026.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif
endif

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]

set_subfolder ""

  name: "Revit 2026"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Autodesk\Revit 2026\Revit.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Revit 2026"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Avira AntiVir Pro...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $LicPath$
DefVar $Hostname$

[Aktionen]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Avira AntiVir Pro"
Sub_CheckLicense
WinBatch_InstallVC
Sub_HandleExitCode
Files_Copy
Patches_SetupInf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\setup.inf"
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Files_Delete
; reboot Windows to make sure the Avira Guard is running
ExitWindows /Reboot

[Sub_CheckLicense]
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))
if FileExists("\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\licenses\avira-antivir-pro\hbedv.key")
  Set $LicPath$ = "\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\licenses\avira-antivir-pro"
else
  if FileExists("%ScriptPath%\hbedv.key")
    Set $LicPath$ = "%ScriptPath%"
  else
    LogError "Fatal: license file hbedv.key not found!"
    IsFatalError
  endif
endif

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[WinBatch_InstallVC]
; dependency for Avira; without it, it will show several error messages at each
; login
"%ScriptPath%\data\vcredist_x86.exe" /q

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"
copy "$LicPath$\hbedv.key" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"
copy "%ScriptPath%\setup.inf" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Patches_SetupInf]
Set [DATA] KeyFile=%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\hbedv.key

[WinBatch_Setup]
; Known Issues:
; 1) It won't reliably run from the share. Running from the share only works
;    when nobody is logged in; if someone is logged in, it will die with
;    exit code 28.
; 2) It can't read the INF file from the share - supplying
;    "%ScriptPath%\setup.inf" will cause it to die with exit code 15.
; 3) If it is already installed, it requires the following additional
;    settings in the INF file:
;    - Upgrade (undocumented)
;    - CopyConfig (undocumented)
;    - SetupMode
;    If it doesn't find these, it will die with exit code 15.
; 4) Every user (regardless of privileges) can enable, disable and configure
;    Avira; this includes the ability to set a password which will even lock
;    out administrators. Yes, this program is _that bad_ designed.
;    As Avira features no command-line interface to set the password,
;    administrators need to set a password manually to prevent this.
;
;    We've figured out that the password (e.g. "test") is stored as an MD5 hash
;    in C:\ProgramData\Avira\AntiVir Desktop\CONFIG\avwin.ini:
;
;      [COMMON]
;      Password=C8059E2EC7419F590E79D7F1B774BFE6
;      PrefixDiff=
;      SecurityExtension=0x00258870
;
;   "Password" is a hash of the UTF-16 encoded password, without newline:
;     iserv ~ # echo -en "t\0e\0s\0t\0" | md5sum
;     c8059e2ec7419f590e79d7f1b774bfe6  -
;
;   But Avira seems to keep avwin.ini locked all the time, so we can't modify
;   this file.
;
; INF documentation:
; http://www.avira.com/documents/products/pdf/en/man_avira_antivir_professional_en.pdf
;
; known/suspected exit codes:
; 15: INF file invalid
; 28: License file invalid
;
; An installation logfile is written to C:\Windows\Temp\AVSETUP* .
;
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\presetup.exe" /inf="%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\setup.inf"

[Files_Delete]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

set_subfolder "AVM"
delete_element "FRITZ!Box Fernzugang"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\AVM"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[Initial]
Message=Installiere MySQL-Connector 5.1.9...

DefVar $SSLKey$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "MySQL-Connector 5.1.9"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_CopySSL
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Registry_SetDBConfig

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Database$ = GetProductProperty("Database", "")
Set $DBPassword$ = GetConfidentialProductProperty("DBPassword", "")
Set $DBPort$ = GetProductProperty("DBPort", "")
Set $DBServer$ = GetProductProperty("DBServer", "")
Set $DBUser$ = GetProductProperty("DBUser", "")
Set $Description$ = GetProductProperty("Description", "")
Set $DSN$ = GetProductProperty("DSN", "")
Set $SSLCert$ = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Untis\Cert\UntisNDS-d$DBUser$.crt"
Set $SSLKey$ = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Untis\Cert\UntisNDS-d$DBUser$.key"
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[Files_CopySSL]
copy -se "\\$Hostname$\appdata\licenses\%installingProdName%\UntisNDS-d$DBUser$.crt" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Untis\Cert"
copy -se "\\$Hostname$\appdata\licenses\%installingProdName%\UntisNDS-d$DBUser$.key" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Untis\Cert"

[WinBatch_Setup]

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
    ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Registry_SetDBConfig]
openkey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\ODBC\ODBC.INI\ODBC Data Sources]
set "$DSN$" = REG_SZ:"MySQL ODBC 5.1 Driver"
openkey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\ODBC\ODBC.INI\$DSN$]
set "DATABASE" = REG_SZ:"d$Database$"
set "DESCRIPTION" = REG_SZ:"$Description$"
set "Driver" = REG_SZ:"C:\Program Files (x86)\MySQL\Connector ODBC 5.1\myodbc5.dll"
set "PWD" = REG_SZ:"$DBPassword$"
set "PORT" = REG_SZ:"$DBPort$"
set "SERVER" = REG_SZ:"$DBServer$"
set "SSLCert" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Untis\Cert\UntisNDS-d$DBUser$.crt"
set "SSLKey" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Untis\Cert\UntisNDS-d$DBUser$.key"
set "UID" = REG_SZ:"d$DBUser$"

Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\BFE Oldenburg"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

ENDE: bfe-oldenburg-eib-knx-installationsbus/remove.ins

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Bitdefender Endpoint Security...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $KeyFile$
DefVar $Hostname$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Bitdefender Endpoint Security"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub_CheckLicense
Sub_CheckInstaller
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Files_Copy
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
LinkFolder_Setup
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))
Set $KeyFile$ = "\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\licenses\%installingProdName%\installer.xml"

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[Sub_CheckInstaller]
if not(FileExists("\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\installer\%installingProdName%\installer.exe"))
  LogError "Fatal: Installer not found! Please check the folder structure!"
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_CheckLicense]
if not(FileExists($KeyFile$))
  LogError "Fatal! $KeyFile$ not found."
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "\\$Hostname$\appdata\installer\%installingProdName%\*"  "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"
copy $KeyFile$  "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\installer.exe" /silent

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Bitdefender Endpoint Security Tools"
delete_element "Reparieren oder Deinstallieren"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

    DosinAnIcon_Uninstall
    Sub_HandleExitCode
    ExitWindows /Reboot
endif

for /f %%i in (' dir /b "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Bitdefender\EndpointSetupInformation"') DO "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Bitdefender\EndpointSetupInformation\%%i\installer.exe" /remove /silent /ranByUninstallTool

[Sub_HandleExitCode]

  Registry_CreateServer2 /sysnative
else
  Registry_CreateServer1 /sysnative
endif

comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
    ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Cleanup]

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
If GetSystemType = "x86 System"
  LogError "Setup is only for 64 Bit systems!"
  IsFatalError
endif
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)

[Files_Copy]
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]

; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010" or $ExitCode$ = "1605")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  ; 1605 ERROR_UNKNOWN_PRODUCT
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Registry_Setup]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Blender]
Set "DisplayName" = REG_SZ:"Blender"
Set "DisplayVersion" = REG_SZ:"$Version$"
Set "DisplayIcon" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Blender Foundation\Blender\blender.exe"
Set "Publisher" = REG_SZ:"Blender Foundation"
Set "UninstallString" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Blender Foundation\Blender\blender.exe"

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Setup

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Blender.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif
endif

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Blender"
set_link
  name: "Blender"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Blender Foundation\Blender\blender.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Blender"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Blender Foundation\Blender\blender.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Blender"

[Files_Cleanup]

  WinBatch_Uninstall
  Sub_HandleExitCode

  Registry_Set_Reboot

  Sub_Reboot
endif

[Registry_Set_Reboot]

set "RebootFlag" = "1"

[Registry_Unset_Reboot]
openKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst]
set "RebootFlag" = "0"

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "uninstall"
]

[Sub_Reboot]
ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
"%ScriptDrive%\tools\AutoIt3.exe" "%ScriptPath%\remove.au3" "%ScriptPath%\data\Setup.exe"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError

  Sub_VDD

while ProcessExists($pid)
  ControlClick("Error", "", "OK")
  Sleep(200)
wend

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\NetworkConnectionSetup1003.exe" /SILENT /NOCANCEL /NORESTART $Tasks$

"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\VDD_setup_v2003.exe" /SILENT /NOCANCEL /NORESTART $Tasks$

; Only needed on Windows 8 and newer.

  WinBatch_SetupVDD
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

; check return code

    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere Certiport Console 8...
DefVar $ExitCode$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Certiport Conso"
Sub_Uninstall
ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"

[Sub_Uninstall]
if FileExists("%SystemDrive%\Certiport\Console\Uninstall.exe")
    WinBatch_Uninstall
    Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
"%SystemDrive%\Certiport\Console\Uninstall.exe" /S

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Certiport"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

PAKET: classicshell
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/classicshell/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Open Shell...
DefVar $AddLocal$
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $ErrorMessage$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $incReportError$
DefVar $InstallClassicExplorer$
DefVar $InstallClassicIE$
DefVar $InstallStartmenu$
DefVar $MenuDesign$
DefVar $MSVersion$
DefVar $ShutDownButtonFunction$
DefVar $ShutDownButtonMenue$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Open Shell"
include_insert "%ScriptDrive%\tools\scripts\report-error-init.inc.ins"
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_PrepareSetup
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_Options
Sub_Reboot
Registry_DisableUpdates /SysNative

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Arch$ = "64"
if (GetSystemType = "x86 System")
  Set $Arch$ = "32"
endif
Set $MSVersion$ = GetMsVersionInfo

if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "<", "6.1"))
  LogError "Fatal: This program is not compatible with Windows XP."
  IsFatalError
endif

Set $InstallStartmenu$ = GetProductProperty("install-startmenu", "true")
Set $InstallClassicIE$ = GetProductProperty("install-classicie", "false")
Set $InstallClassicExplorer$ = GetProductProperty("install-classicexplorer", "false")
Set $MenuDesign$ = GetProductProperty("menu-style", "Win7")
Set $ShutDownButtonMenue$ = GetProductProperty("shutdown-button", "Herunterfahren")

if ($InstallStartmenu$ = "false" and $InstalLClassicIE$ = "false" and $InstallClassicExplorer$ = "false")
 Set $ErrorMessage$ = "Es wurden keine Optionen zur Installation definiert."
 Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $ErrorMessage$)
  Sub_ReportError
 LogError "Fatal: No components to install selected."
  IsFatalError
endif

if ($InstallStartmenu$ = "true")
  Set $AddLocal$ = "ADDLOCAL=StartMenu"
    if (not ($MenuDesign$ = "Nutzer entscheiden selbst"))
      Registry_Register /SysNative
    else
      Registry_UnRegister /SysNative
    endif
else
  Registry_UnRegister /SysNative
endif

if ($InstallClassicIE$ = "true")
  if not($AddLocal$ = "")
    Set $AddLocal$ = $AddLocal$ + ",ClassicIE"
  else
    Set $AddLocal$ = "ADDLOCAL=ClassicIE"
  endif
endif

if ($InstallClassicExplorer$ = "true")
  if not($AddLocal$ = "")
    Set $AddLocal$ = $AddLocal$ + ",ClassicExplorer"
  else
    Set $AddLocal$ = "ADDLOCAL=ClassicExplorer"
  endif
endif

[Registry_Register]
openkey [HKLM\Software\OpenShell\StartMenu]
set "MenuStyle" = "$MenuDesign$"

[Registry_UnRegister]
openkey [HKLM\Software\OpenShell\StartMenu]
DeleteVar "MenuStyle"

[Files_CopyMenuSettings]
copy "%ScriptPath%\Menu Settings.xml" "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\Open-Shell\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /passive /i "%ScriptPath%\data\OpenShellSetup$Arch$_4_4_196.msi" $AddLocal$

[Sub_Options]
;Sets the Function of the ShutdownButton
if ($ShutDownButtonMenue$ = "Herunterfahren")
  Set $ShutDownButtonFunction$ = "CommandShutdown"
endif
if ($ShutDownButtonMenue$ = "Abmelden")
  Set $ShutDownButtonFunction$ = "CommandLogOff"
endif
if ($ShutDownButtonMenue$ = "Neustart")
  Set $ShutDownButtonFunction$ = "CommandRestart"
endif
if ($ShutDownButtonMenue$ = "Energie sparen")
  Set $ShutDownButtonFunction$ = "CommandSleep"
endif
if ($ShutDownButtonMenue$ = "Ruhezustand")
  Set $ShutDownButtonFunction$ = "CommandHibernate"
endif
if ($ShutDownButtonMenue$ = "Sperren")
  Set $ShutDownButtonFunction$ = "CommandLock"
endif
if ($ShutDownButtonMenue$ = "Benutzer wechseln")
  Set $ShutDownButtonFunction$ = "CommandSwitch"
endif
if ($ShutDownButtonMenue$ = "Herunterfahren Dialog")
  Set $ShutDownButtonFunction$ = "CommandShutdownBox"
endif
if ($ShutDownButtonMenue$ = "Energie sparen")
  Set $ShutDownButtonFunction$ = "CommandSleep"
endif
;RegKey sets the desired Options
Registry_ShutDownButton /SysNative

[Registry_ShutdownButton]
OpenKey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\OpenShell\StartMenu]
set "ShutdownCommand" = REG_SZ:"$ShutDownButtonFunction$"

[Registry_DisableUpdates]
openkey [HKLM\Software\OpenShell\OpenShell]
set "Update"=REG_DWORD:0

[Sub_Reboot]
ExitWindows /Reboot

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$

if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  if not($ErrorMessage$ = "")
    Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $ErrorMessage$)
    Sub_ReportError
  endif
  LogError "Fatal: command returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

################################################################################

PAKET: codemeter-runtime
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/codemeter-runtime/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere CodeMeter Runtime...
DefStringList $ServerList$
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $Count$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Hostname$
DefVar $ServerIP$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "CodeMeter Runtime"
Sub_PrepareSetup
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_KillTask
Sub_SetupServers
Sub_LinkFolder
Files_CleanupAutostart

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))

Set $Arch$ = "32"
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "64"
endif

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%ScriptPath%\data\CodeMeterRuntime$Arch$.exe" /ComponentArgs "*":"/qb!" 

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_KillTask]
SetLogLevel=4
DosInAnIcon_KillCMCC
SetLogLevel=7

[DosInAnIcon_KillCMCC]
taskkill /f /im "CodemeterCC.exe"

[Sub_SetupServers]
Sub_RemoveServers
Sub_AddServers

[Sub_RemoveServers]
if RegKeyExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\WIBU-SYSTEMS\CodeMeter\Server\CurrentVersion\ServerSearchList")
  Registry_DeleteServers /SysNative
endif

[Sub_AddServers]
Set $Count$ = "1"
if GetProductProperty("automatic", "True") = "True"
  Set $Count$ = "2"
  Registry_AddAutomatic /SysNative
endif

if FileExists("\\"+$Hostname$+"\appdata\%installingProdName%\servers.txt")
  Set $ServerList$ = loadTextFile("\\"+$Hostname$+"\appdata\%installingProdName%\servers.txt")
else
  if not(GetProductProperty("servers", "") = "")
    Set $ServerList$ = splitString(GetProductProperty("servers", ""), "|")
  endif
endif

if not(count($ServerList$) = "0")
  for $Address$ in $ServerList$ do Sub_AddServer
endif

[Sub_AddServer]
Set $ServerIP$ = '$Address$'
Registry_AddServer /SysNative
Set $Count$ = calculate($Count$+"+1")

[Registry_AddAutomatic]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\WIBU-SYSTEMS\CodeMeter\Server\CurrentVersion\ServerSearchList\Server1]
Set "Address" = REG_SZ:"255.255.255.255"

[Registry_AddServer]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\WIBU-SYSTEMS\CodeMeter\Server\CurrentVersion\ServerSearchList\Server$Count$]
Set "Address" = REG_SZ:"$ServerIP$"

[Registry_DeleteServers]
DeleteKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\WIBU-SYSTEMS\CodeMeter\Server\CurrentVersion\ServerSearchList]

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Setup

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\CodeMeter Control Center.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif
endif

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "CodeMeter"
set_link
  name: "CodeMeter Control Center"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CodeMeter\Runtime\bin\CodeMeterCC.exe"
  parameters: "-m"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CodeMeter\Runtime\bin\"
end_link

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "CodeMeter Control Center"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CodeMeter\Runtime\bin\CodeMeterCC.exe"
  parameters: "-m"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CodeMeter\Runtime\bin\"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "CodeMeter Control Center"

[Files_CleanupAutostart]
delete -sf "%CommonStartupDir%\CodeMeter Control Center.lnk"

[Initial]
Message=Installiere CorelDRAW Graphics Suite 12...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $ProductKey$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "CorelDRAW Graphics Suite 12"
Files_Copy
Sub_PrepareSetup
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Registry_Setup /SysNative
Sub_LinkFolder
Files_Cleanup

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $ProductKey$ = GetProductProperty("productkey", "")
if $ProductKey$ = ""
  LogError "Fatal: Serialnumber not found!"
  IsFatalError
endif

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /passive /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\CorelDRAW Graphics Suite 12.msi" /norestart DELANG=1 SERIALNUMBER=$ProductKey$ ALLUSERS=1 ADDLOCAL=ALL

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Registry_Setup]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Corel\CorelDRAW\12.0]
Set "ShowEULA"  = REG_DWORD:0

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Cleanup

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\CorelDRAW Graphics Suite 12.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif
endif

[LinkFolder_Cleanup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "CorelDRAW Graphics Suite 12"
delete_element "Corel Update"

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "CorelDRAW Graphics Suite 12"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Corel\Corel Graphics 12\Programs\CorelDRW.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Corel\Corel Graphics 12\Programs\"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "CorelDRAW Graphics Suite 12"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Cornelsen"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Cornelsen"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

delete_element "Schüler D6"
delete_element "Schüler P6"

[Sub_RemoveEmptyFolder]
Set $Path$ = "\Cornelsen\English G 21 Unterrichtssoftware"
ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"
Set $Path$ = "\Cornelsen"
ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475

Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "$Path$"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

  LogError "Fatal: No license key set."
  IsFatalError

  LogError "Fatal: No tag set."
  IsFatalError

    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError

PAKET: cto-warenwirtschaft-25
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/cto-warenwirtschaft-25/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere CTO Warenwirtschaft...
Encoding=UTF-8
DefVar $CustomerID$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Name$
DefVar $Serialnumber$
DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "CTO Warenwirtschaft"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_Copy
Sub_HandleExitCode
PatchTextFile_License "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CTO\Warenwirtschaft\lizenz.ini"
Registry_Setup /SysNative
Sub_LinkFolder

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)

Set $CustomerID$ = GetProductProperty("customerid", "")
Set $Name$ = GetProductProperty("name", "")
SetLogLevel=4
Set $Serialnumber$ = GetProductProperty("serialnumber", "")
SetConfidential $Serialnumber$
SetLogLevel=7

if $CustomerID$ = "" AND $Name$ = "" AND $Serialnumber$ = ""
  if GetProductProperty("testversion", "Business") = "Business"
    Set $Name$ = "Prüfversion1"
  else
    Set $Name$ = "Prüfversion2"
  endif
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CTO\Warenwirtschaft\"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[PatchTextFile_License]
GoToTop
AddLine '[Lizenz]'
AddLine "Kundennummer=$CustomerID$"
AddLine "Kundenname=$Name$"
AddLine "Seriennummer=$Serialnumber$"

[Registry_Setup]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\CTO Warenwirtschaft]
Set "DisplayName" = REG_SZ:"CTO Warenwirtschaft"
Set "DisplayVersion" = REG_SZ:"$Version$"
Set "DisplayIcon" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CTO\Warenwirtschaft\warenwirtschaft.exe"
Set "Publisher" = REG_SZ:"CTO Software GmbH"
Set "UninstallString" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CTO\Warenwirtschaft\unins000.exe"

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Setup

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

if GetProductProperty("desktop_gross", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktopGross
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktopGross
endif

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "CTO Software"
set_link
  name: "CTO Warenwirtschaft"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CTO\Warenwirtschaft\warenwirtschaft.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CTO\Warenwirtschaft\"
end_link
set_link
  name: "CTO Warenwirtschaft (große Masken)"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CTO\Warenwirtschaft\warenwirtschaft_gross.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CTO\Warenwirtschaft\"
end_link

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "CTO Warenwirtschaft"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CTO\Warenwirtschaft\warenwirtschaft.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CTO\Warenwirtschaft\"
end_link

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktopGross]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "CTO Warenwirtschaft (große Masken)"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CTO\Warenwirtschaft\warenwirtschaft_gross.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\CTO\Warenwirtschaft\"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "CTO Warenwirtschaft"

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktopGross]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "CTO Warenwirtschaft (große Masken)"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

  isFatalError
endif

netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="IServ Ultimaker Cura" protocol=TCP dir=in localip=any remoteip=any action=allow profile=domain program="%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Ultimaker Cura\UltiMaker-Cura.exe"

  IsFatalError
endif

LinkFolder_Cleanup

  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Ultimaker Cura.LNK")
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
 endif
endif

  name: "Ultimaker Cura"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Ultimaker Cura\UltiMaker-Cura.exe"

  name: "Ultimaker Cura"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Ultimaker Cura\UltiMaker-Cura.exe"
end_link

  IsFatalError

  LogError "Fatal: found different version, uninstall it first before installing this package!"

[WinBatch_SetupDEU]

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

  WinBatch_Uninstall
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

; Wise Installer
"%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Diesterweg\Camden Market 2\UNWISE.EXE" /S "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Diesterweg\Camden Market 2\INSTALL.LOG"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "1605" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
    ; 1605 ERROR_UNKNOWN_PRODUCT
    ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[LinkFolder_Delete]
set_basefolder common_programs
delete_subfolder "Diesterweg/Camden Market 2"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Diesterweg"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyDiesterwegFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Diesterweg"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Diesterweg\Camden Market 2\"

PAKET: diesterweg-camden-town-3-2012-whiteboard

PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/diesterweg-camden-town-3-2012-whiteboard/remove.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere Diesterweg Camden Town 3 (2012) - Interaktive Whiteboard-Software...

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Camden Town 3"
Files_Remove
LinkFolder_Uninstall
ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"
Sub_CleanupProgramFiles

[Sub_CleanupProgramFiles]
if (GetSystemType = "64 Bit System")
  ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramsFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"
else
  ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramsFolder32 "cscript" "//E:VBS"
endif

[Files_Remove]
delete -sfc "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Diesterweg\Camden Town 3 - 2012 - Interaktive Whiteboard-Software\"

[LinkFolder_Uninstall]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder ""
delete_subfolder "Diesterweg\Camden Town 3 Whiteboard"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Diesterweg"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramsFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("ProgramFilesX86") & "\Diesterweg"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramsFolder32]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("ProgramFiles") & "\Diesterweg"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))
Set $License$ = GetProductProperty("productkey", "")
if ($License$ = "")
  LogError "Fatal! Product key not found!"
  IsFatalError
else
  Set $License$ = $License$ + "01"
endif
if GetProductProperty("tool", "False") = "True"
   LinkFolder_Tool
endif

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[LinkFolder_Tool]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Diesterweg/Flex und Flo 1 Mathe"
set_link
   name: "Flex und Flo 1 Mathe - Lehrertool"
   target: "\\$Hostname$\appdata\diesterweg-flex-flo-1\prog\WIN\tool.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Diesterweg/Flex und Flo 1 Mathe"
set_link
  name: "Flex und Flo 1 Mathe"
  target: "\\$Hostname$\appdata\diesterweg-flex-flo-1\prog\WIN\FLEXM1.exe"
end_link

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Setup
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "True") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Flex und Flo 1 Mathe"
  target: "\\$Hostname$\appdata\diesterweg-flex-flo-1\prog\WIN\FLEXM1.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Flex und Flo 1 Mathe"

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%CommonAppdataDir%\Schroedel\FLEXM1\"

[Patches_lizenz.ini]
Set [Lizenz] Lizenz=$License$

end_link

DefVar $Path$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Notting Hill Gate 2"
Sub_CheckAIR
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Files_CopyConfig
LinkFolder_Setup

[Sub_CheckAIR]
if fileexists("%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Gemeinsame Dateien\Adobe AIR\Versions\1.0\Adobe AIR Application Installer.exe")
  Set $Path$ = "Gemeinsame Dateien"
else
  if fileexists("%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Common Files\Adobe AIR\Versions\1.0\Adobe AIR Application Installer.exe")
    Set $Path$ = "Common Files"
  else
    LogError "Fatal: Adobe AIR not found"
    IsFatalError
  endif
endif

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%ProgramFiles32Dir%\$Path$\Adobe AIR\Versions\1.0\Adobe AIR Application Installer.exe" -silent "%ScriptPath%\data\Application\install.air"

[Files_CopyConfig]
copy "%ScriptPath%\config.xml" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Diesterweg\Lernsoftware NHG2 Netzwerkversion\"

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Diesterweg"
set_link
  name: "Notting Hill Gate 2"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Diesterweg\Lernsoftware NHG2 Netzwerkversion\Lernsoftware NHG2 Netzwerkversion.exe"
end_link

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
; http://wiki.iserv.eu/wiki/Adobe_Air
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "1" or $ExitCode$ = "9")
  ; 0: Installation successful
  ; 1: Installation successful but reboot required
  ; 9: Installation failed; application already installed
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptySystemFolder64]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Dobot"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyStartmenuFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
;path = "C:\Program Files\Dobot"
path = "%CommonStartmenuDir%\Programs\Dobot"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

  Set $ActiveSetupVersion$ = GetRegistryStringValueSysnative("[HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\docker-desktop] "+"Version")

    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
  else

      LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
    endif
endif
