Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\easySoftV741_setup.exe" /S /v/qn

[DosInAnIcon_License]
; -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Modified on: 2022-11-22
; -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Normally only "LicCompany" and "LicKey" are necessary from the following entries.
; In version 7.41 the registry key for 7.41 is completely deleted by the manufacturer after the installation with /S /v/qn.
; With manual installation everything runs normally.
;
; More information in: #55668 and #56073
;--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo Windows Registry Editor Version 5.00 >> %opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\License.reg
echo [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Eaton\easySoft\7.41 ] >> %opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\License.reg
echo "CompanyId" = dword:00000001  >> %opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\License.reg
echo "CurrentDokuLanguage"=REG_SZ:"DE" >> %opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\License.reg
echo "CurrentLanguage"=REG_SZ:"D" >> %opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\License.reg
echo "InstallDir"=REG_SZ:"C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Eaton\\easySoft $Version$" >> %opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\License.reg
echo "LicCompany"=REG_SZ:"$Company$" >> %opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\License.reg
echo "LicKey"=REG_SZ:"$LicKey$" >> %opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\License.reg
echo "LicName"=REG_SZ:"Windows-Benutzer" >> %opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\License.reg
echo "PACKAGE_SDLC"=REG_SZ:"easy-soft" >> %opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\License.reg
echo "PATH_SDLC_HTML"=REG_SZ:"SoftwareUpdate/index/Html" >> %opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\License.reg
echo  "URL_SDLC"=REG_SZ:"https://applications.eaton.eu/sdlc/" >> %opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\License.reg

[Sub_ImportLicense]
;Import registry keys with licensekey
registry loadUnicodeTextFile("%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\License.reg") /regedit

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[LinkFolder_Cleanup]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "easySoft 7.41"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptySystemFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Eaton"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[Initial]

DefVar $Hostname$

Sub_Setup

PatchTextFile_Config2 "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\eclipse\eclipse.ini"
Sub_PatchSpeedup
Sub_LinkFolder
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $JavaPath$ = "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\openJDK\openJDK 11"
else
  LogError "Fatal: setup only supports 64-bit systems!"
  IsFatalError
endif

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[Sub_PatchSpeedup]
if GetProductProperty("speedup", "False") = "True"
  PatchTextFile_Speedup "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Eclipse\eclipse.ini"
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Sub_Setup]
; Expanding with PowerShell                          
; File extract with -x buggy
PowerShellCall('Expand-Archive -Force -LiteralPath "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\eclipse-jee-2024-12-R-win32-x86_64.zip" -DestinationPath "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\"')

[Files_CopyAddins]
copy -se "\\$Hostname$\appdata\eclipse\*" "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Eclipse"

[PatchTextFile_Config]
FindLine_StartingWith "osgi.instance.area.default"
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine "osgi.user.area=H:/Eclipse"
AdvanceLine 1
InsertLine "osgi.configuration.area=H:/Eclipse/.eclipse"
AdvanceLine 1
InsertLine "osgi.instance.area.default=H:/Eclipse/workspace"

[PatchTextFile_Config2]
FindLine_StartingWith "-Dosgi.instance.area.default"
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine "osgi.instance.area.default=H:/Eclipse/workspace"
GotoTop
FindLine_StartingWith "-vmargs"
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine "$JavaPath$\bin\"
AdvanceLine 1
InsertLine "-vm"

[PatchTextFile_Speedup]
AppendLine "-Xverify:none"

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Setup

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Eclipse"
set_link
  name: "Eclipse"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\eclipse\eclipse.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Eclipse"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\eclipse\eclipse.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Eclipse"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%" & "\EPLAN" & "\Common"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If
path = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%" & "\EPLAN"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If
path = "%ProgramFiles64Dir%" & "\EPLAN" & "\Common"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If
path = "%ProgramFiles64Dir%" & "\EPLAN"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyStartmenueFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Novar"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_PrepareSetup
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Registry_Setup /SysNative
Sub_LinkFolder

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
; Workaround for Windows 10 until vendor fixed setup
if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "10.0") = "0")
  Set $Tasks$ = ' /TASKS=""'
endif
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)

[WinBatch_Setup]
; Inno Setup
; https://doku.iserv.de/development/deploy/packages/installer/inno/
"%ScriptPath%\data\SweetHome3D-$Version$-windows.exe" /SP- /VERYSILENT /os.arch=x64 /NOCANCEL $Tasks$

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Registry_Setup]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Sweet Home 3D_is1]
Set "DisplayName" = REG_SZ:"Sweet Home 3D"
Set "DisplayIcon" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Sweet Home 3D\SweetHome3D.exe"

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Cleanup

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Sweet Home 3D"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Sweet Home 3D\SweetHome3D.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Sweet Home 3D"

[LinkFolder_Cleanup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Sweet Home 3D"
delete_element "Sweet Home 3D entfernen"

LinkFolder_Cleanup
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Files_Copy

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "10.0") = "0"
  Set $Tasks$ = ' /TASKS="" '
endif

[LinkFolder_Cleanup]
set_basefolder common_programs
delete_subfolder "EUKLID DynaGeo"

[WinBatch_Setup]
; InnoSetup
; http://unattended.sourceforge.net/InnoSetup_Switches_ExitCodes.html
"%ScriptPath%\data\edg40.exe" /sp- /silent /norestart /nocancel $Tasks$

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Copy]
; license file
; copy first from package directory and then from appdata/licenses directory
; so that those files always take precedence
copy "%ScriptPath%\*.dgl" "%ProgramFilesDir%\DynaGeo"
copy "\\iserv\appdata\licenses\euklid-dynageo\*.dgl" "%ProgramFilesDir%\DynaGeo"
; INI file; if this does not exist, DynaGeo will try to create it
; and then crash if it doesn't have admin rights :O
copy "%ScriptPath%\DynaGeo.ini" "%ProgramFilesDir%\DynaGeo"

    Files_Delete
    LinkFolder_Delete
    ExecWith_RemoveEmptySystemFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"
    ExecWith_RemoveEmptyStartMenuFolder_FKElektroTechnik "cscript" "//E:VBS"
    ExecWith_RemoveEmptyStartMenuFolder_Europa "cscript" "//E:VBS"
endif

[Files_Delete]
delete -sf "%SystemDrive%\Europa Lehrmittel\Arbeitsblätter Elektrotechnik 2.0\"

set_subfolder "Europa Lehrmittel\Fachkunde Elektrotechnik"
delete_element "Arbeitsblätter Fachkunde Elektrotechnik 2.0"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptySystemFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "%SystemDrive%\Europa Lehrmittel"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyStartMenuFolder_FKElektroTechnik]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Europa Lehrmittel\Fachkunde Elektrotechnik"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyStartMenuFolder_Europa]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Europa Lehrmittel"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere Fabmaker Slicer Smart...
DefVar $ExitCode$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Fabmaker Slicer Smart"
Sub_Uninstall
LinkFolder_DeleteShortcut
ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"

[Sub_Uninstall]
if FileExists("%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Fabmaker Slicer Smart\unins000.exe")
    WinBatch_Uninstall
    Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
"%ScriptDrive%\tools\AutoIt3.exe" "%ScriptPath%\remove.au3" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Fabmaker Slicer Smart\unins000.exe"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[LinkFolder_DeleteShortcut]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "fabmaker Slicer"
delete_element "Fabmaker Slicer Smart"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\fabmaker Slicer"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere Fischertechnik ROBO Pro...
DefVar $ExitCode$

[Actions]

Sub_HandleExitCode
Files_Delete

"%ScriptDrive%\tools\autoit\msiRemove_withLog.exe" "fischertechnik ROBOPro"

del -sf "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\ROBOPro\"

set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "ROBOPro"
delete_element "USB-Treiber installieren"

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "fischertechnik ROBOTICS Terminal"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\ROBOPro"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "1605" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 1605 ERROR_UNKNOWN_PRODUCT
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere Fraunhofer Open Roberta Connector...
DefVar $ExitCode$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Fraunhofer Open Roberta Connector"
WinBatch_Uninstall
Sub_HandleExitCode
DosInAnIcon_Firewall
Registry_Setup
LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
msiexec /passive /x {280CA994-3385-429A-9FC6-6276595675F4}

[DosInAnIcon_Firewall]
netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name="IServ Java JRE8" profile=domain

[Registry_Setup]
DeleteKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\{280CA994-3385-429A-9FC6-6276595675F4}]

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "1605" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
    ; 1605 ERROR_UNKNOWN_PRODUCT
    ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Open Roberta Connector"
set_basefolder common_programs
delete_subfolder "OpenRoberta"

[Initial]
Message=Installiere FreeCAD...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "FreeCAD"
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_Copy
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_LinkFolder
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)
If GetSystemType = "x86 System"
  LogError "Setup is only for 64 Bit systems!"
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\FreeCAD_$Version$-Windows-x86_64-py311-installer.exe" /S

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "False"
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "FreeCAD 1.1"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

ENDE: freecad/install.ins

  Sub_HandleExitCodeUninstall

[Sub_Uninstall]

  Sub_HandleExitCodeUninstall
endif

[WinBatch_UninstallOld]
"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\FreeCAD 1.0\Uninstall-FreeCAD.exe" /S

[WinBatch_Uninstall]

  IsFatalError

PAKET: gdata-security-client
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/gdata-security-client/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
SetLogLevel=6
Message=Installiere G Data Security Client...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Parameters$
DefVar $FeaturesChanged$
DefVar $FeatureParameters$

[Aktionen]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "G Data"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub_CheckFeatures
Sub_Install
Sub_Reboot

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Parameters$ = '/@_QuietInstallation="true" /@SelectedLanguage="de" '
if not(GetProductProperty("host", "") = "")
  Set $Parameters$ = $Parameters$ + ' /@HostName="' + GetProductProperty("host", "") + '"'
endif
if not(GetProductProperty("group", "") = "")
  Set $Parameters$ = $Parameters$ + ' /@GroupName="' + GetProductProperty("group", "") + '"'
endif

[Sub_CheckFeatures]
Set $FeaturesChanged$ = "False"
Set $FeatureParameters$ = '/@_EnableFeaturesDefault="'

;Check AntiSpam
if (GetProductProperty("antiSpam", "False") = "True")
  Set $FeatureParameters$ = $FeatureParameters$ + "$B_Client_AntiSpam$,"
  Set $FeaturesChanged$ = "True"
endif
;Check Backup
if (GetProductProperty("backup", "False") = "True")
  Set $FeatureParameters$ = $FeatureParameters$ + "$B_Client_Backup$,"
  Set $FeaturesChanged$ = "True"
endif
;Check DeviceControl
if (GetProductProperty("deviceControl", "False") = "True")
  Set $FeatureParameters$ = $FeatureParameters$ + "$B_Client_DeviceControl$,"
  Set $FeaturesChanged$ = "True"
endif
;Check Firewall
if (GetProductProperty("firewall", "False") = "True")
  Set $FeatureParameters$ = $FeatureParameters$ + "$B_Client_Firewall$"
  Set $FeaturesChanged$ = "True"
endif

Set $FeatureParameters$ = $FeatureParameters$ + '"'
if($FeaturesChanged$ = "True")
  Set $Parameters$ = $Parameters$ + " " + $FeatureParameters$
endif

[Sub_Install]
If not(FileExists("\\iserv\appdata\gdata-security-client\GDClientPck.exe"))
  LogError "Fatal! Installer 'GDClientPck.exe' not found in \\iserv\appdata\gdata-security-client\"
  IsFatalError
EndIf
WinBatch_Setup /WaitForProcessEnding "setup.exe" /TimeOutSeconds 1000
Sub_HandleExitCode

[WinBatch_Setup]
"\\iserv\appdata\gdata-security-client\GDClientPck.exe" $Parameters$

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_Reboot]
ExitWindows /Reboot

################################################################################
ENDE: gdata-security-client/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]

DefVar $Path$
Encoding=utf-8

ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Java Bibliotheken"
Sub_Setup

[Sub_Setup]
if FileExists("%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\BlueJ\lib\userlib")
  Files_CopyBlueJ
else
  LogError "For considered work with BlueJ - BlueJ has to be installed firstly. Please execute the installation of this package afterwards again."
endif
if FileExists("%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\JavaEditor\JEMachine.INI")
  Files_CopyJavaEditor
  SubReadIni
  DosInAnIcon_FixPerms
else
  LogError "For considered work with the JavaEditor - the JavaEditor has to be installed firstly. Please execute the installation of this package afterwards again."
endif


[Files_CopyBlueJ]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\BlueJ\lib\userlib"

[Files_CopyJavaEditor]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\JavaEditor\UserAddIn"

[SubReadIni]
set $Path$ = GetValueFromInifile("%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\JavaEditor\JEMachine.INI", "Program", "Classpath", "")
if not(contains($Path$, "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\JavaEditor\UserAddIn\*"))
  if not($Path$ = "")
    set $Path$ = $Path$ + ";"
  endif
  Patches_Config "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\JavaEditor\JEMachine.INI"
endif

[DosInAnIcon_FixPerms]
icacls "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\JavaEditor\UserAddIn" /grant *S-1-1-0:(OI)F /T

[Patches_Config]
set [Program] Classpath=$Path$%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\JavaEditor\UserAddIn\*

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere Gluon JavaFX SDK...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Path$
DefVar $DirName$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Gluon JavaFX SDK"
Sub_PrepareRemove
Files_Cleanup

ExecWith_RemoveEmptySystemFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"

;
; On Update just change this!
;
Set $DirName$ = "JavaFX17"

[Files_Cleanup]
del -sf "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Java\$DirName$\"

[Sub_DeleteFX]
Set $Path$ = EnvVar("Path")
; Removes all elements containing JavaFX17
DefStringList $Paths$
Set $Paths$ = splitString($Path$, ";")
Set $Paths$ = removeFromListByContaining($DirName$, $Paths$)
Set $Path$ = composeString($Paths$, ";")
Registry_DeleteFX

[Registry_DeleteFX]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\control\Session Manager\Environment]
DeleteVar "JDK_HOME"
DeleteVar "JAVADOCS_VERSION"
Set "Path" = '$Path$'

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptySystemFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Java"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

    Sub_HandleExitCodeUninstall
    Sub_Cleanup
  endif

$UninstParameter$

  IsFatalError

  Files_Delete

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Google Chrome...
DefStringList $StartpageList$
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Homepage$
DefVar $Hostname$
DefVar $IconURL$
DefVar $NewTabURL$
DefVar $PasswordManager$
DefVar $RoamingProfilesEnabled$
DefVar $Searchprovider$
DefVar $SearchURL$
DefVar $Servername$
DefVar $Startpage$
DefVar $StartpageCount$
DefVar $SuggestURL$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Google Chrome"
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub_SetVariables
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Registry_Setup
Sub_SetupStartpage
Sub_UserProfile
Sub_LinkFolder

[Sub_KillTask_ChromeUpdate]
KillTask "GoogleUpdate.exe"
KillTask "chrome.exe"

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString("0", GetReturnListFromSection("OpsiServiceCall_GetHostname"))))
Set $Servername$ = TakeString("0", GetReturnListFromSection("OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Servername"))
Set $Homepage$ = "https://"+$Servername$+"/iserv/"
Set $StartpageCount$ = "1"

Set $Arch$ = ""
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "64"
endif

[Sub_SetVariables]
if not(GetProductProperty("homepage", "") = "")
  Set $Homepage$ = GetProductProperty("homepage", "")
EndIf

if FileExists("\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\google-chrome\startpage.txt")
  Set $StartpageList$ = loadTextFile("\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\google-chrome\startpage.txt")
Else
  if not(GetProductProperty("startpage", "") = "")
    Set $StartpageList$ = splitString(GetProductProperty("startpage", ""), "|")
  EndIf
EndIf

if GetProductProperty("manager", "True") = "True"
  Set $PasswordManager$ = "1"
Else
  Set $PasswordManager$ = "0"
EndIf

if GetProductProperty("searchprovider", "") = "DuckDuckGo"
  Set $Searchprovider$ = "DuckDuckGo"
  Set $SearchURL$ = "https://duckduckgo.com/?q={searchTerms}\"
  Set $IconURL$ = "https://duckduckgo.com/favicon.ico"
  Set $NewTabURL$ = "https://duckduckgo.com/chrome_newtab"
  Set $SuggestURL$ = "https://duckduckgo.com/ac/?q={searchTerms}&type=list"
EndIf

if GetProductProperty("searchprovider", "") = "Ecosia"
  Set $Searchprovider$ = "Ecosia"
  Set $SearchURL$ = "https://www.ecosia.org/search?q={searchTerms}"
  Set $IconURL$ = "https://ecosia.org/favicon.ico"
  Set $NewTabURL$ = "https://ecosia.org"
  Set $SuggestURL$ = "https://www.ecosia.org/search?q={searchTerms}&type=list"
EndIf

if GetProductProperty("searchprovider", "") = "fragFINN.de"
  Set $Searchprovider$ = "fragFINN.de"
  Set $SearchURL$ = "https://www.fragfinn.de/?s={searchTerms}"
  Set $IconURL$ = "https://www.fragfinn.de/favicon.ico"
  Set $NewTabURL$ = "https://www.fragfinn.de"
  Set $SuggestURL$ = "https://www.fragfinn.de/?s={searchTerms}&type=list"
EndIf

if GetProductProperty("searchprovider", "") = "Google"
  Set $Searchprovider$ = "Google"
  Set $SearchURL$ = "{google:baseURL}search?q={searchTerms}&{google:RLZ}{google:originalQueryForSuggestion}{google:assistedQueryStats}{google:searchFieldtrialParameter}{google:searchClient}{google:sourceId}ie={inputEncoding"
  Set $IconURL$ = "http://www.google.com/favicon.ico"
  Set $NewTabURL$ = "{google:baseURL}"
  Set $SuggestURL$ = "{google:baseURL}complete/search?output=chrome&q={searchTerms}"
EndIf

[OpsiServiceCall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Servername]
"method": "iserv_cfg"
"params": [
  "Servername"
]

[OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_RoamingProfiles]
"method": "iserv_cfg"
"params": [
  "RoamingProfiles"
]

[Sub_UserProfile]
; If Roaming profiles are enabled, drive I: (Windows profile) will not be
; mounted. Enabling profiles in that case is probably not the best idea.
Set $RoamingProfilesEnabled$ = TakeString("0", GetReturnListFromSection("OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_RoamingProfiles"))

; $RoamingProfilesEnabled$ explicitly uses small case as it comes as bool from
; JSON RPC reponse and not as uppercase string "True" like the product property.
;
; DO NOT CHANGE RANDOMLY!
if ($RoamingProfilesEnabled$ = "true" and GetProductProperty("userprofile", "True") = "True")
  Registry_Profile
else
  Registry_Remove_Profile
endif

[Registry_Profile]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Policies\Google\Chrome]
set "RoamingProfileLocation"=REG_SZ:"I:\Remote.V2\AppData\Google\Chrome"
set "RoamingProfileSupportEnabled"=REG_DWORD:1

[Registry_Remove_Profile]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Policies\Google\Chrome]
DeleteVar "RoamingProfileLocation"
DeleteVar "RoamingProfileSupportEnabled"

[WinBatch_Setup]
; Download: http://www.google.com/chrome/eula.html?msi=true
; Doku: http://www.google.com/support/a/bin/answer.py?hl=en&answer=187202
msiexec /passive /i "%ScriptPath%\data\GoogleChromeStandaloneEnterprise$Arch$.msi"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Registry_Setup]
; Disable auto-update
; Doku: http://www.google.com/support/a/bin/answer.py?answer=187207
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Google\Update]
set "AutoUpdateCheckPeriodMinutes"=REG_DWORD:0
set "DisableAutoUpdateChecksCheckboxValue"=REG_DWORD:1
set "Update{8A69D345-D564-463C-AFF1-A69D9E530F96}"=REG_DWORD:0
set "Update{4DC8B4CA-1BDA-483E-B5FA-D3C12E15B62D}"=REG_DWORD:0

; Doku: http://www.google.com/support/a/bin/answer.py?hl=en&answer=187206
; Set default search provider
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Policies\Google\Chrome]
Set "DefaultSearchProviderEnabled"=REG_DWORD:1
set "DefaultSearchProviderName"=REG_SZ:"$Searchprovider$"
set "DefaultSearchProviderSearchURL"=REG_SZ:"$SearchURL$"
set "DefaultSearchProviderIconURL"=REG_SZ:"$IconURL$"
set "DefaultSearchProviderNewTabURL"=REG_SZ:"$NewTabURL$"
set "DefaultSearchProviderSuggestURL"=REG_SZ:"$SuggestURL$"

; Set Cache
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Policies\Google\Chrome]
set "DiskCacheDir"=REG_SZ:"%LocalAppData%\Google\Chrome\Cache"
set "DefaultBrowserSettingEnabled"=REG_DWORD:0

; Set Passwortd-Manager
Set "PasswordManagerEnabled"=REG_DWORD:$PasswordManager$
set "RestoreOnStartup"=REG_DWORD:4
; Disable Startpage
set "PromotionalTabsEnabled"=REG_DWORD:0
set "WelcomePageOnOSUpgradeEnabled"=REG_DWORD:0

; Set Homepage
Set "ShowHomeButton"=REG_DWORD:1
set "HomepageLocation"=REG_SZ:"$Homepage$"
set "HomepageIsNewTabPage"=REG_DWORD:0

[Sub_SetupStartpage]
Registry_RemoveStartpage

if not(count($StartpageList$) = "0")
  for $Page$ in $StartpageList$ do Sub_AddStartpage
else
  Set $Startpage$ = $Homepage$
  Registry_AddStartpage
endif

[Sub_AddStartpage]
Set $Startpage$ = '$Page$'
Registry_AddStartpage
Set $StartpageCount$ = calculate($StartpageCount$+"+1")

[Registry_AddStartpage]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Google\Chrome\RestoreOnStartupURLs]
Set "$StartpageCount$" = REG_SZ:"$Startpage$"

[Registry_RemoveStartpage]
DeleteKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Google\Chrome\RestoreOnStartupURLs]

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Setup

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "True") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Google Chrome"
  target: "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"
  parameters: "--lang=de"
end_link

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Google Chrome"
  target: "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"
  parameters: "--lang=de"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Google Chrome"

WinBatch_SetACL
Sub_HandleExitCode

[Sub_PrepareSetup]

[Files_DeletePrevious]
delete -sf "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Hamstersimulator\"

[Files_Setup]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*.*" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Hamstersimulator"
copy "%ScriptPath%\hamster.ico" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Hamstersimulator"

[PatchTextFile_Setup]
; runlocally-Wert setzen
GoToTop
FindLine_StartingWith 'workspace'
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine 'workspace=H:\Hamstersimulator'
GoToTop
FindLine_StartingWith 'runlocally'
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine 'runlocally=$runlocally$'

[LinkFolder_Setup]
; Startmenü-Eintrag
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Hamstersimulator"
set_link
  name: "Hamstersimulator"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Hamstersimulator\hamstersimulator.bat"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Hamstersimulator"
  icon_file: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Hamstersimulator\hamster.ico"
end_link

[WinBatch_SetACL]
; Hamstersimulator requires write permissions to it's program folder
; S-1-1-0: Everyone
"%ScriptPath%\SetACL.exe" -on "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Hamstersimulator" -ot file -actn ace -ace "n:S-1-1-0;p:full;s:y"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
   LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
   IsFatalError
endif

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Haskell Platform"
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"

[Initial]
Message=Installiere IServ Lokalen Windows-Benutzer erstellen...
; Fix for umlauts in error messages
Encoding=UTF-8
DefVar $autoLogin$
DefVar $CantChangePassword$
DefVar $DefaultProfilePath$
DefVar $Description$
DefVar $ErrorMessage$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $FullName$
DefVar $Group$
DefVar $mandatory$
DefVar $MandatoryProfilePath$
DefVar $Name$
DefVar $overwrite$
DefVar $Password$
DefVar $passwordchg$
DefVar $PCName$
DefVar $ProfilePath$
DefVar $resetMandatoryProfile$
DefVar $restriction_cmd$
DefVar $restriction_contextmenu$
DefVar $restriction_copilot$
DefVar $restriction_controlpanel$
DefVar $restriction_notifications$
DefVar $restriction_onedrive$
DefVar $restriction_regedit$
DefVar $restriction_run$
DefVar $restriction_store$
DefVar $restriction_taskmanager$
DefVar $restriction_wallpaper$
DefVar $restriction_websearch$
DefVar $Server$
DefVar $shares$
DefVar $UserGroup$
DefVar $Workgroup$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "IServ Lokalen Windows-Benutzer erstellen"
include_insert "%ScriptDrive%\tools\scripts\report-error-init.inc.ins"
Sub_GetProperties
Sub_Validate
Sub_Create

[Sub_GetProperties]
Set $PCName$ = "%PCName%"
Set $Name$ = GetProductProperty("name", "")
Set $FullName$ = GetProductProperty("fullname", "")
Set $Description$ = GetProductProperty("description", "")
Set $Password$ = GetProductProperty("password", "")
Set $Group$ = GetProductProperty("group", "")
Set $CantChangePassword$ = GetProductProperty("cantchangepw", "true")

if ($CantChangePassword$ = "True")
  Set $passwordchg$ = "no"
else
  if ($CantChangePassword$ = "False")
    Set $passwordchg$ = "yes"
  else
    Set $passwordchg$ = "no"
  endif
endif

Set $autoLogin$ = GetProductProperty("autoLogin", "False")
Set $mandatory$ = GetProductProperty("mandatory", "False")
Set $overwrite$ = GetProductProperty("overwrite", "False")
Set $resetMandatoryProfile$ = GetProductProperty("resetMandatoryProfile", "True")
Set $restriction_cmd$ = GetProductProperty("restriction_cmd", "False")
Set $restriction_contextmenu$ = GetProductProperty("restriction_contextmenu", "False")
Set $restriction_copilot$ = GetProductProperty("restriction_copilot", "False")
Set $restriction_controlpanel$ = GetProductProperty("restriction_controlpanel", "False")
Set $restriction_notifications$ = GetProductProperty("restriction_notifications", "False")
Set $restriction_onedrive$ = GetProductProperty("restriction_onedrive", "False")
Set $restriction_regedit$ = GetProductProperty("restriction_regedit", "False")
Set $restriction_run$ = GetProductProperty("restriction_run", "False")
Set $restriction_store$ = GetProductProperty("restriction_store", "False")
Set $restriction_taskmanager$ = GetProductProperty("restriction_taskmanager", "False")
Set $restriction_wallpaper$ = GetProductProperty("restriction_wallpaper", "False")
Set $restriction_websearch$ = GetProductProperty("restriction_websearch", "False")
Set $shares$ = GetProductProperty("shares", "True")

Set $Server$ = takeString(0, splitString(takeString(0, getReturnListFromSection("OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Servername")), "."))
Set $Workgroup$ = takeString(0, getReturnListFromSection("OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Workgroup"))

if FileExists("%Systemdrive%\IServ\%installingProdName%\Script\empty-RecycleBin.ps1")
  Files_Remove_OldScript
endif

if ($mandatory$ = "True")
  ; Set Paths
  Set $ProfilePath$ = "%ProfileDir%\" + $Name$ + ".man"
  Set $DefaultProfilePath$ = "%ProfileDir%\Default"
  Set $MandatoryProfilePath$ = "%ProfileDir%\" + $Name$ + ".man.v6"

  ; Sets schedTask for emptying the trashbin for local user objects which are mandatory at logoff
  Files_Copy_EmptyRecycleBinScripts
endif

[Sub_Validate]
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMSVersionInfo, "<", "10.0")
  Set $ErrorMessage$ = "Keine kompatible Windows Version. Erforderlich ist mindestens Windows 10 oder neuer."
  Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $ErrorMessage$)
  Sub_ReportError
  LogError "Fatal: Windows version not supported. Only compatible with Windows 10 or higher."
  IsFatalError
endif

if ($Name$ = "")
  Set $ErrorMessage$ = "Kein Benutzername festgelegt."
  Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $ErrorMessage$)
  Sub_ReportError
  LogError "Fatal: name not set"
  IsFatalError
endif

if ($Name$ = "Administrator" or $Name$ = "Gast" or $Name$ = "Guest")
  Set $ErrorMessage$ = $Name$ + " ist ein reservierter Windows-Benutzer, der nicht modifiziert oder als Benutzername in Bezug auf einen neuen lokalen Benutzer verwendet werden kann."
  Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $ErrorMessage$)
  Sub_ReportError
  LogError "Fatal: " + $Name$ + " is a reserved Windows user that cannot be modified or used as a username for a new local user."
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_Create]
; Error-Codes sind nicht eindeutig.
if ($mandatory$ = "True" and (not(FileExists($MandatoryProfilePath$)) or $resetMandatoryProfile$ = "True"))
  Files_DeleteMandatoryProfile
  Files_CopyProfile
  Files_CleanupMandatoryProfile
  DosInAnIcon_HideMandatoryProfile
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  DosInAnIcon_RemoveAttributes
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  Files_RenameRegistryHive
  DosInAnIcon_ResetAttributes
  Sub_HandleExitCode

  DosInAnIcon_FixProfilePermissionsWin10
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  DosInAnIcon_GrantMandatoryProfileReadAccess
  Sub_HandleExitCode

  DosInAnIcon_LoadRegistryHive
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  DosInAnIcon_FixRegistryPermissions
  Sub_HandleExitCode

  DosInAnIcon_FixRegistryPermissionsWin10
  Sub_HandleExitCode

  if ($shares$ = "True")
    Registry_Shares
  endif

  if ($restriction_cmd$ = "True")
    Registry_Restriction_Cmd
  endif
  if ($restriction_contextmenu$ = "True")
    Registry_Restriction_ContextMenu
  endif
  if ($restriction_copilot$ = "True")
    Registry_Restriction_Copilot
  endif
  if ($restriction_controlpanel$ = "True")
    Registry_Restriction_ControlPanel
  endif
  if ($restriction_notifications$ = "True")
    Registry_Restriction_Notifications
  endif
  if ($restriction_onedrive$ = "True")
    Registry_Restriction_OneDrive
  endif
  if ($restriction_regedit$ = "True")
    Registry_Restriction_Regedit
  endif
  if ($restriction_run$ = "True")
    Registry_Restriction_Run
  endif
  if ($restriction_store$ = "True")
    Registry_Restriction_Store
  endif
  if ($restriction_taskmanager$ = "True")
    Registry_Restriction_TaskManager
  endif
  if ($restriction_wallpaper$ = "True")
    Registry_Restriction_Wallpaper
  endif
  if ($restriction_websearch$ = "True")
    Registry_Restriction_WebSearch
  endif

  DosInAnIcon_UnloadRegistryHive
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

if ($mandatory$ = "True" or $overwrite$ = "True")
  DosInAnIcon_UserDel
  ; Allow everyone full access to the user profile to make sure that we can delete it.
  DosInAnIcon_FixProfilePermissions
  Files_DeleteUserProfile
  ; For mysterious reasons, in certain situations opsi-script is not able to delete the user profile completly, so lets cleanup the rest with a batch script.
  DosInAnIcon_CleanupUserProfileRests
endif

; Check if the user already exists
; If not, create the user
; If the user exists, reapply settings such as password and other options
DosInAnIcon_Check
if (GetLastExitCode = "1")
  Set $ErrorMessage$ = "Fehler beim Erstellen des Benutzers: " + takeString(0, getOutStreamFromSection("DosInAnIcon_UserAdd"))
  Sub_HandleExitCode
else
  if not($mandatory$ = "True")
    DosInAnIcon_UserOptions
    Sub_HandleExitCode
  endif
endif

DosInAnIcon_DisablePasswordExpiry
Sub_HandleExitCode
; Set Description and Full Name via WinBatch instead of DosInAnIcon, because cmd would break umlauts
WinBatch_SetDescription
Sub_HandleExitCode
WinBatch_SetFullName
Sub_HandleExitCode

; Check if user group (Benutzer/Users) is entered in group property to prevent
; errornous message "Der angegebene Kontoname ist bereits Mitglied der Gruppe."
; as every new user is member of Users group
Set $UserGroup$ = SidToName("S-1-5-32-545")
if not($Group$ = "") and not ($Group$ = $UserGroup$)
  DosInAnIcon_Group
  if not(GetLastExitCode = "0")
    set $ErrorMessage$ = "Fehler beim Zuweisen zur Gruppe '" + $Group$ + "': " + takeString(2, getOutStreamFromSection("DosInAnIcon_Group"))
    Sub_HandleExitCode
  endif
endif

if ($autoLogin$ = "True")
  Registry_AutoLogin /SysNative

  if not($Password$ = "")
    Registry_AutoLogin_Password /SysNative
  else
    Registry_AutoLogin_RemovePassword /SysNative
  endif
else
  Registry_DisableAutoLogin /SysNative
endif


[Files_Remove_OldScript]
delete -f "%Systemdrive%\IServ\%installingProdName%\Script\empty-RecycleBin.ps1"

[Files_Copy_EmptyRecycleBinScripts]
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\add\autorun.cmd" "%CommonStartupDir%"
;copy "%ScriptPath%\data\add\empty-RecycleBin.ps1" "%SystemDrive%\IServ\%installingProdName%\Script"

[Files_DeleteMandatoryProfile]
delete -sfc "$MandatoryProfilePath$\"

[Files_CopyProfile]
; -e = copy empty directories
copy -sce "$DefaultProfilePath$\*" "$MandatoryProfilePath$\"

[Files_CleanupMandatoryProfile]
delete -fc "$MandatoryProfilePath$\ntuser.dat.LOG*"
delete -fc "$MandatoryProfilePath$\ntuser.dat{*"

[Files_RenameRegistryHive]
rename "$MandatoryProfilePath$\ntuser.dat" "$MandatoryProfilePath$\ntuser.man"

[DosInAnIcon_FixRegistryPermissions]
@echo off
"%ScriptPath%\data\add\SetACL.exe" -on HKU\.DEFAULT.man -ot REG -actn ace -ace "n:S-1-1-0;p:full"

[DosInAnIcon_FixRegistryPermissionsWin10]
@echo off
; Allow "ALLE ANWENDUNGSPAKETE" full access to User's registry on Windows 10 to fix startmenu
; https://www.windowspro.de/wolfgang-sommergut/anleitung-mandatory-user-profile-verbindliches-benutzerprofil-fuer-windows-10
"%ScriptPath%\data\add\SetACL.exe" -on HKU\.DEFAULT.man -ot REG -actn ace -ace "n:S-1-15-2-1;p:full"

[DosInAnIcon_RemoveAttributes]
@echo off
attrib -h -s "$MandatoryProfilePath$\ntuser.dat"

[DosInAnIcon_ResetAttributes]
@echo off
attrib +h +s "$MandatoryProfilePath$\ntuser.man"

[DosInAnIcon_HideMandatoryProfile]
@echo off
attrib +h "$MandatoryProfilePath$"

[DosInAnIcon_FixProfilePermissions]
@echo off
"%ScriptPath%\data\add\SetACL.exe" -on %ProfileDir%\$name$\ -ot FILE -rec yes -actn ace -ace "n:S-1-1-0;p:full"

[DosInAnIcon_FixProfilePermissionsWin10]
@echo off
; Allow "ALLE ANWENDUNGSPAKETE" full access to User's profile on Windows 10 to fix startmenu
; https://www.windowspro.de/wolfgang-sommergut/anleitung-mandatory-user-profile-verbindliches-benutzerprofil-fuer-windows-10
"%ScriptPath%\data\add\SetACL.exe" -on $MandatoryProfilePath$\ -ot FILE -rec yes -actn ace -ace "n:S-1-15-2-1;p:full" -rec yes

[DosInAnIcon_Check]
@echo off
for /f %%i in ('powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_UserAccount | Where-Object { $_.LocalAccount -eq $true } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name" ^| findstr /r /v "^$"') do echo %%i | findstr /i /x "$Name$"
exit %ERRORLEVEL%

[DosInAnIcon_GrantMandatoryProfileReadAccess]
@echo off
; Grant BUILTIN\Users read access so the user can load the mandatory profile
icacls "$MandatoryProfilePath$" /grant *S-1-5-32-545:(OI)(CI)R /T

[DosInAnIcon_LoadRegistryHive]
@echo off
REG LOAD HKU\.DEFAULT.man "$MandatoryProfilePath$\ntuser.man"

[DosInAnIcon_UnloadRegistryHive]
@echo off
REG UNLOAD HKU\.DEFAULT.man

[Registry_Shares]
openkey [HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\NetworkProvider]
set "RestoreConnection" = REG_DWORD:0
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Network]
set "RestoreDiskChecked" = REG_DWORD:0
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Network\G]
; 131072 in HEX: 0x20000
set "ProviderType" = REG_DWORD:131072
set "ConnectionType" = REG_DWORD:1
set "RemotePath" = "\\$Server$\groups"
set "ProviderName" = "Microsoft Windows Network"
set "DeferFlags" = REG_DWORD:1
set "UserName" = ""
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Network\H]
; 131072 in HEX: 0x20000
set "ProviderType" = REG_DWORD:131072
set "ConnectionType" = REG_DWORD:1
set "RemotePath" = "\\$Server$\home"
set "ProviderName" = "Microsoft Windows Network"
set "DeferFlags" = REG_DWORD:1
set "UserName" = ""

[DosInAnIcon_UserDel]
@echo off
NET USER "$name$" /delete

[Files_DeleteUserProfile]
delete -sfc "%ProfileDir%\$name$\"
; delete multiple copies of user profile, mostly their have the suffix .PCName, .PCName.000, .PCName.001 and so far...
delete -sfc "%ProfileDir%\$name$.$PCName$*\"

[DosInAnIcon_UserAdd]
@echo off
;change code page for umlauts and hide the output
chcp 1252 > NUL
; create it if it doesn't exist
; parameter /y to force passwords longer than 14 characters
; http://serverfault.com/questions/452894/force-net-user-command-to-set-password-longer-than-14-characters
net user "$Name$" "$Password$" /EXPIRES:NEVER /passwordchg:$passwordchg$ /PASSWORDREQ:$passwordchg$ /PROFILEPATH:"$ProfilePath$" /add /y

[DosInAnIcon_DisablePasswordExpiry]
@echo off
; disable password expiry
cscript //nologo "%ScriptPath%\data\add\nopwdexp.vbs" /domain:"%PCName%" /user:"$Name$"

[DosInAnIcon_CleanupUserProfileRests]
@echo off
rmdir /S /Q "%ProfileDir%\$name$"

[DosInAnIcon_UserOptions]
@echo off
;change code page for umlauts and hide the output
chcp 1252 > NUL
; if it exists, re-apply options
; parameter /y to force passwords longer than 14 characters
; http://serverfault.com/questions/452894/force-net-user-command-to-set-password-longer-than-14-characters
net user "$Name$" "$Password$" /EXPIRES:NEVER /passwordchg:$passwordchg$ /PASSWORDREQ:$passwordchg$ /PROFILEPATH:"$ProfilePath$" /y

[WinBatch_SetDescription]
net user "$Name$" /COMMENT:"$description$" 

[WinBatch_SetFullName]
net user "$Name$" /FULLNAME:"$FullName$"

[DosInAnIcon_Group]
@echo off
net localgroup "$Group$" /add "$Name$"

[Registry_AutoLogin]
openkey [HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon]
set "AutoAdminLogon" = "1"
set "DefaultUserName" = "$Name$"
set "DefaultDomainName" = "$PCName$"

[Registry_AutoLogin_Password]
openkey [HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon]
set "DefaultPassword" = "$Password$"

[Registry_AutoLogin_RemovePassword]
openkey [HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon]
deletevar "DefaultPassword"

[Registry_DisableAutoLogin]
openkey [HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon]
deletevar "DefaultUserName"
deletevar "DefaultPassword"
set "AutoAdminLogon" = "0"
set "DefaultDomainName" = "$Workgroup$"

[OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Servername]

"method": "iserv_cfg"
"params": [
  "Hostname"
]

[OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Workgroup]
"method": "iserv_cfg"
"params": [
  "Workgroup"
]

[Registry_Restriction_ControlPanel]
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer]
set "NoControlPanel" = REG_DWORD:1

[Registry_Restriction_TaskManager]
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System]
set "DisableTaskMgr" = REG_DWORD:1

[Registry_Restriction_Cmd]
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System]
set "DisableCMD" = REG_DWORD:2

[Registry_Restriction_ContextMenu]
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer]
set "NoViewContextMenu" = REG_DWORD:1

[Registry_Restriction_Copilot]
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot]
set "TurnOffWindowsCopilot" = REG_DWORD:1

[Registry_Restriction_Notifications]
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer]
set "DisableNotificationCenter" = REG_DWORD:1

[Registry_Restriction_OneDrive]
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Software\Classes\CLSID\{018D5C66-4533-4307-9B53-224DE2ED1FE6}]
set "System.IsPinnedToNameSpaceTree" = REG_DWORD:0
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run]
deletevar "OneDrive"

[Registry_Restriction_Regedit]
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System]
set "DisableRegistryTools" = REG_DWORD:1

[Registry_Restriction_Run]
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer]
set "NoRun" = REG_DWORD:1

[Registry_Restriction_Store]
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Software\Policies\Microsoft\WindowsStore]
set "RemoveWindowsStore" = REG_DWORD:1

[Registry_Restriction_Wallpaper]
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\ActiveDesktop]
set "NoChangingWallPaper" = REG_DWORD:1

[Registry_Restriction_WebSearch]
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer]
set "DisableSearchBoxSuggestions" = REG_DWORD:1
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Search]
set "BingSearchEnabled" = REG_DWORD:0

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  if not($ErrorMessage$ = "")
    Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $ErrorMessage$)
    Sub_ReportError
  endif
  LogError "Fatal: command returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere IServ Lokalen Windows-Benutzer erstellen...
DefVar $autoLogin$
DefVar $ErrorMessage$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $mandatory$
DefVar $MandatoryProfilePath$
DefVar $Name$
DefVar $Workgroup$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "IServ Lokalen Windows-Benutzer erstellen"
include_insert "%ScriptDrive%\tools\scripts\report-error-init.inc.ins"
Sub_GetProperties
Sub_Validate
Sub_Delete

[Sub_GetProperties]
Set $Name$ = GetProductProperty("name", "")
Set $autoLogin$ = GetProductProperty("autoLogin", "False")
Set $mandatory$ = GetProductProperty("mandatory", "False")
Set $Workgroup$ = takeString(0, getReturnListFromSection("OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Workgroup"))
if ($mandatory$ = "True")
  Set $MandatoryProfilePath$ = "%ProfileDir%\" + $Name$ + ".man.v6"
endif

[Sub_Validate]
if ($Name$ = "")
  LogError "Fatal: name not set"
  IsFatalError
endif

if ($Name$ = "Administrator" or $Name$ = "Gast" or $Name$ = "Guest")
  Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $Name$ + " ist ein reservierter Windows-Benutzername, er kann nicht als Benutzername für den lokalen Benutzer verwendet werden.")
  Sub_ReportError
  LogError "Fatal: " + $Name$ + " is a reserved Windows user name, it cannot be used as user name for the local user."
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_Delete]
; Error-Codes sind nicht eindeutig.
if ($mandatory$ = "True" and (FileExists($MandatoryProfilePath$)))
  Files_DeleteMandatoryProfile
endif
; Check if user exists
; if not, do nothing
; if, delete it
DosInAnIcon_Check
if (GetLastExitCode = "0")
  set $ErrorMessage$ = "Fehler beim Löschen des Benutzers: " + takeString(0, getOutStreamFromSection("DosInAnIcon_UserDel"))
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif
Files_DeleteUserProfile
if ($autoLogin$ = "True")
  Registry_DisableAutoLogin /SysNative
endif
Files_Cleanup_ScriptFolder
ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"

[DosInAnIcon_UserDel]
@echo off
NET USER "$name$" /delete

[DosInAnIcon_Check]
@echo off
for /f %%i in ('powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_UserAccount | Where-Object { $_.LocalAccount -eq $true } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name" ^| findstr /r /v "^$"') do echo %%i | findstr /i /x "$Name$"
exit %ERRORLEVEL%

[Files_DeleteUserProfile]
delete -sfc "%ProfileDir%\$name$\"
; delete multiple copies of user profile, mostly their have the suffix .PCName, .PCName.000, .PCName.001 and so far...
delete -sfc "%ProfileDir%\$name$.%PCName%*\"

[Files_DeleteMandatoryProfile]
delete -sfc "$MandatoryProfilePath$\"

[Files_Cleanup_ScriptFolder]
delete -sf "%SystemDrive%\IServ\%installingProdName%\"
delete "%CommonStartupDir%\autorun.cmd"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "%SystemDrive%\IServ"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[Registry_DisableAutoLogin]
openkey [HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon]
deletevar "DefaultUserName"
deletevar "DefaultPassword"
set "AutoAdminLogon" = "0"
set "DefaultDomainName" = "$Workgroup$"

[OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Workgroup]
"method": "iserv_cfg"
"params": [
  "Workgroup"
]

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  if not($ErrorMessage$ = "")
    Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $ErrorMessage$)
    Sub_ReportError
  endif
  LogError "Fatal: command returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

################################################################################
PAKET: hayko-microsoft-dot-net-framework
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/hayko-microsoft-dot-net-framework/install.ins
################################################################################

; Exit codes: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/framework/deployment/guide-for-administrators?redirectedfrom=MSDN#troubleshooting

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Microsoft .NET Framework...
DefVar $BasePath$
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $PackagePath$
DefVar $ReleaseID$
DefVar $ReleaseIDWin11$
DefVar $WinVersion$
DefVar $MSVersion$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Microsoft .NET Framework"
Sub_PrepareWindows
Sub_Setup

[Sub_PrepareWindows]
Set $BasePath$ = "%ScriptPath%\data"
Set $Arch$ = "x86"
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
endif

Set $ReleaseID$ = GetValue("ReleaseID", GetMsVersionMap)
Set $ReleaseIDWin11$ = getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion", "CurrentBuild", "32bit")
Set $MSVersion$ = GetMsVersionInfo
Set $WinVersion$ = ""

; Windows 11 detection
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($MSVersion$, "=", "10.0") and CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($ReleaseIDWin11$, ">=", "22000")
  Set $WinVersion$ = "11.0"
else
  Set $WinVersion$ = $MSVersion$
endif

[Sub_Setup]
Switch $WinVersion$
  Case "10.0"
    Sub_Install_Win10
  EndCase
  Case "11.0"
    Sub_Install_Win11
  EndCase
  DefaultCase
    Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", "Unsupported OS version detected: " + $WinVersion$ + ". Only Windows 10 and later versions are supported. Installation aborted.")
    Sub_ReportError
    LogError "Fatal: Unsupported OS version detected."
    IsFatalError
  EndCase
EndSwitch

[Sub_Install_Win10]
Sub_Set_SXS_Path
; .NET Framework 3.5 auf Windows 10 installieren
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($ReleaseID$, ">=", "1809")
  DosInAnIcon_AddNetFx35Win101809 winst /SysNative
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  DosInAnIcon_InstallNetFx35 winst /SysNative
else
  DosInAnIcon_InstallNetFx35 winst /SysNative
endif
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_InstallNetFx48

; Win11 liefert .NET 4.8 bereits mit — daher nur .NET 3.5 installieren
[Sub_Install_Win11]
Sub_Set_SXS_Path
DosInAnIcon_InstallNetFx35 winst /SysNative
Sub_HandleExitCode

[Sub_Set_SXS_Path]
; Sequentielle ifs: letzter passender Treffer gewinnt (hoechste Version)
Set $PackagePath$ = $BasePath$ + "\sxs\" + $MSVersion$ + "\" + $Arch$
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($ReleaseID$, ">=", "1903")
  Set $PackagePath$ = $BasePath$ + "\sxs\" + $MSVersion$ + "\1903\" + $Arch$
endif
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($ReleaseID$, ">=", "2004")
  Set $PackagePath$ = $BasePath$ + "\sxs\" + $MSVersion$ + "\2004\" + $Arch$
endif
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($ReleaseID$, ">=", "2009")
  Set $PackagePath$ = $BasePath$ + "\sxs\" + $MSVersion$ + "\2009\" + $Arch$
endif
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($ReleaseIDWin11$, ">=", "22621")
  Set $PackagePath$ = $BasePath$ + "\sxs\" + $MSVersion$ + "\22621\" + $Arch$
endif
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($ReleaseIDWin11$, ">=", "26100")
  Set $PackagePath$ = $BasePath$ + "\sxs\" + $MSVersion$ + "\26100\" + $Arch$
endif


[Sub_InstallNetFx48]
if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($MSVersion$, "=", "10.0") and CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($ReleaseID$, "<", "1903"))
  ; KB4019990 (D3D-Update) ist Voraussetzung fuer .NET 4.8 auf Windows 10 < 1903
  WinBatch_d3dUpdate
  ; .NET Framework 4.8 auf Windows 10 < 1903 installieren
  WinBatch_SetupNetFx48
  ; Fallback auf 4.5.2 wenn KB2119355 fehlt (Exitcode 5100)
  if (GetLastExitCode = "5100")
    WinBatch_SetupNetFx452
    Sub_HandleExitCode
  else
    WinBatch_SetupNetFx48LP
    Sub_HandleExitCode
  endif
endif

[DosInAnIcon_InstallNetFx35]
DISM /Online /Enable-Feature /FeatureName:NetFx3 /All /LimitAccess /Source:$PackagePath$ /NoRestart

[DosInAnIcon_AddNetFx35Win101809]
DISM /Online /add-package /packagepath:$PackagePath$ /IgnoreCheck /NoRestart

; Fallback: .NET Framework 4.5.2 for systems missing KB2119355 (required by 4.8)
[WinBatch_SetupNetFx452]
"%ScriptPath%\data\NDP452-KB2901907-x86-x64-AllOS-ENU.exe" /norestart /passive

[WinBatch_d3dUpdate]
wusa "%ScriptPath%\data\Windows6.1-KB4019990-$Arch$.msu" /quiet /norestart

[WinBatch_SetupNetFx48]
"%ScriptPath%\data\ndp48-x86-x64-allos-enu.exe" /norestart /passive

[WinBatch_SetupNetFx48LP]
"%ScriptPath%\data\ndp48-x86-x64-allos-deu.exe" /norestart /passive

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Initial]

Message "Installiere IServ-Registry-Patch für Microsoft Windows..."

[Actions]

include_insert "%ScriptDrive%\tools\scripts\report-error-init.inc.ins"
Sub_Prepare
Sub_Install_Windows

[Sub_Prepare]
Set $MSVersion$ = GetMsVersionInfo
Set $BuildNumber$ = GetValue("build_number", GetMsVersionMap)
Set $WinVersion$ = ""

; Windows 11 Detection (Windows 10 mit Build >= 22000)
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($MSVersion$, "=", "10.0") and CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($BuildNumber$, ">=", "22000")
  Set $WinVersion$ = "11.0"
else
  Set $WinVersion$ = $MSVersion$
endif

[Sub_Install_Windows]
Switch $WinVersion$
  Case "10.0"
    Sub_Install_Windows_10
  EndCase
  Case "11.0"
    Sub_Install_Windows_11
  EndCase
  DefaultCase
    Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", "Unsupported OS version detected: " + $WinVersion$ + ". Only Windows 10 and Windows 11 are supported. Installation aborted.")
    Sub_ReportError
    LogError "Fatal: Unsupported OS version detected."
    IsFatalError
  EndCase
EndSwitch

[Sub_Install_Windows_10]
Set $RegFile$ = "win10.reg"
Message "Installiere IServ-Registry-Patch für Windows 10..."
Sub_Install_Windows_1011

[Sub_Install_Windows_11]
Set $RegFile$ = "win11.reg"
Message "Installiere IServ-Registry-Patch für Windows 11..."
Sub_Install_Windows_1011

[Sub_Install_Windows_1011]

Sub_Set_Background
Sub_Set_Startmenu

Sub_Set_Copilot
Sub_Set_Recall
Sub_Set_Widgets

  Registry_LockScreen_Off
Else
  Registry_LockScreen_On
EndIf

[Sub_Set_Background]

  Sub_Set_Background_Path
  Sub_Set_Display_Style
  Sub_Set_Change_Background
else
  Sub_Unset_Change_Background
endif

[Sub_Set_Background_Path]
Set $BGPath$ = GetProductProperty("custombackground", "")

if $BGPath$ = ""
  Set $BGPath$ = "C:\Windows\Web\Wallpaper\Windows\img0.jpg"
else                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      if not(contains($BGPath$, ".png") OR contains($BGPath$, ".jpg") OR contains($BGPath$, ".bmp"))
    Set $BGPath$ = "C:\Windows\Web\Wallpaper\Windows\img0.jpg"                                                                                                                                                                                                                            endif
endif                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           if not(FileExists("\\iserv\appdata\iserv-windows-regpatch\" + $BGPath$))
  Set $BGPath$ = "C:\Windows\Web\Wallpaper\Windows\img0.jpg"
else
  Set $BGPath$ = "\\iserv\appdata\iserv-windows-regpatch\" + $BGPath$
endif

[Sub_Set_Display_Style]
Switch GetProductProperty("displaystyle", "Zentriert")
  Case "Zentriert"
    Set $DisplayStyle$ = "0"
  EndCase
  Case "Nebeneinander"
    Set $DisplayStyle$ = "1"
  EndCase
  Case "Gestreckt"
    Set $DisplayStyle$ = "2"
  EndCase
  Case "Angepasst"
    Set $DisplayStyle$ = "3"
  EndCase
  Case "Ausgefüllt"
    Set $DisplayStyle$ = "4"
  EndCase
  Case "Übergreifend"
    Set $DisplayStyle$ = "5"
  EndCase
EndSwitch

[Registry_LockScreen_Off]

[DosInAnIcon_SetDefaultUserPermissions]
icacls C:\Users\Default /Q /C /T /remove:g BUILTIN\Users

[WinBatch_FixPermissions]
; The NetworkLocationWizard has broken permissions by default. regedit seems to
; ignore this, but reg import will exit with an error code when it encounters
; this key, so we have to fix these permissions ourselves first.
; SYSTEM: S-1-5-18
; Administrators: S-1-5-32-544
"%ScriptPath%\setacl.exe" -on "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Network\NetworkLocationWizard" -ot reg -actn ace -ace "n:S-1-5-18;p:full" -ace "n:S-1-5-32-544;p:full"

[Registry_FixNetlogon]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\NetworkProvider\HardenedPaths]
; Mit der Veröffentlichung von MS15-011 und MS15-014 treten Probleme mit der Domänenanmeldung auf.
; http://blogs.technet.com/b/askpfeplat/archive/2015/02/23/guidance-on-deployment-of-ms15-011-and-ms15-014.aspx
; Es müssen \\iserv und \\%opsiServer% angegeben werden, da einmal so und einmal so auf das Verzeichnis zugegriffen wird.
Set "\\iserv\netlogon"=REG_SZ:"RequireMutualAuthentication=0,RequireIntegrity=0"
Set "\\%opsiServer%\netlogon"=REG_SZ:"RequireMutualAuthentication=0,RequireIntegrity=0"

[DosInAnIcon_RegImport]
reg import "%ScriptPath%\netlogon\$RegFile$"

[ExecWith_EnableMicrosoftUpdate]
; https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/aa826676(v=vs.85).aspx
Set ServiceManager = CreateObject("Microsoft.Update.ServiceManager")
ServiceManager.ClientApplicationID = "My App"
Set NewUpdaTeService = ServiceManager.AddService2("7971f918-a847-4430-9279-4a52d1efe18d",7,"")

[Sub_UninstallSmb1Task]
DosInAnIcon_RemovePreviousTask winst /SysNative
DosInAnIcon_RemoveSmb1
Sub_HandleExitCode

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%Systemroot%\iserv-windows-activate-smb1\"

[DosInAnIcon_RemovePreviousTask]
schtasks /Delete /TN "IServ Windows SMB1 aktivieren" /F

[DosInAnIcon_RemoveSmb1]
powershell -command "Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol"
powershell -command "Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol-Server"

[DosInAnIcon_Firewall]
call "%ScriptPath%\netlogon\firewall.bat"

PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/hein-moeller-schule-winfact-2016/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere WinFACT 2016...
DefVar $ExitCode$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "WinFACT 2016"
Files_Copy
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_Linkfolder
Files_Cleanup

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\setup.exe" /sp- /silent /norestart /suppressmsgboxes /nocancel

[Sub_Linkfolder]
Linkfolder_Cleanup
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[Linkfolder_Cleanup]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Blockorientierte Simulation BORIS"

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Blockorientierte Simulation BORIS"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Kahlert\WinFACT 9\Boris.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Kahlert\WinFACT 9\"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Blockorientierte Simulation BORIS"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

################################################################################
ENDE: hein-moeller-schule-winfact-2016/install.ins
################################################################################

################################################################################
PAKET: helbling-musix-1
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/helbling-musix-1/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Helbling MusiX 1 (ab 2011)...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $ProductKey$
DefVar $ActiveSetupVersion$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Helbling MusiX 1 (ab 2011)"
Sub_ValidateConfig
Sub_Setup
XMLPatch_License "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\MusiX 1\license.xml"
Sub_Activ_Setup
LinkFolder_Setup
ExitWindows /RebootWanted

[Sub_ValidateConfig]
Set $ProductKey$ = GetProductProperty("licence", "")
if ($ProductKey$ = "")
  LogError "Fatal! No product key found!"
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_Setup]
; Expanding with PowerShell                          
; File extract with -x buggy
PowerShellCall('Expand-Archive -Force -LiteralPath "%ScriptPath%\data\MusiX1.zip" -DestinationPath "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\MusiX 1"')

[Sub_Activ_Setup]
; disable update messeage on first start with active setup
Set $ActiveSetupVersion$ = "1"
if RegKeyExists("HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\Helbling MusiX 1","Version")
  Set $ActiveSetupVersion$ = GetRegistryStringValueSysnative("[HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\Helbling MusiX 1] "+"Version")
  Set $ActiveSetupVersion$ = calculate($ActiveSetupVersion$+"+1")
endif
Registry_ActiveSetup /SysNative

[Registry_ActiveSetup]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\Helbling MusiX 1]
; %AppData% needed for userprofile - #24163 Note20
set "StubPath"='cmd /c xcopy /Y /I "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\MusiX 1\license.xml" "%AppData%\MusiX1\Local Store\"'
Set "Version"="$ActiveSetupVersion$"

[XMLPatch_License]
- warning_when_no_node_existing false
- create_when_node_not_existing false
openNodeSet 'licenseKey'
SetText "$ProductKey$"

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Helbling"
set_link
  name: "MusiX 1"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\MusiX 1\MusiX 1.exe"
end_link

################################################################################
ENDE: helbling-musix-1/install.ins
################################################################################


################################################################################
PAKET: helbling-musix-1
DATEI: remove.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/helbling-musix-1/remove.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere Helbling MusiX 1 (ab 2011)...
DefVar $ExitCode$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Helbling MusiX 1 (ab 2011)"
Files_Cleanup
LinkFolder_Setup
ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\MusiX 1\"

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Helbling"
delete_element "MusiX 1"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Helbling"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If


################################################################################
ENDE: helbling-musix-1/remove.ins
################################################################################

PAKET: helbling-playway-3
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/helbling-playway-3/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Klett Playway 3 Digitale Toolbox Schullizenz...
DefVar $Date$
DefStringList $DateList$
DefVar $DateTime$
DefStringList $DateTimeList$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $LicensePath$
DefStringList $LicenseXML$
DefVar $RemoteAppData$
DefVar $Time$
DefVar $Hostname$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Klett Playway 3 Digitale Toolbox Schullizenz"
Files_Copy
Sub_License
Sub_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Files_CopyLicense
DosInAnIcon_FixPerms
Sub_FixFiles
Sub_HandleExitCode
Registry_Setup /SysNative
Sub_LinkFolder
Files_Cleanup

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Sub_License]
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))
Set $LicensePath$ = "\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\licenses\helbling-playway-3"
Set $RemoteAppData$ = "\\" + $Hostname$ + "\windows\Remote.V2\AppData"
if not(FileExists($LicensePath$+ "\license.xml"))
  LogError "No license file found!"
  isFatalError
endif

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[Files_CopyLicense]
copy -se "$LicensePath$\*" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Playway 3\"

[Sub_Setup]
; Expanding with PowerShell
; File extract with -x buggy
PowerShellCall('Expand-Archive -Force -LiteralPath "%ScriptPath%\data\Playway3.zip" -DestinationPath "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Playway 3"')

[DosInAnIcon_FixPerms]
icacls "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Playway 3" /grant "*S-1-1-0:(OI)(CI)F" /t

[Sub_FixFiles]
Sub_GetTime
Sub_FixMedia
Sub_HandleExitCode

[Sub_GetTime]
Set $LicenseXML$ = getReturnListFromSection("XMLPatch_CheckTime " + "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Playway 3\license.xml")
Set $DateTime$ = TakeString(0, $LicenseXML$)
Set $DateTimeList$ = splitString($DateTime$, ";")
Set $Time$ = TakeString(0, $DateTimeList$)
Set $Date$ = TakeString(1, $DateTimeList$)
Set $DateList$ = splitString($Date$, ".")
Set $Date$ = TakeString(2, $DateList$) + "-" + TakeString(1, $DateList$) + "-" + TakeString(0, $DateList$)

[XMLPatch_CheckTime]
OpenNodeSet

  documentroot
  all_childelements_with:
    elementname:"windows"
    all_childelements_with:
      elementname:"checkTime"
end
return text

[Sub_FixMedia]
PowerShellCall('(Get-Item "C:\Program Files (x86)\Playway 3\globalmedia\media.xml").LastWriteTime = "'+$Date$+' '+$Time$+'"')

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Registry_Setup]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Klett Playway 3]
Set "DisplayName" = REG_SZ:"Klett Playway 3"
Set "DisplayVersion" = REG_SZ:"3"
Set "DisplayIcon" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Playway 3\Playway 3 Digitale Toolbox Schullizenz.exe"
Set "Publisher" = REG_SZ:"Helbling"
Set "UninstallString" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Playway 3\Playway 3 Digitale Toolbox Schullizenz.exe"

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Setup

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Helbling"
set_link
  name: "Playway 3"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Playway 3\Playway 3 Digitale Toolbox Schullizenz.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Playway 3"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Playway 3\Playway 3 Digitale Toolbox Schullizenz.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Playway 3"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

################################################################################
ENDE: helbling-playway-3/install.ins
################################################################################

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\FLACI"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[Initial]
Encoding=UTF-8
Message=Installiere IServ Desktopverknüpfungen anlegen...
DefStringList $LinkList$
DefStringList $LnkList$
DefStringList $SelectedList$
DefStringList $UrlList$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Hostname$
DefVar $LinkName$
DefVar $SelectedLink$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "IServ Desktopverknüpfungen anlegen"
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_Setup
Files_CopyIcons

[Sub_Setup]
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))
Set $LinkList$ = shellCall('dir "\\'+$Hostname$+'\appdata\%installingProdName%\links"')
Set $UrlList$ = getListContaining($LinkList$, ".url")
Set $LnkList$ = getListContaining($LinkList$, ".lnk")
Set $LinkList$ = addListToList($UrlList$, $LnkList$)
if not(GetProductProperty("selected", "") = "")
  Set $SelectedList$ = splitString(GetProductProperty("selected", ""), "|")
endif
if not(count($LinkList$) = "0")  
  for $link$ in $LinkList$ do Sub_RecordLink
endif

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[Sub_RecordLink]
Set $LinkName$ = TakeString(3, splitStringOnWhiteSpace('$link$'))
if not(count($SelectedList$) = "0")
  for $selected$ in $SelectedList$ do Sub_CheckLink
else
  Files_CopyLink
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  SetLogLevel=5
  PatchTextFile_AddLink "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\IServ\lists\linklist.txt"
  SetLogLevel=7
endif

[Sub_CheckLink]
Set $SelectedLink$ = '$selected$'
if stringReplace($LinkName$, ".lnk", "") = $SelectedLink$ OR stringReplace($LinkName$, ".url", "") = $SelectedLink$
  Files_CopyLink
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  SetLogLevel=5
  PatchTextFile_AddLink "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\IServ\lists\linklist.txt"
  SetLogLevel=7
endif

[PatchTextFile_AddLink]
AddLine "$LinkName$"

[Files_CopyLink]
copy "\\$Hostname$\appdata\%installingProdName%\links\$LinkName$" "%CommonDesktopDir%\"

[Files_CopyIcons]
copy -s "\\$Hostname$\appdata\%installingProdName%\*" "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\IServ\icons\"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

  Set $LinkList$ = loadTextFile("%ProgramFiles64Dir%\IServ\lists\linklist.txt")
  if not(count($LinkList$) = "0")
    for $link$ in $LinkList$ do Sub_LinkCleanup
    Files_CleanupList
  endif
endif

Set $LinkName$ = '$link$'
if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\"+$LinkName$)
  Files_RemoveLink
  Sub_HandleExitCodeUninst
endif

[Sub_HandleExitCodeUninst]

if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

delete -s "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\IServ\icons\*"

[Files_RemoveLink]

PAKET: iserv-enable-wol
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/iserv-enable-wol/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Aktiviere Wake-On-Lan...
DefStringList $result$
DefVar $RegistryKey$
DefVar $testName$
encoding=utf8

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Wake-On-LAN"
comment "Set Wake-on-LAN settings"
Set $result$ = getRegistryKeyListSysnative("HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4D36E972-E325-11CE-BFC1-08002bE10318}")
for $value$ in $result$ do Sub_network_wake_on_lan
Registry_ImproveWOL

[Sub_network_wake_on_lan]
set $RegistryKey$ = "[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4D36E972-E325-11CE-BFC1-08002bE10318}\" + "$value$" + "]"
Set $testName$ = GetRegistryStringValueSysNative($RegistryKey$ + "DriverDesc")
if contains($testName$,"82579")
   Registry_install_Intel_82579
endif
if contains($testName$,"82574")
   Registry_install_Intel_82574
endif
if contains($testName$, "82567")
  Registry_install_Intel_82567
endif
if (contains($testName$,"I217") or contains($testName$,"I210"))
   Registry_install_Intel_217
endif
if contains($testName$,"I354")
   Registry_install_Intel_354
endif
if contains($testName$,"82566")
   Registry_install_Intel_82566
endif
if contains($testName$,"nForce")
   Registry_install_Nvidia_nForce
endif
if (contains($testName$,"AR8121") or contains($testName$,"AR8113") or contains($testName$,"AR8114") or contains($testName$,"AR8131"))
   Registry_install_Atheros_AR8121
endif
if contains($testName$,"Realtek PCIe")
   Registry_install_Realtek_PCIe
endif

[Registry_ImproveWOL]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NDIS\Parameters]
set "AllowWakeFromS5" = REG_DWORD:00000001

[Registry_install_Intel_354]
openkey $RegistryKey$
set "EnablePME" = "1"
set "*WakeOnMagicPacket"="1"
set "*WakeOnPattern"="1"

[Registry_install_Intel_217]
openkey $RegistryKey$
set "EnablePME" = "1"
set "*WakeOnMagicPacket"="1"
set "*WakeOnPattern"="1"

[Registry_install_Intel_82579]
openkey $RegistryKey$
set "EnablePME" = "1"
set "WakeOn"="118"

[Registry_install_Intel_82567]
openkey $RegistryKey$
set "EnablePME" = "1"
set "*WakeOnMagicPacket"="1"
set "*WakeOnPattern"="1"

[Registry_install_Intel_82574]
openkey $RegistryKey$
set "EnablePME" = "1"
set "WakeOn"="118"
;set "WakeOnSlot" = "0"
;set "EnableWakeOnManagmentOnTCO" = "0"

[Registry_install_Intel_82566]
openkey $RegistryKey$
set "EnablePME" = "1"
set "WakeOn"="118"

[Registry_install_Nvidia_nForce]
openkey $RegistryKey$
set "EthWOLFromPowerOff" = "1"
set "WakeUpMagic" = "1"
set "WakeUpPattern" = "1"

[Registry_install_Atheros_AR8121]
openkey $RegistryKey$
set "ShutdownWake" = "1"
set "WakeUpCapability" = "6"
; Needed for windows 7?
set "WakeUpCapabilities" = "3"
set "PnPCapabilities" = REG_DWORD:280

[Registry_install_Realtek_PCIe]
openkey $RegistryKey$
set "S5WakeOnLan" = "1"
set "WolCap" = "3"
set "PnPCapabilities" = REG_DWORD:288

[Initial]
Encoding=UTF-8
Message=Installiere IServ Microsoft Office Bereinigungstool aus...

[Actions]

[Sub_Setup]
Set $OfficeVersion$ = getProductProperty("office", "")

Switch $OfficeVersion$
  Case ""
    set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", "Es wurde keine Office-Version gesetzt. Bitte setzen Sie die Office-Version und installieren Sie dieses Paket dann erneut.")
    Sub_ReportError
    LogError "Fatal: no office version found. Please set the office version and install again."
    IsFatalError
  EndCase
  Case "Office 2019"
    Sub_CheckFolder
    Sub_Uninstall2019
    Sub_DeleteFiles
  EndCase
  Case "Office 2021"
    Sub_CheckFolder
    Sub_Uninstall2021
    Sub_DeleteFiles
  EndCase
  Case "Office 2024"
    Sub_CheckFolder
    Sub_Uninstall2024
    Sub_DeleteFiles
  EndCase
  Case "Alle"
    Sub_CheckFolder
    Sub_Uninstall2019
    Sub_Uninstall2021
    Sub_Uninstall2024
    Sub_DeleteFiles
  EndCase
EndSwitch

[Sub_CheckFolder]
if FileExists("%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\WINPROJ.EXE") OR FileExists("%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\WINPROJ.EXE") OR FileExists("%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\VISIO.EXE") OR FileExists("%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\VISIO.EXE")
  set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", "Das Bereinigungstool hat entdeckt, dass Microsoft Projekt oder Microsoft Visio installiert ist. Bitte deinstallieren Sie diese Pakete und installieren Sie dieses Paket dann erneut.")
  Sub_ReportError
  LogError "Fatal: found project or visio, please remove them before reinstalling!"
  IsFatalError
