################################################################################
PAKET: iserv-rejoin-domain
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/iserv-rejoin-domain/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Encoding=UTF-8
Message=Installiere IServ Windows-Domänenmitgliedschaft erneuern...
DefStringList $ParamList$
DefVar $Force$
DefVar $IsJoined$
DefVar $IServDomain$
DefVar $LocalDomain$
DefVar $MaxLength$
DefVar $NameLength$
DefVar $NewName$
DefVar $PcPatchPassword$
DefVar $RebootFlag$

[Actions]
Message "Prüfe Voraussetzungen zum Betreten der Domäne..."
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "IServ Windows-Domänenmitgliedschaft erneuern"
Files_Copy
include_insert "%SystemDrive%\tmp\rejoindomain\report-error-init.inc.ins"
Sub_Setup

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\add\*" "%SystemDrive%\tmp\rejoindomain"

[Sub_Setup]
Sub_GetIsJoined
if ($IsJoined$ = "true")
  Sub_GetIServDomain
  Sub_GetLocalDomain
  if ($LocalDomain$ = $IServDomain$ and GetProductProperty("force", "false") = "false")
    ; The package was assigned to a computer that doesn't need to rejoin
    ; the domain. We'll source any rejoindomain log that we can find, just in
    ; case.
    Message "Computer ist bereits in der Domäne "+$IServDomain$+"!"
    if (FileExists("%SystemDrive%\tmp\rejoindomain\instlog.log"))
      includelog "%SystemDrive%\tmp\rejoindomain\instlog.log"
    endif
  else
    ; We're in the wrong domain; leave it.
    Message "Verlasse die alte Domäne "+$LocalDomain$+"..."
    DosInAnIcon_LeaveDomain
    ; Schedule reinstallation so we can rejoin the domain after the reboot.
    opsiservicecall_Reinstall
    ; This piece of sh*t software waits 5 minutes for the reboot even when no
    ; user is logged in. On the other hand, we _must_ exit the script with
    ; "ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot" or else it would overwrite the reinstall
    ; command that we've just sent. This hack speeds up the reboot by launching
    ; an asynchronous shutdown process that reboots after 10 seconds.
    WinBatch_TimedReboot /LetThemGo
    ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot
  endif
else
  Sub_Rename
  ; We can't join the domain while opsi is running. Trying to do that would
  ; result in error 1219 "The credentials supplied conflict with an existing
  ; set of credentials". To solve this, we start a separate winst process
  ; (practically a fork) that executes a local copy of this script, waits for
  ; 10 seconds, and then joins the domain.

  ; determine if we have forked
  Set $ParamList$ = SplitString(ParamStr, " ")
  if (TakeString(0, $ParamList$) = "forked")
    ; We're in the fork; join the domain.
    Set $IServDomain$ = TakeString(1, $ParamList$)
    SetLogLevel=4
    Set $PcPatchPassword$ = TakeString(2, $ParamList$)
    SetConfidential $PcPatchPassword$
    SetLogLevel=7
    Message "Warten vor dem Betreten der Domäne "+$IServDomain$"+..."
    sleepSeconds 10
    Message "Betrete Domäne "+$IServDomain$+"..."
    DosInAnIcon_JoinDomain
    Files_Cleanup
    ; The forked winst instance can't reboot with ExitWindows because that
    ; requires opsiclientd.
    DosBatch_Reboot
  else
    ; We haven't forked yet.
    ; The domain name and pcpatch password have to be supplied to the fork
    ; because it can't talk to the backend.
    Sub_GetIServDomain
    Sub_GetPcPatchPassword
    ; Domain join resets some settings from registry patch, so apply again
    opsiservicecall_ReinstallRegistryPatch
    Message "Bereite das Betreten der Domäne "+$IServDomain$+" vor..."
    ; Now fork and exit...
    Files_Fork
    WinBatch_Fork /LetThemGo
  endif
endif

[Sub_GetIServDomain]
Set $IServDomain$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetIServRealm"))))
if ($IServDomain$ = "")
  Set $IServDomain$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetIServWorkgroup"))))
endif

[Sub_GetLocalDomain]
Set $LocalDomain$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(4, GetOutStreamFromSection("DosInAnIcon_GetLocalDomain"))))

[Sub_GetIsJoined]
Set $IsJoined$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(4, GetOutStreamFromSection("DosInAnIcon_GetIsJoined"))))

[Sub_GetPcPatchPassword]
SetLogLevel=4
Set $PcPatchPassword$ = Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetPcPatchPassword")))
SetConfidential $PcPatchPassword$
SetLogLevel=6

[DosInAnIcon_GetLocalDomain]
wmic /interactive:off computersystem get domain

[DosInAnIcon_GetIsJoined]
wmic /interactive:off computersystem get partofdomain

[DosInAnIcon_LeaveDomain]
wmic /interactive:off computersystem where name!=null call UnjoinDomainOrWorkgroup

[DosInAnIcon_JoinDomain]
wmic /interactive:off computersystem where name!=null call JoinDomainOrWorkgroup "",3,"$IServDomain$","$PcPatchPassword$","$IServDomain$\pcpatch"

[DosBatch_Reboot]
shutdown -r -t 0 -f

[WinBatch_TimedReboot]
"%System%\shutdown.exe" -r -t 10 -f

[Sub_Rename]
Set $RebootFlag$ = ""
if RegKeyExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%")
  Set $RebootFlag$ = getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%", "RebootFlag")
endif

Set $NewName$ = GetProductProperty("newname", "")

if not($RebootFlag$ = "1")
  if GetProductProperty("rename", "False") = "True" AND not($NewName$ = "")
    Set $MaxLength$ = "15.0"
    Set $NameLength$ = strLength($NewName$) + ".0"
    if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($NameLength$, ">", $MaxLength$)
      ; checks if the name has more than 15 characters
      Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", "Der neue Computername darf maximal 15 Zeichen enthalten.")
      Sub_ReportError
      LogError "Fatal: The new computer name may only contain up to 15 characters!"
      IsFatalError
    endif
    if strPos($NewName$, "-") = "1" OR isRegexMatch(strPart($NewName$, "1", "1"), "[\d]")
      ; strpos checks if there is a '-' at the first position
      ; strPart only looks at the first character
      ; \d filters for only digits
      Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", "Der neue Computername muss mit einem Buchstaben beginnen.")
      Sub_ReportError
      LogError "Fatal: The new computer name must begin with a letter!"
      IsFatalError
    endif
    if strPart($NewName$, $NameLength$, "1") = "-"
      ; strpart looks at the end of the name (at the end of the string)
      ; and checks if it is a '-'
      Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", "Der neue Computername darf nicht mit einem '-' enden.")
      Sub_ReportError
      LogError "Fatal: The new computer name may not end with '-'!"
      IsFatalError
    endif
    if isRegexMatch($NewName$, "[^-\w]+")
      ; uses regex to check if there are any characters that are not '-' or any a-z, A-Z or 0-9
      Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", "Der neue Computername darf nur Buchstaben, Ziffern und '-' enthalten.")
      Sub_ReportError
      LogError "Fatal: The new computer name must only contain valid characters!"
      IsFatalError
    endif
    PowerShellCall('Rename-Computer -NewName "'+$NewName$+'"')
    Set $RebootFlag$ = "1"
    Registry_SaveRebootFlag /SysNative
    opsiservicecall_Reinstall
    ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot
  endif
endif

Registry_RemoveBootFlag /SysNative

[Registry_SaveRebootFlag]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]
Set "RebootFlag" = REG_SZ:"$RebootFlag$"

[Registry_RemoveBootFlag]
DeleteKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]

[Files_Fork]
copy "%ScriptPath%\install.ins" "%SystemDrive%\tmp\rejoindomain"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -s "%SystemDrive%\tmp\rejoindomain\*.ins"

[WinBatch_Fork]
"%ProgramFilesDir%\opsi.org\opsi-client-agent\opsi-winst\winst32.exe" "%Systemdrive%\tmp\rejoindomain\install.ins" /logfile "%Systemdrive%\tmp\rejoindomain\instlog.log" /batch /parameter "forked $IServDomain$ $PcPatchPassword$"

[opsiservicecall_GetIServWorkgroup]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Workgroup"
]

[opsiservicecall_GetIServRealm]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "WindowsADRealm"
]

[opsiservicecall_GetPcPatchPassword]
"method":"iserv_pcpatch_password"
"params":[]

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "setup"
]

[opsiservicecall_ReinstallRegistryPatch]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "iserv-windows-regpatch",
  "",
  "setup"
]

; Copyright (c) uib gmbh (www.uib.de)
; This sourcecode is owned by uib
; and published under the Terms of the General Public License.
; credits: http://www.opsi.org/credits/

[Initial]
requiredWinstVersion >= "4.11.1.1"
Encoding=UTF-8
Message=Installiere IServ Windows-Aktivierung...
DefVar $EditionID$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $LicenseKey$
DefVar $MSVersion$
DefVar $Tried$
DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
; ----------------------------------------------------------------
; see:
; http://technet.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ff793433.aspx
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "IServ Windows-Aktivierung"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub_Do

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "10.0") < "0")
  LogError "Fatal: Setup is for Windows 10 and above!"
  isFatalError
endif

Set $LicenseKey$ = ""
Set $Tried$ = "0"
Set $Version$ = GetValue("packageversion", GetProductMap)

if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "10.0") = "0")
 ; Windows 11 lies and tells us, that it is Windows 10
  Set $EditionID$ = GetRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion", "EditionID")
  if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetValue("build_number", GetMsVersionMap), ">=", "22000")
    ; Windows 11
    if ($EditionID$ = "Professional")
      Set $LicenseKey$ = GetProductProperty("licensekey_win11", "")
    else 
      if ($EditionID$ = "Education")
        Set $LicenseKey$ = GetProductProperty("licensekey_win11_edu", "")
      else 
        if ($EditionID$ = "ProfessionalEducation")
          Set $LicenseKey$ = GetProductProperty("licensekey_win11_proedu", "")
        endif
      endif
    endif

    comment "Use Windows 11 license key"
  else
    ; Windows 10
    if not(GetProductProperty("licensekey_win10_esu", "") = "")
      Set $LicenseKey$ = GetProductProperty("licensekey_win10_esu", "")
    else
      Set $EditionID$ = GetRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion", "EditionID")
      if ($EditionID$ = "Professional")
        Set $LicenseKey$ = GetProductProperty("licensekey_win10", "")
      else 
        if ($EditionID$ = "Education")
          Set $LicenseKey$ = GetProductProperty("licensekey_win10_edu", "")
        else 
          if ($EditionID$ = "ProfessionalEducation")
            Set $LicenseKey$ = GetProductProperty("licensekey_win10_proedu", "")
          endif
        endif
      endif
    endif

    comment "Use Windows 10 license key"
  endif
endif

if ($LicenseKey$ = "" and CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, ">=", "6.2"))
  Set $LicenseKey$ = TakeString("0", GetOutStreamFromSection("DosInAnIcon_GetBIOSKey"))
endif

if ($LicenseKey$ = "" or $LicenseKey$ = "[ERR] - ACPI table MSDM not found on this system")
  LogError "Could not find license key from properties or from BIOS or the operating system is not supported."
  isFatalError
EndIf

comment " use key "+$LicenseKey$

[Sub_Do]
comment "Check Status"
DosInAnIcon_status winst /sysnative

comment "Set the Key"
DosInAnIcon_set_key winst /sysnative

comment "Check Status"
DosInAnIcon_status winst /sysnative

comment "Start Activation"
Sub_Activation

comment "Check Status"
DosInAnIcon_status winst /sysnative

; check result
Sub_Check
Files_CopyIcon
Registry_Setup /SysNative

[DosInAnIcon_GetBIOSKey]
@echo off
"%ScriptPath%\data\add\get_win8key.exe"

[Sub_Activation]
if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "10.0") = "0")
  DosInAnIcon_changepk winst /sysnative
endif
DosInAnIcon_activate winst /sysnative
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
; Acitivation in progress - retry
if ($ExitCode$ = "-1073422296")
  Set $Tried$ = calculate($Tried$+"+1")
  if ($Tried$ > "10")
    LogWarning "Retried activation for ten times - giving up"
  else
    SleepSeconds 10
    Sub_Activation
  endif
endif

[DosInAnIcon_set_key]
cscript //b c:\windows\system32\slmgr.vbs /ipk $LicenseKey$

[DosInAnIcon_changepk]
changepk /productkey $LicenseKey$

[DosInAnIcon_activate]
cscript //b c:\windows\system32\slmgr.vbs /ato

[DosInAnIcon_status]
cscript c:\windows\system32\slmgr.vbs /dli

[Sub_Check]
; check return code
Files_Copy
Set $ExitCode$ = TakeString(0, GetOutStreamFromSection('DosInAnIcon_Check'))
Files_Delete
comment "Check exit code: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: activation failed"
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Copy]
; copying the file to another location disables its localization, so we can
; parse the English output reliably
copy "%System%\slmgr.vbs" "%Systemdrive%\tmp"

[DosInAnIcon_Check]
@echo off
cscript %Systemdrive%\tmp\slmgr.vbs /dli | findstr /R /C:"^License Status: Licensed" >nul
echo %ERRORLEVEL%

[Files_CopyIcon]
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\add\iserv.ico" "%Systemroot%\IServ\images\%installingProdName%\"

[Registry_Setup]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\IServ Windows-Aktivierung]
Set "DisplayName" = REG_SZ:"IServ Windows-Aktivierung"
Set "DisplayVersion" = REG_SZ:"$Version$"
Set "DisplayIcon" = REG_SZ:"%Systemroot%\IServ\images\iserv.ico"
Set "Publisher" = REG_SZ:"IServ GmbH"
Set "UninstallString" = REG_SZ:"IServ"
Set "NoRemove" = REG_DWORD:1
Set "NoModify" = REG_DWORD:1

[Files_Delete]
delete "%Systemdrive%\tmp\slmgr.vbs"

################################################################################
PAKET: iserv-windows-activation
DATEI: remove.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/iserv-windows-activation/remove.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]

[Initial]
Message=Installiere IServ Windows Batch...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $FileName$
DefVar $Hostname$
DefVar $KeyPath$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "IServ Batch"
Sub_PrepInstall
Files_Copy
WinBatch_CheckFile
Sub_HandleExitCodeCheckFile
DosInAnIcon_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
ExitWindows /Reboot

[Sub_PrepInstall]
Set $FileName$ = GetProductProperty("filename", "start")
if ($FileName$ = "")
    Set $FileName$ = "start"
endif
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))
Set $KeyPath$ = "\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\%installingProdName%\"
if not(FileExists($KeyPath$+ $FileName$ + ".bat"))
    LogError "Fatal: No batch file " + $FileName$ + ".bat found."
    IsFatalError
endif

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[WinBatch_CheckFile]
"%ScriptDrive%\tools\AutoIt3.exe" "%ScriptPath%\FileContains.au3" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\$FileName$.bat" "pause"

[DosInAnIcon_Setup]
@echo off
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\$FileName$.bat"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_HandleExitCodeCheckFile]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    if ($ExitCode$ = "1")
        LogError "Your batch file contains a pause."
        IsFatalError
    else
        LogError "Fatal error while opening the batch file."
        IsFatalError
    endif
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -s "\\iserv\appdata\%installingProdName%\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

Sub_HandleExitCode

Sub_HandleExitCode

ExitWindows /Reboot

[DosInAnIcon_DisableMeta]
; Disable SMB1 meta feature
dism /Online /Disable-Feature /FeatureName:SMB1Protocol /NoRestart

[DosInAnIcon_DisableClient]
; Disable SMB1 for clients
dism /Online /Disable-Feature /FeatureName:SMB1Protocol-Client /NoRestart

[DosInAnIcon_DisableServer]
; Disable SMB1 for server
dism /Online /Disable-Feature /FeatureName:SMB1Protocol-Server /NoRestart

[DosInAnIcon_DisableDeprecation]
; Disable deprecation of SMB1
dism /Online /Disable-Feature /FeatureName:SMB1Protocol-Deprecation /NoRestart

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere IServ Windows SMBv1 deaktivieren...
DefVar $ExitCode$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "SMBv1 deaktivieren"
; in uninstall we enable SMBv1 again
DosInAnIcon_EnableMeta
Sub_HandleExitCode
DosInAnIcon_EnableServer
Sub_HandleExitCode
DosInAnIcon_DisableClient
Sub_HandleExitCode
DosInAnIcon_DisableDeprecation
Sub_HandleExitCode
ExitWindows /Reboot

[DosInAnIcon_EnableMeta]
; Enable SMB1 meta feature (required for SMB1 server)
dism /Online /Enable-Feature /FeatureName:SMB1Protocol /NoRestart

[DosInAnIcon_EnableServer]
; Enable SMB1 server (required for winexe)
dism /Online /Enable-Feature /FeatureName:SMB1Protocol-Server /NoRestart

[DosInAnIcon_DisableClient]
; Disable sub features of SMB1 which we do not need for Samba AD.
; There are enabled by the meta feature.
dism /Online /Disable-Feature /FeatureName:SMB1Protocol-Client /NoRestart

[DosInAnIcon_DisableDeprecation]
; Disable deprecation of SMB1 (enabled by the meta feature)
dism /Online /Disable-Feature /FeatureName:SMB1Protocol-Deprecation /NoRestart

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Initial]
Message=Installiere IServ Anmelde- und Sperrbildschirm anpassen...

[Actions]

Sub_Install

[Sub_Install]
if GetProductProperty("change_lockscreen", "False") = "True"
  Registry_DisallowLockScreen
Else
  Registry_AllowLockScreen
EndIf
if GetProductProperty("disable_lockscreen", "False") = "True"
  Registry_DisableLockScreen
Else
  Registry_EnableLockScreen
EndIf
if GetProductProperty("disable_camera", "False") = "True"
  Registry_DisableCamera
Else
  Registry_EnableCamera
EndIf
if GetProductProperty("disable_narrator", "False") = "True"
  Registry_DisableNarrator
Else
  Registry_EnableNarrator
EndIf

; ----------------------------------------------------------------
; 0 = enable 
; 1 = disable
; ----------------------------------------------------------------

[Registry_AllowLockScreen]
OpenKey [HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization]
Set "NoChangingLockScreen"=REG_DWORD:0
; prüfen mit leerem String:
DeleteVar "LockScreenImage"

[Registry_DisallowLockScreen]
; Disable changing lockscreen
OpenKey [HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization]
Set "NoChangingLockScreen"=REG_DWORD:1
Set "LockScreenImage"=REG_SZ:'C:\Windows\Web\Wallpaper\Windows\img0.jpg'

[Registry_EnableLockScreen]
OpenKey [HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization]
Set "NoLockScreen"=REG_DWORD:0

[Registry_DisableLockScreen]
OpenKey [HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization]
Set "NoLockScreen"=REG_DWORD:1

[Registry_EnableCamera]
OpenKey [HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization]
Set "NoLockScreenCamera"=REG_DWORD:0

[Registry_DisableCamera]
OpenKey [HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization]
Set "NoLockScreenCamera"=REG_DWORD:1

[Registry_EnableNarrator]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\narrator.exe]
Set "Debugger" = REG_SZ:"0"

[Registry_DisableNarrator]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\narrator.exe]
Set "Debugger" = REG_SZ:"1"

[Actions]
Encoding=UTF-8
Message "Installiere IServ Registry-Patch für Microsoft Windows..."
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "IServ Registry-Patch für Microsoft Windows"
DefVar $BGPath$
DefVar $DisplayStyle$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $MSVersion$
DefVar $RegFile$
DefVar $Version$

Set $MSVersion$ = GetMsVersionInfo
Set $Version$ = GetValue("packageversion", GetProductMap)

if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($MSVersion$, "=", "5.1")
  Sub_Install_Windows_XP
else
  if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($MSVersion$, "=", "6.0")
    Sub_Install_Windows_Vista
  else
    if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($MSVersion$, "=", "6.1")
      Sub_Install_Windows_7
    else
      if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($MSVersion$, "=", "6.2")
        Sub_Install_Windows_8
      else
        if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($MSVersion$, "=", "6.3")
          Sub_Install_Windows_8_1
        else
	  if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($MSVersion$, "=", "10.0")
	    ; Windows 11 lies and tells us, that it is Windows 10
	    if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetValue("build_number", GetMsVersionMap), ">=", "22000")
	      Sub_Install_Windows_11
	    else
	      Sub_Install_Windows_10
	    endif
	  else
            LogError "Unsupported OS version. No action."
          endif
        endif
      endif
    endif
  endif
endif

[Sub_Do]
if not(RegKeyExists("HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Network\NetworkLocationWizard"))
  Registry_Create_NetLocationWizard /SysNative
endif

WinBatch_FixPermissions /SysNative
Sub_HandleExitCode
DosInAnIcon_RegImport winst /SysNative
Sub_HandleExitCode
Registry_EnableMicrosoftUpdate /SysNative
Sub_HandleExitCode
DosInAnIcon_Firewall
DosInAnIcon_SetWinExetoDefenderWhitelist

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: subprocess returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_Install_Windows_XP]
Message "Installiere IServ-Registry-Patch für Windows XP..."
LogWarning "No action for Windows XP."

[Sub_Install_Windows_Vista]
Message "Installiere IServ-Registry-Patch für Windows Vista..."
LogWarning "No action for Windows Vista."

[Sub_install_Windows_7]
Set $RegFile$ = "win7.reg"
Message "Installiere IServ-Registry-Patch für Windows 7..."
Sub_Do

[Sub_Install_Windows_8]
Set $RegFile$ = "win8.reg"
Message "Installiere IServ-Registry-Patch für Windows 8..."
Sub_Do

[Sub_Install_Windows_8_1]
Set $RegFile$ = "win8.reg"
Message "Installiere IServ-Registry-Patch für Windows 8.1..."
Sub_Do

[Sub_Install_Windows_10]
Set $RegFile$ = "win10.reg"
Message "Installiere IServ-Registry-Patch für Windows 10..."
Sub_Install_Windows_1011

[Sub_Install_Windows_11]
Set $RegFile$ = "win11.reg"
Message "Installiere IServ-Registry-Patch für Windows 11..."
Sub_Check
Sub_Install_Windows_1011

[Sub_Install_Windows_1011]
if GetProductProperty("lockscreen", "False") = "True"
  Registry_LockScreen_Off
Else
  Registry_LockScreen_On
EndIf

if GetProductProperty("background", "False") = "True"
  Set $BGPath$ = GetProductProperty("custombackground", "")

  if $BGPath$ = ""
    Set $BGPath$ = "C:\Windows\Web\Wallpaper\Windows\img0.jpg"
  else
    if not(contains($BGPath$, ".png") OR contains($BGPath$, ".jpg") OR contains($BGPath$, ".bmp"))
      Set $BGPath$ = "C:\Windows\Web\Wallpaper\Windows\img0.jpg"
    endif
  endif

  if not(FileExists("\\iserv\appdata\iserv-windows-regpatch\" + $BGPath$))
    Set $BGPath$ = "C:\Windows\Web\Wallpaper\Windows\img0.jpg"
  else
    Files_CopyBG
    Set $BGPath$ = "%Systemroot%\IServ\images\" + $BGPath$
  endif

  Switch GetProductProperty("displaystyle", "Zentriert")
    Case "Zentriert"
      Set $DisplayStyle$ = "0"
    EndCase
    Case "Nebeneinander"
      Set $DisplayStyle$ = "1"
    EndCase
    Case "Gestreckt"
      Set $DisplayStyle$ = "2"
    EndCase
    Case "Angepasst"
      Set $DisplayStyle$ = "3"
    EndCase
    Case "Ausgefüllt"
      Set $DisplayStyle$ = "4"
    EndCase
    Case "Übergreifend"
      Set $DisplayStyle$ = "5"
    EndCase
  EndSwitch

  Registry_Set_Desktop_Background /AllNTUserDats
  Registry_Background_Off
else
  Registry_Background_On
  Registry_Unset_Desktop_Background /AllNTUserDats
endif

if GetProductProperty("startmenu", "False") = "True"
  Registry_Startmenu_Off
else
  Registry_Startmenu_On
endif

if GetProductProperty("hotspot", "False") = "True"
  Registry_Hotspot_Off
else
  Registry_Hotspot_On
endif

if GetProductProperty("store", "False") = "True"
  Registry_Store_Off
else
  Registry_Store_On
endif

if GetProductProperty("copilot", "False") = "True"
  Registry_Copilot_Off /AllNTUserDats
else
  Registry_Copilot_On /AllNTUserDats
endif

if GetProductProperty("recall", "False") = "True"
  Registry_Recall_Off /AllNTUserDats
else
  Registry_Recall_On /AllNTUserDats
endif

if GetProductProperty("widgets", "False") = "True"
  Registry_Widgets_Off
else
  Registry_Widgets_On
endif

Sub_Do

if GetProductProperty("quickboot", "False") = "True"
  Registry_Quickboot_On
endif

if GetProductProperty("locationservice", "False") = "True"
  Registry_Locationservice_On /SysNative
else
  Registry_Locationservice_Off /SysNative

OpenKey [HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Network\NetworkLocationWizard]
Set "HideWizard" = REG_DWORD:1

[WinBatch_FixPermissions]
; The NetworkLocationWizard has broken permissions by default. regedit seems to
; ignore this, but reg import will exit with an error code when it encounters
; this key, so we have to fix these permissions ourselves first.
; SYSTEM: S-1-5-18
; Administrators: S-1-5-32-544
"%ScriptPath%\data\add\SetACL.exe" -on "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Network\NetworkLocationWizard" -ot reg -actn ace -ace "n:S-1-5-18;p:full" -ace "n:S-1-5-32-544;p:full"

[Registry_FixNetlogon]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\NetworkProvider\HardenedPaths]
; Mit der Veröffentlichung von MS15-011 und MS15-014 treten Probleme mit der Domänenanmeldung auf.
; http://blogs.technet.com/b/askpfeplat/archive/2015/02/23/guidance-on-deployment-of-ms15-011-and-ms15-014.aspx
; Es müssen \\iserv und \\%opsiServer% angegeben werden, da einmal so und einmal so auf das Verzeichnis zugegriffen wird.
Set "\\iserv\netlogon"=REG_SZ:"RequireMutualAuthentication=0,RequireIntegrity=0"
Set "\\%opsiServer%\netlogon"=REG_SZ:"RequireMutualAuthentication=0,RequireIntegrity=0"

[DosInAnIcon_RegImport]
reg import "%ScriptPath%\netlogon\$RegFile$"

[Registry_EnableMicrosoftUpdate]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU]
Set "AllowMUUpdateService" = REG_DWORD:1

[Sub_UninstallSmb1Task]
DosInAnIcon_RemovePreviousTask winst /SysNative
DosInAnIcon_RemoveSmb1
Sub_HandleExitCode

[Files_CopyIcon]
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\add\iserv.ico" "%Systemroot%\IServ\images\"

[Registry_Setup]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\IServ RegPatch]
Set "DisplayName" = REG_SZ:"IServ Registry-Patch für Microsoft Windows"
Set "DisplayIcon" = REG_SZ:"%Systemroot%\IServ\images\iserv.ico"
Set "DisplayVersion" = REG_SZ:"$Version$"
Set "Publisher" = REG_SZ:"IServ GmbH"
Set "UninstallString" = REG_SZ:"IServ"
Set "NoRemove" = REG_DWORD:1
Set "NoModify" = REG_DWORD:1

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%Systemroot%\iserv-windows-activate-smb1\"

[DosInAnIcon_RemovePreviousTask]
schtasks /Delete /TN "IServ Windows SMB1 aktivieren" /F

[DosInAnIcon_RemoveSmb1]
powershell -command "Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol"
powershell -command "Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName SMB1Protocol-Server"

[DosInAnIcon_Firewall]
call "%ScriptPath%\netlogon\firewall.bat"

Set $JDKPath$ = getRegistryValue("HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\control\Session Manager\Environment", "Java_HOME", "sysnative")

[Sub_Install]
if GetProductProperty("teacherversion", "false") = "false"
  Set $Version$ = "-x"
endif
if FileExists($JDKPath$ + "\bin\javac.exe")
  Files_DeleteOldSettings
  Files_CopySettings
  Set $JDKPath$ = stringReplace($JDKPath$ + "bin\javac.exe", "\", "\\")
  PatchTextFile_Settings "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\.javakarasettings"
  Files_DeleteTempSettings
endif

[Files_Setup]
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\javakara$Version$.jar" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\JavaKara"
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\kara.ico" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\JavaKara"

[Files_CopySettings]
copy "%ScriptPath%\add\.javakarasettings" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%"

[Files_DeleteTempSettings]
delete -f "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%"

[Files_DeleteOldSettings]
delete -f "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\JavaKara\.javakarasettings"

[PatchTextFile_Settings]
FindLine_StartingWith "javac"
DeleteTheLine
AddLine "javac.path=$JDKPath$"
SaveToFile "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\JavaKara\.javakarasettings"

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_StartMenu

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_StartMenu]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "JavaKara"
set_link
  name: "JavaKara"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\JavaKara\javakara$Version$.jar"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\JavaKara"
  icon_file: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\JavaKara\kara.ico"
end_link

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "JavaKara"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\JavaKara\javakara$Version$.jar"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\JavaKara"
  icon_file: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\JavaKara\kara.ico"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Kara"

Sub_PatchSilentConfig
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
DosInAnIcon_Firewall
Registry_SetVersion /SysNative
LinkFolder_Setup
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Sub_PatchSilentConfig]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "False"
  PatchTextFile_SetDesktop "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\add\silent.config"
endif
if GetProductProperty("java", "True") = "True"
  PatchTextFile_SetJava "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\add\silent.config"
endif
if GetProductProperty("groovy", "True") = "True"
  PatchTextFile_SetGroovy "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\add\silent.config"
endif
if GetProductProperty("kt", "True") = "True"
  PatchTextFile_SetKt "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\add\silent.config"
endif

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\idea-$Version$.exe" /S /CONFIG="%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\add\silent.config" /D="%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\JetBrains\IntelliJ IDEA $Version$"

[PatchTextFile_SetDesktop]
FindLine_Containing "launcher64"
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine 'launcher64=0'

[PatchTextFile_SetJava]
FindLine_Containing ".java"
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine '.java=1'

[PatchTextFile_SetGroovy]
FindLine_Containing ".groovy"
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine '.groovy=1'

[PatchTextFile_SetKt]
FindLine_Containing ".kt"
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine '.kt=1'

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[DosInAnIcon_Firewall]
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="IServ JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA" dir=in action=allow program="%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\JetBrains\IntelliJ IDEA $Version$\bin\idea64.exe"

[Registry_SetVersion]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]
Set "InstalledVersion" = REG_SZ:"$Version$"

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "JetBrains"
set_link
  name: "IntelliJ IDEA $Version$"
  target: "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\JetBrains\IntelliJ IDEA $Version$\bin\idea64.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\JetBrains\IntelliJ IDEA $Version$"
end_link

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

Sub_Uninstall

[Sub_PrepareUninstall]
Set $InstVersion$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)
if RegKeyExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%")
  Set $InstVersion$ = getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%", "InstalledVersion")
endif

[Sub_Uninstall]
if FileExists("%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\JetBrains\IntelliJ IDEA " + $InstVersion$ + "\bin\Uninstall.exe")
  WinBatch_Uninstall
  Sub_HandleExitCodeUninstall
  sleepSeconds 15
  DosInAnIcon_DeleteFirewall
  Sub_LinkFolderUninst
  Sub_Registry_Cleanup
  Sub_Files_Cleanup
endif

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
"%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\JetBrains\IntelliJ IDEA $InstVersion$\bin\Uninstall.exe" /S

[Sub_HandleExitCodeUninstall]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

  LinkFolder_DeleteStartmenu
endif

set_subfolder "JetBrains"
delete_element "IntelliJ IDEA $InstVersion$"

; do not add further lines. this will always delete the link of the last installed version.

set_subfolder "JetBrains"
delete_element "IntelliJ IDEA Community Edition $InstVersion$"
; -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[Sub_Files_Cleanup]
if DirectoryExists("%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\JetBrains")
  Files_Delete
endif

[Files_Delete]
delete -sf "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\JetBrains"

[Sub_Registry_Cleanup]
if RegKeyExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%")
  Registry_Delete /SysNative
endif

[Registry_Delete]

    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif

  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\draw.io\draw.io.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "draw.io"

"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[Sub_Setup]

  WinBatch_Setup
else
  LogError "Fatal: Installer not found"
  IsFatalError
endif

"\\$Hostname$\appdata\installer\%installingProdName%\setup.exe" /verysilent

  WinBatch_SetupUMT
  Sub_HandleExitCode

  WinBatch_SetupVAA
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

  WinBatch_SetupVAE
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

[WinBatch_SetupVAA]
"%ScriptPath%\data\setupVAA.exe" /S /v/q/n

[WinBatch_SetupVAE]
"%ScriptPath%\data\setupVAE.exe" /S /v/q/n

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

  name: "Blockorientierte Simulation BORIS"

end_link

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\KELLER"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")

path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Klett"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Klett"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

- warning_when_no_node_existing false
- create_when_node_not_existing true

; apparently doesn't work because of differences between Linux/Windows
; timestamps (?)... setting this value should fix this.
OpenNodeSet "EnvironmentOptions/CheckDiskChangesWithLoading"
SetAttribute "Value" value="True"

################################################################################
PAKET: lego-mindstorms-edu-nxt
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/lego-mindstorms-edu-nxt/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere LEGO MINDSTORMS Education NXT...
DefVar $ExitCode$
Defvar $Arch$

[Aktionen]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "LEGO"
Sub_PrepareSetup
; disable the login blocker because the setup won't work before the logon
; window has been shown
opsiservicecall_DisableLoginBlocker /opsiclientd
SleepSeconds 2
ExecWith_FocusWinst "%ScriptPath%\autoit3.exe"
Sub_Setup
LinkFolder_Uninstall

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
DefVar $Account$
DefVar $Password$
Set $Account$ = "opsiSetupAdmin"
Set $Password$ = randomstr
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
else
  Set $Arch$ = "x86"
endif

[opsiservicecall_DisableLoginBlocker]
; opsiservicecall sections don't actually support boolean values - if we'd supply
; "false", it would send that as a string and the backend would interprete this
; string as a boolean true value. Luckily, the empty string "" is equivalent to
; a boolean false value.
"method":"setBlockLogin"
"params":[
  ""
]

[ExecWith_FocusWinst]
; focus the winst window so the user doesn't look at the logon window
WinActivate("opsi-winst")

[Sub_Setup]
; execute setup depending on operating system
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "6") >= "0"
  WinBatch_Setup
  Sub_HandleExitCode
else
  Files_Copy
  DosInAnIcon_Userdel
  DosInAnIcon_Useradd
  Sub_RunSetup
  DosInAnIcon_Userdel
  Files_Delete
endif

; Windows 7

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%ScriptPath%\data\setup.exe" "%ScriptPath%\data\spec-$Arch$.lego" /q /acceptlicenses yes /r:n /log "C:\tmp\lego.log"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

; Windows XP

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*.*" "%SystemDrive%\tmp\lego"

[DosInAnIcon_Userdel]
net user "$Account$" /delete
rmdir /s /q "%ProfileDir%\$Account$"

[DosInAnIcon_Useradd]
net user "$Account$" "$Password$" /add
net localgroup Administratoren /add "$Account$"

[Sub_RunSetup]
DefStringList $res$
Set $res$ = getOutStreamFromSection("ExecWith_Setup '%ScriptPath%\AutoIt3.exe'")
if count($res$) = "1"
  Set $ExitCode$ = takeString(0, $res$)
  comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
  if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
    ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
  endif
else
  LogError "Fatal: Setup did not return exit code!"
  IsFatalError
endif

[ExecWith_Setup]
; http://msdn.microsoft.com/library/ee942965%28v=VS.100%29.aspx
; return exit code via stdout as winst cannot read exit codes from ExecWith
$exitcode = RunAsWait("$Account$", @ComputerName, "$Password$", 1, _
  '"%SystemDrive%\tmp\lego\setup.exe" "%SystemDrive%\tmp\lego\spec-$Arch$.lego" ' & _
  '/q /acceptlicenses yes /r:n /log "C:\tmp\lego.log"')
if not @error then
  ConsoleWrite($exitcode)
endif

[Files_Delete]
delete -sf "%SystemDrive%\tmp\lego\"

[LinkFolder_Uninstall]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "NXT 2.1 Data Logging"
delete_element "NXT 2.1 Programming"


################################################################################
ENDE: lego-mindstorms-edu-nxt/install.ins
################################################################################

  DefVar $e$
  Set $e$ = takeString(0, $res$)
  Comment "setup exit code: " + $e$
  if not($e$ = "0")
      if ($e$ = "1614") or ($e$ = "3010")
        ExitWindows /Reboot
      else
        LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $e$
        IsFatalError
      endif
  endif
else
  LogError "Fatal: Setup did not return exit code!"
  IsFatalError
endif

[ExecWith_Setup]
; http://msdn.microsoft.com/library/ee942965%28v=VS.100%29.aspx
; return exit code via stdout as winst cannot read exit codes from ExecWith
$exitcode = RunAsWait("$Act$", @ComputerName, "$Pwd$", 1, _
  'msiexec /passive /i "$fn$" /l*v %SystemDrive%\tmp\msi.log')
if not @error then
  ConsoleWrite($exitcode)
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%SystemDrive%\tmp\lego\"
delete "%SystemDrive%\tmp\msi.log"

[Sub_InstallLeJOS]
DefStringList $output$
Set $output$ = getOutStreamFromSection('DosBatch_InstallDriver winst /SysNative')

[DosBatch_InstallDriver]
pnputil.exe -i -a "%ScriptPath%\data\rndis\rndis.inf"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Initial]
Message=Installiere LibreOffice...
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $DefaultOffice$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "LibreOffice"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub_PrepareDefaultOffice
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Files_Copy
Sub_Setup
Files_CopyAppdata
Sub_LinkFolder
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)
Set $Arch$ = "x86-64"
if GetSystemType = "x86 System"
  LogError "Fatal: setup only supports 64-bit systems!"
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_PrepareDefaultOffice]
if GetProductProperty("defaultoffice", "False") = "True"
  Set $DefaultOffice$ = "REGISTER_ALL_MSO_TYPES=1"
else
  Set $DefaultOffice$ = "REGISTER_NO_MSO_TYPES=1"
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\LibreOffice_$Version$_Win_$Arch$_helppack_de.msi" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\LibreOffice_$Version$_Win_$Arch$.msi" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Sub_Setup]
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
WinBatch_SetupHelppack
Sub_HandleExitCode

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /passive /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\LibreOffice_$Version$_Win_$Arch$.msi" $DefaultOffice$ ISCHECKFORPRODUCTUPDATES=0

[WinBatch_SetupHelppack]
msiexec /passive /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\LibreOffice_$Version$_Win_$Arch$_helppack_de.msi"

[Files_CopyAppdata]
; files get copied local in programm folder of libreoffice
; serves to fix creation errors on appdata in exam mode 
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\add\*" "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\LibreOffice\"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\LibreOffice 25.8.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif
endif

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "LibreOffice 25.8"
  target: "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\LibreOffice\program\soffice.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "LibreOffice 25.8"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"
delete -f "%opsiLogDir%\libreoffice-main.log"
delete -f "%opsiLogDir%\libreoffice-helppack.log"

################################################################################
ENDE: libreoffice/install.ins
################################################################################


################################################################################
PAKET: libreoffice
DATEI: remove.inc.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/libreoffice/remove.inc.ins
################################################################################

DefVar $CurrentVersion$
Sub_RemoveAll

[Sub_RemoveAll]
; The LibreOffice setup refuses to install old versions if a new 
; version is already installed.
if (FileExists("%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\LibreOffice\program\soffice.exe"))
  Set $CurrentVersion$ = GetValue("ProductVersion", GetFileInfoMapSysNative("%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\LibreOffice\program\soffice.exe"))
  ; Strip last version number part (1.2.3.4 => 1.2.3)
  Set $CurrentVersion$ = ComposeString(GetSubList(0 : 2, SplitString($CurrentVersion$, ".")), ".")
  if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($CurrentVersion$, ">", $Version$))
    WinBatch_RemoveAll
    Sub_HandleExitCode_Remove
    Sub_LinkFolder
  endif
endif

[WinBatch_RemoveAll]
"%ScriptDrive%\tools\autoit\msiRemove_withLog.exe" "LibreOffice"

[Sub_HandleExitCode_Remove]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010" or $ExitCode$ = "1605")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 1605 ERROR_UNKNOWN_PRODUCT
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\LibreOffice 25.8.LNK")
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "LibreOffice 25.8"

################################################################################
ENDE: libreoffice/remove.inc.ins
################################################################################

PAKET: libreoffice
DATEI: remove.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/libreoffice/remove.ins

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere LibreOffice...
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "LibreOffice"
Sub_Uninstall

[Sub_Uninstall]
if FileExists("%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\LibreOffice\program\soffice.exe")
  Sub_PrepareRemove
  Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
  WinBatch_UninstallHelppack
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  WinBatch_UninstallLibreOffice
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  Files_Cleanup
endif

[Sub_PrepareRemove]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap) 
Set $Arch$ = "x86"
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x86-64"
endif

[WinBatch_UninstallHelppack]
; uninstall libreoffice helppack
msiexec /passive /x "%ScriptPath%\data\LibreOffice_$Version$_Win_$Arch$_helppack_de.msi"

[WinBatch_UninstallLibreOffice]
; uninstall libreoffice main product
msiexec /passive /x "%ScriptPath%\data\LibreOffice_$Version$_Win_$Arch$.msi"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "1605" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 1605 ERROR_UNKNOWN_PRODUCT
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\LibreOffice\"

set_subfolder "LIFEtool"

; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\LIFEtool"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
      fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\LIFEtool"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\LIFEtool"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

################################################################################
PAKET: local-user
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/local-user/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere IServ Lokalen Windows-Benutzer erstellen...
; Fix for umlauts in error messages
Encoding=UTF-8
DefVar $BuildNumber$
DefVar $CantChangePassword$
DefVar $DefaultProfilePath$
DefVar $Description$
DefVar $ErrorMessage$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $FullName$
DefVar $Group$
DefVar $MandatoryProfilePath$
DefVar $Name$
DefVar $PCName$
DefVar $Password$
DefVar $ProfilePath$
DefVar $Server$
DefVar $UserGroup$
DefVar $Workgroup$
DefVar $autoLogin$
DefVar $mandatory$
DefVar $overwrite$
DefVar $passwordchg$
DefVar $resetMandatoryProfile$
DefVar $shares$
DefStringList $MSVersionMap$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "IServ Lokalen Windows-Benutzer erstellen"
include_insert "%ScriptDrive%\tools\scripts\report-error-init.inc.ins"
Sub_GetProperties
Sub_Validate
Sub_Create

[Sub_GetProperties]
Set $PCName$ = "%PCName%"
Set $Name$ = GetProductProperty("name", "")
Set $FullName$ = GetProductProperty("fullname", "")
Set $Description$ = GetProductProperty("description", "")
Set $Password$ = GetProductProperty("password", "")
Set $Group$ = GetProductProperty("group", "")
Set $CantChangePassword$ = GetProductProperty("cantchangepw", "true")

if ($CantChangePassword$ = "true")
  Set $passwordchg$ = "no"
else
  if ($CantChangePassword$ = "false")
    Set $passwordchg$ = "yes"
  else
    Set $passwordchg$ = "no"
  endif
endif

Set $autoLogin$ = GetProductProperty("autoLogin", "False")
Set $mandatory$ = GetProductProperty("mandatory", "False")
Set $overwrite$ = GetProductProperty("overwrite", "False")
Set $resetMandatoryProfile$ = GetProductProperty("resetMandatoryProfile", "True")
Set $shares$ = GetProductProperty("shares", "True")

Set $Server$ = takeString(0, splitString(takeString(0, getReturnListFromSection("OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Servername")), "."))
Set $Workgroup$ = takeString(0, getReturnListFromSection("OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Workgroup"))

if FileExists("%Systemdrive%\IServ\%installingProdName%\Script\empty-RecycleBin.ps1")
  Files_Remove_Script
endif

if ($mandatory$ = "True")
  ; Set Paths
  Set $ProfilePath$ = "%ProfileDir%\Default.man"
  Set $DefaultProfilePath$ = "%ProfileDir%\Default"
  Set $MSVersionMap$ = GetMSVersionMap
  Set $BuildNumber$ = TakeString("1", SplitString(TakeString("2", $MSVersionMap$), "="))

  if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($BuildNumber$, ">=", "14393")
    ; Windows 10 1607 or newer
    Set $MandatoryProfilePath$ = "%ProfileDir%\Default.man.v6"
  else
    ; Windows 10 1507 + 1511
    Set $MandatoryProfilePath$ = "%ProfileDir%\Default.man.v5"
  endif
  
  ; Sets schedTask for emptying the trashbin for local user objects which are mandatory at logoff
  Files_Copy_EmptyRecycleBinScripts
endif

[Sub_Validate]
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMSVersionInfo, "<", "10.0")
  Set $ErrorMessage$ = "Keine kompatible Windows Version. Erforderlich ist mindestens Windows 10 oder neuer."
  Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $ErrorMessage$)
  Sub_ReportError
  LogError "Fatal: Windows version not supported. Only compatible with Windows 10 or higher."
  IsFatalError
endif

if ($Name$ = "")
  Set $ErrorMessage$ = "Kein Benutzername festgelegt."
  Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $ErrorMessage$)
  Sub_ReportError
  LogError "Fatal: name not set"
  IsFatalError
endif

if ($Name$ = "Gast" or $Name$ = "Guest")
  Set $ErrorMessage$ = $Name$ + " ist ein reservierter Windows-Benutzer, der nicht modifiziert oder als Benutzername in Bezug auf einen neuen lokalen Benutzer verwendet werden kann."
  Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $ErrorMessage$)
  Sub_ReportError
  LogError "Fatal: " + $Name$ + " is a reserved Windows user that cannot be modified or used as a username for a new local user."
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_Create]
; Error-Codes sind nicht eindeutig.
if ($mandatory$ = "True" and (not(FileExists($MandatoryProfilePath$)) or $resetMandatoryProfile$ = "True"))
  Files_DeleteMandatoryProfile
  Files_CopyProfile
  Files_CleanupMandatoryProfile
  DosInAnIcon_HideMandatoryProfile
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  DosInAnIcon_RemoveAttributes
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  Files_RenameRegistryHive
  DosInAnIcon_ResetAttributes
  Sub_HandleExitCode

  if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMSVersionInfo, "=>", "10.0")
    DosInAnIcon_FixProfilePermissionsWin10
    Sub_HandleExitCode
  endif
  
  DosInAnIcon_LoadRegistryHive
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  DosInAnIcon_FixRegistryPermissions
  Sub_HandleExitCode

  if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMSVersionInfo, "=>", "10.0")
    DosInAnIcon_FixRegistryPermissionsWin10
    Sub_HandleExitCode
  endif

  if ($shares$ = "True")
    Registry_Shares
  endif

  DosInAnIcon_UnloadRegistryHive
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

if ($mandatory$ = "True" or $overwrite$ = "True")
  DosInAnIcon_UserDel
  ; Allow everyone full access to the user profile to make sure that we can delete it.
  DosInAnIcon_FixProfilePermissions
  Files_DeleteUserProfile
  ; For mysterious reasons, in certain situations opsi-script is not able to delete the user profile completly, so lets cleanup the rest with a batch script.
  DosInAnIcon_CleanupUserProfileRests
endif

; Check if the user already exists
; If not, create the user
; If the user exists, reapply settings such as password and other options
DosInAnIcon_Check
if (GetLastExitCode = "1")
  Set $ErrorMessage$ = "Fehler beim Erstellen des Benutzers: " + takeString(0, getOutStreamFromSection("DosInAnIcon_UserAdd"))
else
  DosInAnIcon_UserOptions
endif
Sub_HandleExitCode
WinBatch_SetDescription
Sub_HandleExitCode
WinBatch_SetFullName
Sub_HandleExitCode

DosInAnIcon_DisablePasswordExpiry
if not($mandatory$ = "True")
  DosInAnIcon_UserOptions
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  ; Set Description and Full Name via WinBatch instead of DosInAnIcon, because cmd would break umlauts 
  WinBatch_SetDescription
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  WinBatch_SetFullName
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

; Check if user group (Benutzer/Users) is entered in group property to prevent
; errornous message "Der angegebene Kontoname ist bereits Mitglied der Gruppe."
; as every new user is member of Users group
Set $UserGroup$ = SidToName("S-1-5-32-545")
if not($Group$ = "") and not ($Group$ = $UserGroup$) 
  set $ErrorMessage$ = "Fehler beim Hinzufügen des Benutzers zur Gruppe: " + takeString(1, getOutStreamFromSection("DosInAnIcon_Group"))
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

if ($autoLogin$ = "true") 
  Registry_AutoLogin /SysNative

  if not($Password$ = "")
    Registry_AutoLogin_Password /SysNative
  else
    Registry_AutoLogin_RemovePassword /SysNative
  endif
else
  Registry_DisableAutoLogin /SysNative
endif

[Files_Copy_EmptyRecycleBinScripts]
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\add\autorun.cmd" "%CommonStartupDir%"
;copy "%ScriptPath%\data\add\empty-RecycleBin.ps1" "%SystemDrive%\IServ\%installingProdName%\Script"

[Files_DeleteMandatoryProfile]
delete -sfc "$MandatoryProfilePath$\"

[Files_CopyProfile]
; -e = copy empty directories
copy -sce "$DefaultProfilePath$\*" "$MandatoryProfilePath$\"

[Files_CleanupMandatoryProfile]
delete -fc "$MandatoryProfilePath$\ntuser.dat.LOG*"
delete -fc "$MandatoryProfilePath$\ntuser.dat{*"

[Files_RenameRegistryHive]
rename "$MandatoryProfilePath$\ntuser.dat" "$MandatoryProfilePath$\ntuser.man"

[DosInAnIcon_FixRegistryPermissions]
@echo off
"%ScriptPath%\data\add\SetACL.exe" -on HKU\.DEFAULT.man -ot REG -actn ace -ace "n:S-1-1-0;p:full"

[DosInAnIcon_FixRegistryPermissionsWin10]
@echo off
; Allow "ALLE ANWENDUNGSPAKETE" full access to User's registry on Windows 10 to fix startmenu
; https://www.windowspro.de/wolfgang-sommergut/anleitung-mandatory-user-profile-verbindliches-benutzerprofil-fuer-windows-10
"%ScriptPath%\data\add\SetACL.exe" -on HKU\.DEFAULT.man -ot REG -actn ace -ace "n:S-1-15-2-1;p:full"

[DosInAnIcon_RemoveAttributes]
@echo off
attrib -h -s "$MandatoryProfilePath$\ntuser.dat"

[DosInAnIcon_ResetAttributes]
@echo off
attrib +h +s "$MandatoryProfilePath$\ntuser.man"

[DosInAnIcon_HideMandatoryProfile]
@echo off
attrib +h "$MandatoryProfilePath$"

[DosInAnIcon_FixProfilePermissions]
@echo off
"%ScriptPath%\data\add\SetACL.exe" -on %ProfileDir%\$name$\ -ot FILE -rec yes -actn ace -ace "n:S-1-1-0;p:full"

[DosInAnIcon_FixProfilePermissionsWin10]
@echo off
; Allow "ALLE ANWENDUNGSPAKETE" full access to User's profile on Windows 10 to fix startmenu
; https://www.windowspro.de/wolfgang-sommergut/anleitung-mandatory-user-profile-verbindliches-benutzerprofil-fuer-windows-10
"%ScriptPath%\data\add\SetACL.exe" -on $MandatoryProfilePath$\ -ot FILE -rec yes -actn ace -ace "n:S-1-15-2-1;p:full" -rec yes

[DosInAnIcon_Check]
@echo off
for /f %%i in ('powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_UserAccount | Where-Object { $_.LocalAccount -eq $true } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name" ^| findstr /r /v "^$"') do echo %%i | findstr /i "$Name$"
exit %ERRORLEVEL%

[DosInAnIcon_LoadRegistryHive]
@echo off
REG LOAD HKU\.DEFAULT.man "$MandatoryProfilePath$\ntuser.man"

[DosInAnIcon_UnloadRegistryHive]
@echo off
REG UNLOAD HKU\.DEFAULT.man

[Registry_Shares]
openkey [HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\NetworkProvider]
set "RestoreConnection" = REG_DWORD:0
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Network]
set "RestoreDiskChecked" = REG_DWORD:0
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Network\G]
; 131072 in HEX: 0x20000
set "ProviderType" = REG_DWORD:131072
set "ConnectionType" = REG_DWORD:1
set "RemotePath" = "\\$Server$\groups"
set "ProviderName" = "Microsoft Windows Network"
set "DeferFlags" = REG_DWORD:1
set "UserName" = ""
openkey [HKU\.DEFAULT.man\Network\H]
; 131072 in HEX: 0x20000
set "ProviderType" = REG_DWORD:131072
set "ConnectionType" = REG_DWORD:1
set "RemotePath" = "\\$Server$\home"
set "ProviderName" = "Microsoft Windows Network"
set "DeferFlags" = REG_DWORD:1
set "UserName" = ""

[DosInAnIcon_UserDel]
@echo off
NET USER "$name$" /delete

[Files_DeleteUserProfile]
delete -sfc "%ProfileDir%\$name$\"
; delete multiple copies of user profile, mostly their have the suffix .PCName, .PCName.000, .PCName.001 and so far...
delete -sfc "%ProfileDir%\$name$.$PCName$*\"

[DosInAnIcon_UserAdd]
@echo off
;change code page for umlauts and hide the output
chcp 1252 > NUL
; create it if it doesn't exist
; parameter /y to force passwords longer than 14 characters
; http://serverfault.com/questions/452894/force-net-user-command-to-set-password-longer-than-14-characters
net user "$Name$" "$Password$" /EXPIRES:NEVER /passwordchg:$passwordchg$ /PASSWORDREQ:$passwordchg$ /PROFILEPATH:"$ProfilePath$" /add /y

[DosInAnIcon_DisablePasswordExpiry]
@echo off
; disable password expiry
cscript //nologo "%ScriptPath%\data\add\nopwdexp.vbs" /domain:"%PCName%" /user:"$Name$"

[DosInAnIcon_CleanupUserProfileRests]
@echo off
rmdir /S /Q "%ProfileDir%\$name$"

[DosInAnIcon_UserOptions]
@echo off
;change code page for umlauts and hide the output
chcp 1252 > NUL
; if it exists, re-apply options
; parameter /y to force passwords longer than 14 characters
; http://serverfault.com/questions/452894/force-net-user-command-to-set-password-longer-than-14-characters
net user "$Name$" "$Password$" /EXPIRES:NEVER /passwordchg:$passwordchg$ /PASSWORDREQ:$passwordchg$ /PROFILEPATH:"$ProfilePath$" /y

[WinBatch_SetDescription]
net user "$Name$" /COMMENT:"$description$" 

[WinBatch_SetFullName]
net user "$Name$" /FULLNAME:"$FullName$"

[DosInAnIcon_Group]
@echo off
net localgroup "$Group$" /add "$Name$"

[Registry_AutoLogin]
openkey [HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon]
set "AutoAdminLogon" = "1"
set "DefaultUserName" = "$Name$"
set "DefaultDomainName" = "$PCName$"

[Registry_AutoLogin_Password]
openkey [HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon]
set "DefaultPassword" = "$Password$"

[Registry_AutoLogin_RemovePassword]
openkey [HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon]
deletevar "DefaultPassword"

[Registry_DisableAutoLogin]
openkey [HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon]
deletevar "DefaultUserName"
deletevar "DefaultPassword"
set "AutoAdminLogon" = "0"
set "DefaultDomainName" = "$Workgroup$"

  "Hostname"
]

[OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Workgroup]
"method": "iserv_cfg"

  "Workgroup"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  if not($ErrorMessage$ = "")
    Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $ErrorMessage$)
    Sub_ReportError
  endif
  LogError "Fatal: command returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

PAKET: local-user

PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/local-user/remove.ins

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere IServ Lokalen Windows-Benutzer erstellen...
DefVar $Name$
DefVar $FullName$
DefVar $Description$
DefVar $Password$
DefVar $Group$
DefVar $CantChangePassword$
DefVar $mandatory$
DefVar $resetMandatoryProfile$
DefVar $shares$
DefVar $autoLogin$
DefVar $MandatoryProfilePath$
DefVar $Workgroup$
DefVar $ErrorMessage$
DefVar $BuildNumber$
DefStringList $MSVersionMap$
DefVar $ExitCode$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "IServ Lokalen Windows-Benutzer erstellen"
include_insert "%ScriptDrive%\tools\scripts\report-error-init.inc.ins"
Sub_GetProperties
Sub_Validate
Sub_Delete

[Sub_GetProperties]
Set $Name$ = GetProductProperty("name", "")
Set $FullName$ = GetProductProperty("fullname", "")
Set $Description$ = GetProductProperty("description", "")
Set $Password$ = GetProductProperty("password", "")
Set $Group$ = GetProductProperty("group", "")
Set $CantChangePassword$ = GetProductProperty("cantchangepw", "true")
Set $autoLogin$ = GetProductProperty("autoLogin", "False")
Set $mandatory$ = GetProductProperty("mandatory", "False")
Set $resetMandatoryProfile$ = GetProductProperty("resetMandatoryProfile", "True")
Set $shares$ = GetProductProperty("shares", "True")
Set $Workgroup$ = takeString(0, getReturnListFromSection("OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Workgroup"))
if ($mandatory$ = "True")
  if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, ">=", "10")
    ; Windows 10
    Set $MSVersionMap$ = GetMSVersionMap
    Set $BuildNumber$ = TakeString("1", SplitString(TakeString("2", $MSVersionMap$), "="))
    if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($BuildNumber$, ">=", "14393")
      ; Windows 10 1607
      Set $MandatoryProfilePath$ = "%ProfileDir%\Default.man.v6"
    else
      ; Windows 10 1507 + 1511
      Set $MandatoryProfilePath$ = "%ProfileDir%\Default.man.v5"
    endif
  else
    if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, ">=", "6.3")
      ; Windows 8.1
      Set $MandatoryProfilePath$ = "%ProfileDir%\Default.man.v4"
    else
      if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, ">=", "6.0")
        ; Windows 7
        Set $MandatoryProfilePath$ = "%ProfileDir%\Default.man.v2"
      else
        ; Windows XP
        Set $ProfilePath$ = "%ProfileDir%\Default User.man"
        Set $DefaultProfilePath$ = "%ProfileDir%\Default User"
        Set $MandatoryProfilePath$ = "%ProfileDir%\Default User.man"
      endif
    endif
  endif
endif

[Sub_Validate]
if ($Name$ = "")
  LogError "Fatal: name not set"
  IsFatalError
endif

if ($Name$ = "Gast" or $Name$ = "Guest")
  Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $Name$ + " ist ein reservierter Windows-Benutzername, er kann nicht als Benutzername für den lokalen Benutzer verwendet werden.")
  Sub_ReportError
  LogError "Fatal: " + $Name$ + " is a reserved Windows user name, it cannot be used as user name for the local user."
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_Delete]
; Error-Codes sind nicht eindeutig.
if ($mandatory$ = "True" and (FileExists($MandatoryProfilePath$)))
  Files_DeleteMandatoryProfile
endif
; Check if user exists
; if not, do nothing
; if, delete it
DosInAnIcon_Check
if (GetLastExitCode = "0")
  set $ErrorMessage$ = "Fehler beim Löschen des Benutzers: " + takeString(0, getOutStreamFromSection("DosInAnIcon_UserDel"))
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif
Files_DeleteUserProfile
if ($autoLogin$ = "true")
  Registry_DisableAutoLogin /SysNative
endif
Files_Cleanup_Scriptfolder
ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"

[DosInAnIcon_UserDel]
@echo off
NET USER "$name$" /delete

[DosInAnIcon_Check]
net user | find "$Name$ "
exit %ERRORLEVEL%

[Files_DeleteUserProfile]
delete -sfc "%ProfileDir%\$name$\"
; delete multiple copies of user profile, mostly their have the suffix .PCName, .PCName.000, .PCName.001 and so far...
delete -sfc "%ProfileDir%\$name$.$PCName$*\"

[Files_DeleteMandatoryProfile]
delete -sfc "$MandatoryProfilePath$\"

[Files_Cleanup_ScriptFolder]
delete -sf "%SystemDrive%\IServ\%installingProdName%\"
delete "%CommonStartupDir%\autorun.cmd"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "%SystemDrive%\IServ"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[Registry_DisableAutoLogin]
openkey [HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon]
deletevar "DefaultUserName"
deletevar "DefaultPassword"
set "AutoAdminLogon" = "0"
set "DefaultDomainName" = "$Workgroup$"

[OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Workgroup]
"method": "iserv_cfg"
"params": [
  "Workgroup"
]

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  if not($ErrorMessage$ = "")
    Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $ErrorMessage$)
    Sub_ReportError
  endif
  LogError "Fatal: command returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

WinBatch_Setup_UniTrain
Sub_HandleExitCode
WinBatch_Setup_ActiveServo
Sub_HandleExitCode
WinBatch_Setup_LNVI
Sub_HandleExitCode
;Opsi doesnt like Ü or @ as chars so we have to use get powershell to create a reg file from template
DosInAnIcon_PowerShell_ExecutionPolicy
ExecWith_Powershell powershell.exe
;now import the good reg file as unicode because Ü or @ are still behaving badly
Registry loadUnicodeTextFile("%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\labsoft.reg") /regedit
LinkFolder_Setup

powershell.exe set-executionpolicy Unrestricted

[ExecWith_Powershell]
(Get-Content "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\labsoft.reg") | ForEach-Object { $_ -replace "ConfigFileLocation", "$LabSoftConfig$" } | Set-Content "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\labsoft2.reg"
(Get-Content "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\labsoft2.reg") | ForEach-Object { $_ -replace "FormatFilesLocation", "$FilePathConfig$" } | Set-Content "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\labsoft.reg"

if ($FilePathConfig$ = "")
  LogError "Fatal! No FilePath found!"
  IsFatalError
endif

[WinBatch_Setup_ActiveServo]

[WinBatch_Setup_LNVI]
msiexec /passive /i "%ScriptPath%\data\LNVI.msi" 

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "LabSoft"

  name: "LabSoft"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\LN\LabSoft\LabSoft.exe"
end_link
set_link
  name: "LabSoftX"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\LN\LabSoft\LabSoftX.exe"
end_link
set_link
  name: "VOCANTO"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\LN\LabSoft\vocanto.exe"
end_link
set_link
  name: "ActiveServo"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\LN\ActiveServo\ActiveServo.exe"
end_link

  name: "UniTrain Starter"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\LN\PlugIns\Starter.exe"

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Lumens Ladibug...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $WinstRegKey$
DefVar $RebootFlag$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Lumens Ladibug"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub_CheckReboot
Files_Copy
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_LinkFolder
Files_Cleanup
Sub_Killtask

[Sub_CheckReboot]
; Setup will break if there is a reboot pending, so we restart.
Set $WinstRegKey$ = "HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\"+"%installingProdName%"
Set $RebootFlag$ = GetRegistryStringValue32("["+$WinstRegKey$+"] "+"RebootFlag")
if (not($RebootFlag$ = "1"))
  Set $RebootFlag$ = "1"
  Registry_SaveRebootFlag /32bit
  opsiservicecall_Reinstall
  Sub_ImmReboot
endif

[Registry_SaveRebootFlag]
openKey [$WinstRegKey$]
set "RebootFlag" = "$RebootFlag$"

[Registry_RemoveBootFlag]
deletekey [$WinstRegKey$]

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "setup"
]

[Sub_ImmReboot]
ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
;Workaround to handle the error message during the installation
ExecWith_AutoIt "%ScriptDrive%\tools\AutoIt3.exe" WINST /letThemGo

[ExecWith_AutoIt]
;handles error message 
WinActivate ("Ladibug3.0","Fehler")
Sleep(500)
WinWaitActive("Ladibug3.0","Fehler")
ControlCLick("Ladibug3.0","Fehler","[CLASS:Button; INSTANCE:3]")
;handles reboot message
WinWaitActive("Ladibug3.0","Sie müssen Ihren Computer")
Sleep(500)
Send("{ENTER}")

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Ladibug.exe" /S /v/qb! 

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Cleanup
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_Cleanup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Ladibug 3.0"
delete_element "Uninstall Ladibug3.0"

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Ladibug 3.0"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Lumens\Ladibug3.0\Ladibug.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Lumens\Ladibug3.0"
end_link


[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Ladibug 3.0"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_Killtask]
Killtask "AutoIt3.exe"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

  endif

  Files_CopyLicense

  Files_CopyTmpLicense

  Set $AuthCode$ = GetProductProperty("authcode", "")
  Set $Serial$ = GetProductProperty("serialnumber", "")
  Set $Licensee$ = GetProductProperty("licensee", "")
  Set $MaxClients$ = GetProductProperty("maxslaves", "")

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
if (GetProductProperty("roomtype", "Fester Raum") = "Fester Raum") or (GetProductProperty("roomtype", "Fester Raum") = "Raumliste")
  if not(GetProductProperty("room", "") = "")
    Set $Room$ = GetProductProperty("room", "")
  else
    if not(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_getRoom")) = "")
      Set $Room$ = TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_getRoom"))
    else
      Set $Room$ = "Weitere"
    endif
  endif
else
  if (GetProductProperty("roomtype", "Fester Raum") = "Mobil")
    Set $Room$ = "*"
  else
    LogError "Fatal! Unsupported input!"
    IsFatalError
  endif
endif
; Check license
if (FileExists("\\iserv\appdata\licenses\mastersolution-suite-xl-12\NSM.lIC"))
  Files_CopyLicense
else
  Files_CopyTmpLicense

  Set $AuthCode$ = GetProductProperty("authcode", "")
  Set $Serial$ = GetProductProperty("serialnumber", "")
  Set $Licensee$ = GetProductProperty("licensee", "")
  Set $MaxClients$ = GetProductProperty("maxslaves", "")

  if not($AuthCode$ = "" and $Serial$ = "" and $Licensee$ = "")
    Patches_License "%ProgramFilesDir%\MASTERSOLUTION\SUITE XL\NSM.LIC"
    PatchTextFile_License "%ProgramFilesDir%\MASTERSOLUTION\SUITE XL\NSM.LIC"
    Patches_License "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\NSM.LIC"
    PatchTextFile_License "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\NSM.LIC"
  endif
endif

[Files_CopyTmpLicense]
copy "%ScriptPath%\NSM.LIC" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Mastersolution Suite XL 14...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Licence$
DefVar $Version$
DefVar $Transform$
DefVar $Customer$
DefVar $Room$
DefVar $Authcode$
DefVar $Maxclients$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Mastersolution Suite XL 14"
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_SetVariables
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode

[Sub_SetVariables]
set $Transform$ = "STUDENT=1 CONFIGURATOR=1 CONFIGSHORTCUT=1"
set $Version$ = GetProductProperty("version" , "")
if (GetProductProperty("version", "Schüler") = "Lehrer")
  set $Transform$ = "TRANSFORMS=%ScriptPath%\data\Tutor.mst TUTOR=1"
endif
if (GetProductProperty("version", "Schüler") = "IT-Techniker")
  set $Transform$ = "TRANSFORMS=%ScriptPath%\data\IT.mst TECHCONSOLE=1"
endif

set $Licence$ = GetProductProperty("productkey" , "")
if ($Licence$ = "")
  LogError "Fatal! Licence key not set"
  IsFatalError
endif

set $Customer$ = GetProductProperty("customer" , "")
if ($Customer$ = "")
  LogError "Fatal! Customer not set"
  IsFatalError
endif

set $Maxclients$ = GetProductProperty("maxclients" , "")
if ($Maxclients$ = "")
  LogError "Fatal! Maximum of Clients not set"
  IsFatalError
endif

set $Authcode$ = GetProductProperty("authcode" , "")
if ($Authcode$ = "")
  LogError "Fatal! Authentication-Code not found"
  IsFatalError
endif

set $Room$ = GetProductProperty("room" , "")
if ($Room$ = "")
  LogError "Fatal! No Room was set"
  IsFatalError
endif

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /passive /i "%ScriptPath%\data\MASTERSOLUTION SUITE XL.msi" ROOMSPEC=$Room$ NSM_EVAL=0 NSM_LICENCEE="$Customer$" NSM_SERIALNO=$Licence$ NSM_MAXCLIENTS=$Maxclients$ NSM_AUTHCODE=$Authcode$ $Transform$ /l*v C:\install.log

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

  LogError "Fatal! No setup file found."
  IsFatalError

"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

  Set $SetupPath$ = "\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\installer\medienws-fonts-dsns\$name$"
endif

  WinBatch_Setup
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

[Sub_HandleExitCode]

    IsFatalError
endif

    Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

    WinBatch_Uninstallv2
    Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
"%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Schulschriften\Druckschrift\unins000.exe" /SILENT

[WinBatch_Uninstallv2]
"%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Schulschriften\unins000.exe" /SILENT

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_CleanUp]
delete -sf "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Schulschriften\Druckschrift"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramsFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Schulschriften"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If
