################################################################################
PAKET: microsoft-dot-net-framework
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/microsoft-dot-net-framework/install.ins
################################################################################

; Exit codes: https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ee390831%28v=vs.110%29.aspx#troubleshooting

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Microsoft .NET Framework...
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $PackagePath$
DefVar $Path$
DefVar $Reboot$
DefVar $ReleaseID$
DefVar $ReleaseIDWin11$
DefStringList $msVersionList$
DefStringList $Updates$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Microsoft .NET Framework"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub_Setup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Path$ = "%ScriptPath%\data"
Set $Arch$ = "x86"
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
endif

[Sub_Setup]
; Check if OS is newer than Windows XP
if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "5.1") = "1")
  ; Check if OS is newer than Windows 7
  if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "6.1") = "1")
    ; Install .NET Framework 3.5 on all Windows 8 or newer
    Sub_InstallNetFx35
  endif

  ; Check if OS is newer than Windows XP but not as new as Windows 10 1903
  ; https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/.NET_Framework#.NET_Framework_4.8.0
  if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "<", "10.0") or CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetValue("ReleaseID", GetMsVersionMap), "<", "1903"))
    ; Fix for .Net 4.8
    WinBatch_d3dUpdate
    ; Install .NET Framework 4.8 on Windows 7, Windows 8.1 and Windows 10 < 1903
    WinBatch_SetupNetFx48
    ; Install 4.5.2 if client is missing KB2119355
    if (GetLastExitCode = "5100")
      WinBatch_SetupNetFx452
      Sub_HandleExitCode
    else
      Sub_HandleExitCode
      WinBatch_SetupNetFx48LP
      Sub_HandleExitCode
    endif
     ;WinBatch_SetupNetFx48
     ;Sub_HandleExitCode
  endif
else
  ; Windows XP; Install 2.0, 3.5 and 4.0
  Sub_InstallNetFx35_XP
  WinBatch_SetupNetFx40
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

;
; .Net Framework 3.5 install for Windows 8 and newer
; Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10
;
[Sub_InstallNetFx35]
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "6.3") = "0"
  Sub_CheckInstalledUpdates81
else
endif
Set $PackagePath$ = $Path$ + "\sxs\" + GetMsVersionInfo + "\" + $Arch$
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "10.0") = "0"
  Set $msVersionList$ = GetMsVersionMap
  Set $ReleaseID$ = GetValue("ReleaseID", $msVersionList$)
  Set $ReleaseIDWin11$ = getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion", "CurrentBuild", "32bit")

  if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($ReleaseID$, ">=", "1903")
    Set $PackagePath$ = $Path$ + "\sxs\" + GetMsVersionInfo + "\1903\" + $Arch$
  endif
  
  if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($ReleaseID$, ">=", "2004")
    Set $PackagePath$ = $Path$ + "\sxs\" + GetMsVersionInfo + "\2004\" + $Arch$
  endif

  if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($ReleaseIDWin11$, ">=", "22621")
    Set $PackagePath$ = $Path$ + "\sxs\" + GetMsVersionInfo + "\22621\" + $Arch$
  endif

  if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($ReleaseIDWin11$, ">=", "26100")
    Set $PackagePath$ = $Path$ + "\sxs\" + GetMsVersionInfo + "\26100\" + $Arch$
  endif
  
  if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($ReleaseID$, ">=", "1809")
    DosInAnIcon_AddNetFx35Win101809 winst /SysNative
    DosInAnIcon_InstallNetFx35Win101809 winst /SysNative
  else
    DosInAnIcon_InstallNetFx35 winst /SysNative
  endif
else
  DosInAnIcon_InstallNetFx35 winst /SysNative
endif
Sub_HandleExitCode

[DosInAnIcon_InstallNetFx35]
DISM /Online /Enable-Feature /FeatureName:NetFx3 /All /LimitAccess /Source:$PackagePath$ /NoRestart

[DosInAnIcon_AddNetFx35Win101809]
DISM /Online /add-package /packagepath:$PackagePath$ /IgnoreCheck /NoRestart

[DosInAnIcon_InstallNetFx35Win101809]
DISM /Online /Enable-Feature /FeatureName:NetFx3 /All /LimitAccess /NoRestart

;
; .NET Framework 4.6 Update for Windows 7 or newer
; Will be replaced with .NET Framework 4.6 after its release
;
[WinBatch_SetupNetFx452]
"%ScriptPath%\data\NDP452-KB2901907-x86-x64-AllOS-ENU.exe" /norestart /passive

[WinBatch_d3dUpdate]
wusa "%ScriptPath%\data\Windows6.1-KB4019990-$Arch$.msu" /quiet /norestart

[WinBatch_SetupNetFx48]
"%ScriptPath%\data\ndp48-x86-x64-allos-enu.exe" /norestart /passive

[WinBatch_SetupNetFx48LP]
"%ScriptPath%\data\ndp48-x86-x64-allos-deu.exe" /norestart /passive

;
; Windows 8.1
; .NET Framework 3.5 requires that the following updates are not installed:
; KB2966826, KB2966827, KB2966828
;
[Sub_CheckInstalledUpdates81]
Set $Updates$ = createStringList("2966826", "2966827", "2966828")
for $Update$ in $Updates$ do Sub_CheckRemoveUpdate
if $Reboot$ = "1"
  opsiservicecall_Reinstall
  ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot
endif

[Sub_CheckRemoveUpdate]
DosInAnIcon_UninstallUpdate $Update$ /SysNative /ShowOutput
Sub_HandleExitCode_WUSA
if $ExitCode$ = "3010"
  Set $Reboot$ = "1"
endif

[DosInAnIcon_UninstallUpdate]
%windir%\Sysnative\wusa.exe /uninstall /kb:%1 /quiet /norestart

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "setup"
]

[Sub_HandleExitCode_WUSA]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010" or $ExitCode$ = "2359303")
  ; 0        ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010     ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  ; 2359303  Update not installed (guessed, not documented)
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

;
; Windows XP
; .NET Framework 4.5 and newer are not supported
;
[Sub_InstallNetFx35_XP]
; Install dependency
WinBatch_SetupRGB
Sub_HandleExitCode
; Remove installed version if found
if GetRegistryStringValue("[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\{052FDD78-A6EA-3187-8386-C82F4CA3A929}] DisplayVersion") = "3.5.30729"
  WinBatch_RemoveNetFx35_XP
endif
; Install .NET Framework 3.5
WinBatch_SetupNetFx35_XP
Sub_HandleExitCode

[WinBatch_SetupRGB]
msiexec /passive /i "%ScriptPath%\data\RGB9RAST_x86.msi" ALLUSERS=1

[WinBatch_SetupNetFx35_XP]
"%ScriptPath%\data\dotnetfx35.exe" /passive /norestart

[WinBatch_RemoveNetFx35_XP]
"%ScriptPath%\data\dotnetfx35.exe" /remove /passive /norestart

[WinBatch_SetupNetFx40]
"%ScriptPath%\data\dotNetFx40_Full_x86_x64.exe" /q /norestart

;
; Helper sections
;

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

ENDE: microsoft-dot-net-framework/install.ins

################################################################################
PAKET: microsoft-hyper-v
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/microsoft-hyper-v/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Aktiviere Hyper-V...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Hypervisor$
DefVar $Manager$
DefVar $Services$
DefVar $Modules$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Hyper-V"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub_Setup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "<", "6.2"))
  LogError "Fatal: This package requires at least Windows 8!" 
  IsFatalError
endif

Set $Hypervisor$ = GetProductProperty("hypervisor", "")
Set $Manager$ = GetProductProperty("manager", "")
Set $Services$ = GetProductProperty("services", "")
Set $Modules$ = GetProductProperty("modules", "")

[Sub_Setup]
if ($Manager$ = "true")
  ExecWith_NetworkCategory "powershell.exe" -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoLogo -NonInteractive -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -File winst /SysNative
  ; returns exit code 1 if winrm is not configured
  ExecWith_CheckWinrm "powershell.exe" -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoLogo -NonInteractive -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -File winst /SysNative
  if (GetLastExitCode = "1")
    DosInAnIcon_ConfigureWinrm
    Sub_HandleExitCode
  endif
  ExecWith_WSManCredSSP "powershell.exe" -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoLogo -NonInteractive -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -File winst /SysNative
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  DosInAnIcon_EnableManager winst /SysNative
  Sub_HandleExitCodeDism
  Registry_SetDelegationPolicy /SysNative
else
  DosInAnIcon_DisableManager winst /SysNative
  Sub_HandleExitCodeDism 
endif

if ($Hypervisor$ = "true")
  DosInAnIcon_EnableHypervisor winst /SysNative
  Sub_HandleExitCodeDism
  if ($ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ExitWindows /Reboot
  endif
  DosInAnIcon_ResetFirewall
  DosInAnIcon_OpenFirewall
  Sub_HandleExitCode
else
  DosInAnIcon_DisableHypervisor winst /SysNative
  Sub_HandleExitCodeDism
  if ($ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ExitWindows /Reboot
  endif
endif

if ($Services$ = "true")
  DosInAnIcon_EnableServices winst /SysNative
  Sub_HandleExitCodeDism
  if ($ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ExitWindows /Reboot
  endif
else
  DosInAnIcon_DisableServices winst /SysNative
  Sub_HandleExitCodeDism
  if ($ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ExitWindows /Reboot
  endif
endif

if ($Modules$ = "true")
  DosInAnIcon_EnableModules winst /SysNative
  Sub_HandleExitCodeDism
  if ($ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ExitWindows /Reboot
  endif
else
  DosInAnIcon_DisableModules winst /SysNative
  Sub_HandleExitCodeDism

################################################################################
PAKET: microsoft-msrt
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/microsoft-msrt/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message "Microsoft-Tool zum Entfernen bösartiger Software wird ausgeführt..."
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Reboot$
DefVar $Log$
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $Version$
Encoding=UTF-8

[Aktionen]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "MSRT"
Files_DeleteOldLog
Sub_Prepare
Files_Copy
WinBatch_Run
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_SubmitLog
Files_Cleanup
Sub_Reboot

[Files_DeleteOldLog]
delete -f "%systemroot%\debug\mrt.log"

[Sub_Prepare]
; --------------
;
; CHANGE ONLY THE FOLLOWING LINE TO UPDATE THE SCRIPT
;
; --------------
Set $Version$ = "5.76"
; Determinate system architecture
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "-x64"
endif

if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "<", "6")
  LogError "Fatal! This package requires Windows Vista or later."
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\Windows-KB890830$Arch$-V$Version$.exe" "%opsiTmpDir%\microsoft-msrt\"

[WinBatch_Run]
"%opsiTmpDir%\microsoft-msrt\Windows-KB890830$Arch$-V$Version$.exe" /q

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
if $ExitCode$ = "0"
  ; log into instlog
  comment "no infection found"

  ; log into IServ log
  Set $Log$ = "MSRT: Keine Infektionen gefunden"
  opsiservicecall_SubmitLog
else
  if $ExitCode$ = "6"
    comment "at least one infection detected; no reboot required"
  else
    if $ExitCode$ = "10" or $ExitCode$ = "13"
      comment "at least one infection detected and removed; reboot required"
      Set $Reboot$ = "Reboot"
    else
      LogError "Fatal: MSRT returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
      IsFatalError
    endif
  endif
endif

[Sub_SubmitLog]
if FileExists("%systemroot%\debug\mrt.log")
  DefVar $Infections$
  DefStringList $Res$
  Set $Res$ = GetOutStreamFromSection('DosInAnIcon_ParseLog')

  if count($Res$) >= "1"
    Set $Infections$ = takeString(0, $Res$)

    if not($Infections$ = "")
      ; log into instlog
      comment "infections: " + $Infections$

      ; log into IServ log
      Set $Log$ = "MSRT: Infektionen bereinigt: " + $Infections$
      opsiservicecall_SubmitLog
    endif
  endif
else
  LogWarning "%systemroot%\debug\mrt.log not found!"
endif

[DosInAnIcon_ParseLog]
; - winst is completely useless for string manipulation, so we have to depend
; on Windows here which is only almost useless :|
; - 'echo . | set /p x="output"' is a really dirty hack to print something
; without a newline on Windows.
; - findstr is unable to handle Microsoft's very own favourite UCS2-LE
; encoding, so we have to use type first to convert that file to ASCII.
; - FIXME this prints a trailing space; I've no idea how to fix this :(
@echo off
type %systemroot%\debug\mrt.log > %systemroot%\debug\mrt2.log
for /f "tokens=3" %%a in ('findstr /R /C:"^Threat detected:" %systemroot%\debug\mrt2.log') do echo. | set /p x="%%a "
del %systemroot%\debug\mrt2.log

[opsiservicecall_SubmitLog]
"method":"iserv_log"
"params": [
          "%installingProdName%",
          "$Log$"
          ]

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\microsoft-msrt\"

[Sub_Reboot]
if $Reboot$ = "Reboot"
  ExitWindows /Reboot
endif

[Sub_CheckLicense]

      if FileExists("%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\LogoImages\ExcelLogoSmall.scale-180.png")

      if FileExists("%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\LogoImages\ExcelLogoSmall.scale-180.png")
        LogError "Fatal: Installation failed! Please uninstall older versions of Microsoft Office e.g. MS Office 2019 before having this package installed again."
        IsFatalError
      endif
  endif
endif

copy "%ScriptPath%\data\Setup.exe" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\$Arch$\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

  Set $Languages$ = loadTextFile("\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\%installingProdName%\languages.txt")
else

  endif

"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

  SetAttribute "ID" value="$Version$"

if GetProductProperty("removeaccess", "False") = "True"

if GetProductProperty("removepublisher", "False") = "True"

  DosInAnIcon_Cleanup_OneDrive /32Bit
  Registry_OneDriveDelete /64bit

  PatchTextFile_InstallGroove "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\config.xml"
endif
if GetProductProperty("installlync", "False") = "True"
  PatchTextFile_InstallLync "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\config.xml"

  PatchTextFile_InstallOneNote "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\config.xml"
endif
if GetProductProperty("installbing", "False") = "True"
  PatchTextFile_InstallBing "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\config.xml"
endif
if GetProductProperty("sharedcomputerlicensing", "False") = "True"
  PatchTextFile_ActivateLicensing "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\config.xml"
  if GetProductProperty("automaticlogin", "False") = "True"
    PatchTextFile_ActivateLogin "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\config.xml"
  endif
endif
if GetProductProperty("devicebasedlicensing", "False") = "True"
  PatchTextFile_ActivateDeviceLicensing "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\config.xml"
endif
if GetProductProperty("removeold", "False") = "False"
  PatchTextFile_DeleteRemoveMSI "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\config.xml"
endif

[PatchTextFile_RemoveAccess]
FindLine_StartingWith "      <Language"
AppendLine'      <ExcludeApp ID="Access" />'

[PatchTextFile_RemovePublisher]
FindLine_StartingWith "      <Language"
AppendLine'      <ExcludeApp ID="Publisher" />'

[PatchTextFile_InstallTeams]
FindLine_Containing "Teams"
DeleteTheLine

[PatchTextFile_InstallOneDrive]
FindLine_Containing "OneDrive"
DeleteTheLine

[PatchTextFile_InstallGroove]
FindLine_Containing "Groove"
DeleteTheLine

[PatchTextFile_InstallLync]
FindLine_Containing "Lync"
DeleteTheLine

[PatchTextFile_InstallOneNote]
FindLine_Containing "OneNote"
DeleteTheLine

[PatchTextFile_InstallBing]
FindLine_Containing "Bing"
DeleteTheLine

[PatchTextFile_ActivateLicensing]
FindLine_StartingWith '  <Property Name="Shared'
DeleteTheLine
AppendLine '  <Property Name="SharedComputerLicensing" Value="1" />'

[PatchTextFile_ActivateLogin]
FindLine_StartingWith '  <Property Name="Shared'
AppendLine '  <Property Name="SCLCacheOverride" Value="1" />'
AppendLine '  <Property Name="SCLCacheOverrideDirectory" Value="%appdata%\Microsoft\LicenseToken" />'

[PatchTextFile_ActivateDeviceLicensing]
FindLine_StartingWith '  <Property Name="Shared'
AppendLine '  <Property Name="DeviceBasedLicensing" Value="1" />'

[PatchTextFile_DeleteRemoveMSI]
FindLine_Containing "RemoveMSI"
DeleteTheLine

[XMLPatch_Config]
openNodeSet "Add"
  SetAttribute "OfficeClientEdition" Value="$Arch$"
  
[Registry_OneDriveDelete]
DeleteKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\OneDrive]
  
[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\setup.exe" /configure "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\config.xml"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_Registry]
if GetProductProperty("devicebasedlicensing", "False") = "True"
  Registry_ActivateDeviceLicensing /SysNative
else
  Registry_DeactivateDeviceLicensing /SysNative
endif

if GetProductProperty("sharedcomputerlicensing", "False") = "True"
  Registry_ActivateLicensing /SysNative
  if GetProductProperty("automaticlogin", "False") = "True"
    Registry_ActivateLogin /SysNative
    Registry_DeactivateDeviceLicensing /SysNative
  else
    Registry_DeactivateLogin /SysNative
  endif
else
  Registry_DeactivateLicensing /SysNative
  Registry_DeactivateLogin /SysNative
endif

[Registry_ActivateLicensing]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Office\ClickToRun\Configuration]
Set "SharedComputerLicensing" = REG_SZ:"1"

[Registry_ActivateLogin]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Office\ClickToRun\Configuration]
Set "SCLCacheOverride" = REG_SZ:"1"
Set "SCLCacheOverrideDirectory" = REG_EXPAND_SZ:"%appdata%\Microsoft\LicenseToken"

[Registry_DeactivateLicensing]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Office\ClickToRun\Configuration]
Set "SharedComputerLicensing" = REG_SZ:"0"

[Registry_DeactivateLogin]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Office\ClickToRun\Configuration]
Set "SCLCacheOverride" = REG_SZ:"0"
DeleteVar "SCLCacheOverrideDirectory"

[Registry_ActivateDeviceLicensing]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Office\ClickToRun\Configuration]
Set "DeviceBasedLicensing" = REG_SZ:"1"

[Registry_DeactivateDeviceLicensing]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Office\ClickToRun\Configuration]
Set "DeviceBasedLicensing" = REG_SZ:"0"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Microsoft Project 2021...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $License$
DefVar $Product$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Microsoft Project 2021"
Sub_Checks
Files_Copy
XMLPatch_Config "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\config.xml"
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_LinkFolderDesktop
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_Checks]
Sub_CheckWinVersion
Sub_CheckLicense
Sub_CheckProduct

[Sub_CheckWinVersion]
if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "10.0") < "0")
  LogError "Software needs Windows 10."
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_CheckLicense]
set $License$ = GetProductProperty("licensekey" , "")
if ($License$ = "")
  LogError "Fatal! License key not found"
  IsFatalError
endif

; Checks if Standard or ProPlus should be installed
[Sub_CheckProduct]
set $Product$ = "ProjectStd2021Volume"
if (GetProductProperty("product", "Standard") = "Professional")
  set $Product$ = "ProjectPro2021Volume"
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

;Writes the License, Version, and Path to the .xml
[XMLPatch_Config]
openNodeSet "Add/Product"
  SetAttribute "PIDKEY" value="$License$"
  SetAttribute "ID" value="$Product$"
openNodeSet "Add"
  SetAttribute "SourcePath" value="%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\setup.exe" /configure "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\config.xml"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolderDesktop]
if (GetProductProperty("desktopicon", "False") = "True")
    LinkFolder_Set64
else
  LinkFolder_Delete
endif

[LinkFolder_Set64]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Project"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\WINPROJ.EXE"
end_link

[LinkFolder_Delete]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Project"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Microsoft Schlaumäuse 1...
Encoding=UTF-8
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Arch$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Schlaumäuse 1"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_Copy
; Setup.exe starts a new process and terminats itself, so we need to wait for the new process instead
WinBatch_Setup /WaitForProcessEnding "_INS5576._MP"
Sub_HandleExitCode
Registry_Register
Files_CopyWrapper
LinkFolder_Program
LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
LinkFolder_DeleteFiles
DosInAnIcon_KillISDEL
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Arch$ = "x86"
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Setup.exe" /s /f1"%ScriptPath%\Schlaumaeuse_$Arch$.iss"

[Files_CopyWrapper]
copy -se "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Schlaumäuse1.bat" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Schlaumäuse\"
copy -se "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Schlaumäuse.ico" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Schlaumäuse\"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ;    0 ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Registry_Register]
openkey [HKLM\Software\Schlaumäuse\Schlaumäuse\1.00.000]
set "SavePath" = "H:\Schlaumäuse 1\Save"

[LinkFolder_Program]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Schlaumäuse"
set_link
  name: "Schlaumäuse 1"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Schlaumäuse\Schlaumäuse1.bat"
  icon_file: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Schlaumäuse\Schlaumäuse.ico"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Schlaumäuse"

[LinkFolder_DeleteFiles]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Schlaumäuse"
delete_element "Schlaumäuse ausführen"
delete_element "Schlaumäuse entfernen"

[DosInAnIcon_KillISDEL]
; Task stopped so that no reboot is carried out
taskkill /im "_ISDel.exe" /f

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

if (GetSystemType = "64 Bit System")
  WinBatch_Uninstall_64
else
  WinBatch_Uninstall_32
endif
Sub_HandleExitCode

[WinBatch_Uninstall_64]
"%ScriptPath%\data\Silverlight_x64.exe" /qu

[WinBatch_Uninstall_32]
"%ScriptPath%\data\Silverlight_x86.exe" /qu

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "1605" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 1605 ERROR_UNKNOWN_PRODUCT
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Microsoft Teams...
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Microsoft Teams"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_Copy
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Registry_Setup /SysNative
Sub_LinkFolder
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)
Set $Arch$ = "x64"
if GetSystemType = "x86 System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x86"
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\teamsbootstrapper.exe" -p -o "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\MSTeams-$Arch$.msix"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Registry_Setup]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Microsoft Teams]
Set "DisplayName" = REG_SZ:"Microsoft Teams"
Set "DisplayVersion" = REG_SZ:"$Version$"
Set "DisplayIcon" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\WindowsApps\MSTeams_$Version$_$Arch$__8wekyb3d8bbwe\ms-teams.exe"
Set "Publisher" = REG_SZ:"Microsoft Corporation"
Set "UninstallString" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\WindowsApps\MSTeams_$Version$_$Arch$__8wekyb3d8bbwe\ms-teams.exe"

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Setup

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Microsoft Teams.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif
endif

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Microsoft Teams"
  target: "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\WindowsApps\MSTeams_$Version$_$Arch$__8wekyb3d8bbwe\ms-teams.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Microsoft Teams"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\WindowsApps\MSTeams_$Version$_$Arch$__8wekyb3d8bbwe\ms-teams.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Microsoft Teams"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere Microsoft Teams...
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $InstVersion$
DefVar $RegVersion$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Microsoft Teams"
Sub_PrepareUninstall
Sub_Uninstall

[Sub_PrepareUninstall]
Set $InstVersion$ = GetValue("installedversion", GetProductMap)
if RegKeyExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Microsoft Teams")
  Set $RegVersion$ = getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Microsoft Teams", "DisplayVersion")
  if not(CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($InstVersion$, "=", $RegVersion$))
    Set $InstVersion$ = $RegVersion$
  endif
endif

Set $Arch$ = "x64"
if GetSystemType = "x86 System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x86"
endif

[Sub_Uninstall]
if FileExists("%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\WindowsApps\MSTeams_" + $InstVersion$ + "_" + $Arch$ + "__8wekyb3d8bbwe\ms-teams.exe")
  WinBatch_Uninstall
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  Sub_LinkFolder
  sleepSeconds 10
  Sub_Registry 
 ; Files_Delete
endif

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
powershell -command "Get-AppxPackage *MSTeams* -AllUsers | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_DeleteStartmenu

if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Microsoft Teams.LNK")
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_DeleteStartmenu]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Microsoft Teams"

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Microsoft Teams"

[Sub_Registry]
if RegKeyExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Microsoft Teams")
  Registry_DeleteUninstall /SysNative
endif

if RegKeyExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%")
  Registry_DeleteOPSI /SysNative
endif

[Registry_DeleteUninstall]
DeleteKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Microsoft Teams]

[Registry_DeleteOPSI]
DeleteKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]

;[Files_Delete]
;delete -sf "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\WindowsApps\MSTeams_26043.2016.4478.2773_x64__8wekyb3d8bbwe\"

Sub_Uninstall86
Sub_Uninstall64

[Sub_Uninstall86]

for $32Key$ in $RegKeyList$ do Sub_CheckKey32

[Sub_Uninstall64]
Set $RegKeyList$ = getRegistryKeyListSysnative("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall")
for $64Key$ in $RegKeyList$ do Sub_CheckKey64

[Sub_CheckKey32]
Set $RegKey$ = '$32Key$'
if RegVarExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\"+$RegKey$, "DisplayName")
  if contains(getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\"+$RegKey$, "DisplayName"), "Microsoft Visual C++ 2005")
    WinBatch_Uninstall
    Sub_HandleExitCodeUninstall
  endif
endif

[Sub_CheckKey64]
Set $RegKey$ = '$64Key$'
if RegVarExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\"+$RegKey$, "DisplayName")
  if contains(getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\"+$RegKey$, "DisplayName"), "Microsoft Visual C++ 2005")
    WinBatch_Uninstall
    Sub_HandleExitCodeUninstall
  endif
endif

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
msiexec /passive /x $RegKey$

[Sub_HandleExitCodeUninstall]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_UninstallOld]

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Microsoft Visual Studio Community 2026
DefStringList $RegKeyList$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Hostname$
DefVar $InstallParams$
DefVar $InstallLevel$
DefVar $InstallLevelOld$
DefVar $InstalledVersion$
DefVar $RegKey$
DefVar $SetupLevel$
DefVar $Test$
DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Microsoft Visual Studio Community 2026"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub_Setup
Registry_SaveInstallLevel /SysNative
Sub_LinkFolder

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Test$ = "0"
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))
Sub_GetParams

Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)
Set $RegKeyList$ = getRegistryKeyListSysnative("HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall")
for $Key$ in $RegKeyList$ do Sub_CheckKey

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[Sub_CheckKey]
Set $RegKey$ = '$Key$'
if RegVarExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\"+$RegKey$, "DisplayName")
  if contains(getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\"+$RegKey$, "DisplayName"), "Visual Studio Community 2026")
    Set $InstalledVersion$ = getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\"+$RegKey$, "DisplayVersion")
  endif
endif

[Sub_GetParams]
Set $SetupLevel$ = stringReplaceRegex(GetProductProperty("setuplevel", ""), '[\[\]\"]+', "")
Switch $SetupLevel$
  Case "Nur Visual Studio"
    Set $InstallParams$ = ""
    Set $InstallLevel$ = "0"
    if not(hasMinimumSpace("%Systemdrive%", "3GB"))
      LogError "Fatal: Setup requires at least 3GB free disk space!"
      IsFatalError
    endif
  EndCase
  Case "Visual Studio + allWorkloads"
    Set $InstallParams$ = "--allWorkloads"
    Set $InstallLevel$ = "1"
  EndCase
  Case "Visual Studio + allWorkloads + includeRecommended"
    Set $InstallParams$ = "--allWorkloads --includeRecommended"
    Set $InstallLevel$ = "2"
    if not(hasMinimumSpace("%Systemdrive%", "30GB"))
      LogError "Fatal: Setup requires at least 30GB free disk space!"
      IsFatalError
    endif
  EndCase
  Case "Visual Studio + allWorkloads + includeRecommended + includeOptional"
    Set $InstallParams$ = "--allWorkloads --includeRecommended --includeOptional"
    Set $InstallLevel$ = "3"
    if not(hasMinimumSpace("%Systemdrive%", "65GB"))
      LogError "Fatal: Setup requires at least 30GB free disk space!"
      IsFatalError
    endif
  EndCase
  ; Currently not working:
  ;Case "Komplett"
  ;  Set $InstallParams$ = "--all"
  ;  Set $InstallLevel$ = "4"
  ;  if not(hasMinimumSpace("%Systemdrive%", "210GB"))
  ;    LogError "Fatal: Setup requires at least 210GB free disk space!"
  ;    IsFatalError
  ;  endif
  ;EndCase
EndSwitch

[Sub_Setup]
if RegKeyExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%")
  Set $InstallLevelOld$ = getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%", "InstallLevel")
endif

if $InstallLevelOld$ = ""
  Set $InstallLevelOld$ = "10"
endif

if not(DirectoryExists("%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Microsoft Visual Studio\18"))
  WinBatch_Setup
  Sub_HandleExitCode
else
  if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($InstallLevelOld$, ">", $InstallLevel$)
    Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
    WinBatch_Setup
  else
    if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers($Version$, ">", $InstalledVersion$)
      WinBatch_Update
    else
      WinBatch_Reinstall
    endif
  endif
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

[Registry_SaveInstallLevel]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]
Set "InstallLevel" = REG_SZ:"$InstallLevel$"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"\\$Hostname$\appdata\%installingProdName%\vs_Community.exe" $InstallParams$ --nocache --noWeb --quiet --norestart --wait --noUpdateInstaller

[WinBatch_Update]
"\\$Hostname$\appdata\%installingProdName%\vs_Community.exe" update $InstallParams$ --installPath "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community" --noWeb --quiet --norestart --wait --noUpdateInstaller

[WinBatch_Reinstall]
"\\$Hostname$\appdata\%installingProdName%\vs_Community.exe" modify $InstallParams$ --installPath "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community" --noWeb --quiet --norestart --wait --noUpdateInstaller

[WinBatch_Repair]
"\\$Hostname$\appdata\%installingProdName%\vs_Community.exe" repair --installPath "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community" --noWeb --passive --norestart --wait --noUpdateInstaller

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if FileExists("%CommonProgramsDir%\Visual Studio Installer.LNK")
  LinkFolder_Cleanup
endif

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Visual Studio Community 2026.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif
endif

[LinkFolder_Cleanup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Visual Studio Installer"

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Visual Studio Community 2026"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\Common7\IDE\devenv.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\Common7\IDE"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Visual Studio Community 2026"

[opsiservicecall_Install_SDK]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "microsoft-windows-sdk",
  "",
  "setup"
]

################################################################################
PAKET: microsoft-windows-11-hardware-readiness-script
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/microsoft-windows-11-hardware-readiness-script/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Microsoft Windows 11 Hardware Readiness...
DefVar $Hostname$
DefVar $ErrorMessage$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $jsonString$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Microsoft Windows 11 Hardware Readiness"
include_insert "%ScriptDrive%\tools\scripts\report-error-init.inc.ins"
Files_Copy
Sub_PrepareSetup
DosInAnIcon_PowerShell_ExecutionPolicy
Sub_OutputResult
Files_Cleanup
Sub_HandleExitCode

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[DosInAnIcon_PowerShell_ExecutionPolicy]
powershell.exe Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned

[Sub_OutputResult]
set $jsonString$ = TakeString(2, getOutStreamFromSection("DosInAnIcon_PowerShell_Script"))
set $ExitCode$ = jsonAsObjectGetValueByKey($jsonString$, "returnCode")
if $ExitCode$ = '"0"'
  PatchTextFile_Output "\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\microsoft-windows-11-hardware-readiness\Success\%PCName%.txt"
else
  PatchTextFile_Output "\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\microsoft-windows-11-hardware-readiness\Failed\%PCName%.txt"
endif

[DosInAnIcon_PowerShell_Script]
powershell.exe -F "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\HardwareReadiness.ps1"

[PatchTextFile_Output]
GoToTop
AdvanceLine 1
DeleteTheLine
AddLine '$jsonString$'

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if $ExitCode$ = '"1"'
  set $ErrorMessage$ = "Das System ist nicht mit Windows 11 kompatibel. Weitere Informationen sind aus der Logdatei entnehmbar (siehe Hinweis)."
  set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $ErrorMessage$)
  Sub_ReportError
  LogError "Fatal: system is not capable of running Windows 11"
  IsFatalError
else
  if $ExitCode$ = '"-1"'
    set $ErrorMessage$ = "Einer oder mehrere Hardware-Checks konnten nicht korrekt beendet werden. Weitere Informationen sind aus der Logdatei entnehmbar (siehe Hinweis)."
    set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $ErrorMessage$)
    Sub_ReportError
    LogError "Fatal: one or more of the hardware requirement checks failed"
    IsFatalError
  else
    if $ExitCode$ = '"-2"'
      set $ErrorMessage$ = "Beim Skript ist ein Fehler aufgetreten. Weitere Informationen sind aus der Logdatei entnehmbar (siehe Hinweis)"
      set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", $ErrorMessage$)
      Sub_ReportError
      LogError "Fatal: script encountered an error"
      IsFatalError
    endif
  endif
endif

    IsFatalError

################################################################################
PAKET: microsoft-windows-essentials
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/microsoft-windows-essentials/install.ins
################################################################################

; Source: http://windows.microsoft.com/en-US/windows-live/essentials-install-offline-faq
; Doku: http://www.mydigitallife.info/windows-live-essentials-unattended-silent-setup-installation-switches/
; Doku: http://forums.mydigitallife.info/threads/36086-Windows-Essentials-2012-Unattend-Install

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Microsoft Windows Essentials...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Components$
DefStringList $Componentlist$

[Aktionen]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Windows Essentials"
Sub_EnsureWin7
Sub_PrepareComponentList
Sub_RemovePreviousVersion
Sub_Setup

[Sub_EnsureWin7]
; Check if OS is Windows 7 or higher
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "6.1") = "-1"
  LogError "Operating System is not supported!"
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_PrepareComponentList]
; Prepare the list of components
if GetProductProperty("instMail", "False") = "True"
  Set $Componentlist$ = addtolist($Componentlist$, "Mail")
endif
if GetProductProperty("instMessenger", "False") = "True"
  Set $Componentlist$ = addtolist($Componentlist$, "Messenger")
endif
if GetProductProperty("instMovieMaker", "True") = "True"
  Set $Componentlist$ = addtolist($Componentlist$, "MovieMaker")
endif
if GetProductProperty("instWriter", "False") = "True"
  Set $Componentlist$ = addtolist($Componentlist$, "Writer")
endif
; Make comma separated string out of the list
if count($Componentlist$) > "0"
  Set $Components$ = composeString($Componentlist$,",")
else
  LogError "Fatal! No components selected."
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_RemovePreviousVersion]
if FileExists("%ProgramFilesDir%\Windows Live\Installer\wlarp.exe")
  WinBatch_Uninstall
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
"%ProgramFilesDir%\Windows Live\Installer\wlarp.exe" /cleanup:all /q

[Sub_Setup]
Files_Copy
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "6.1") = "0"
  ; Windows 7
  ; The installation will fail with a lot of ERROR_DLL_INIT_FAILED errors
  ; without the /RunElevated parameter
  WinBatch_Setup /RunElevated
else
  ; Windows 8 or higher
  ; The installation will fail with a 0x80040800 exit code with the
  ; /RunElevated parameter
  WinBatch_Setup
endif
Sub_HandleExitCode
Files_Cleanup

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%SystemDrive%\tmp\we"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%SystemDrive%\tmp\we\wlsetup-all.exe" /q /NOToolbarCEIP /NOhomepage /nolaunch /NOMU /nosearch /AppSelect:$Components$ /Log:"C:\tmp\essentials.log"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%SystemDrive%\tmp\we\"

Sub_Setup

[Sub_Prepare]
Set $Log$ = "%opsiLogDir%\wusa.log"

if (GetSystemType = "x86 System")
  Set $Arch$ = "x86"
else
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
endif

Set $FileName$ = "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Windows6.1-KB2819745-" + $Arch$ + "-MultiPkg.msu"

[Sub_Setup]
; Install only on Windows 7
if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "=", "6.1"))
  Files_Copy
  Sub_Prepare
  WinBatch_Setup /SysNative
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  Files_Cleanup
  ExitWindows /Reboot
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
wusa "$FileName$" /norestart /quiet /log:"$Log$"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "Last exit code: " + $ExitCode$
; If exit code is 2359302, the hotfix is already installed
if not ($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "2359302" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  LogError "Fatal: wusa returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"
delete "$Log$"

; http://www.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/organizations/all.html

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Mozilla Firefox"
DosInAnIcon_KillFirefox
Sub_PrepareSetup
WinBatch_Install
Sub_HandleExitCode

Files_CopyConfig
Sub_CheckConfig
Sub_SetSearchEngine
Sub_SetDefault
Sub_SetSignOn
Sub_SetHomepage
Sub_SignAddons
Sub_3rdCookies

[DosInAnIcon_KillFirefox]
; Firefox needs to be killed to prevent a reboot dialog and to overwrite
; Adblock Plus.
taskkill /im "firefox.exe" /f

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)
Set $Arch$ = "x86"
if (GetSystemType = "64 Bit System")
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
endif

[WinBatch_Install]
msiexec /passive /i "%ScriptPath%\data\$Arch$\Firefox Setup $Version$.msi" /qb!

[Sub_CheckExe]
if not(FileExists("%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\firefox.exe"))
  LogError "Fatal: firefox.exe not found"
  IsFatalError
endif    

[Files_CopyConfig]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\add\*" "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\"

[Sub_CheckConfig]
Set $InstalluBlock$ = GetProductProperty("installuBlock", "True")
if not($InstalluBlock$ = "True")
  Files_RemoveAddon
  Registry_DeleteAddOn /SysNative
  Registry_DeleteAddOn /32bit
else
  Registry_RegisterAddOn /SysNative
  Registry_RegisterAddOn /32bit
endif

[Files_RemoveAddon]
delete -f "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\browser\extensions\*"

[Registry_RegisterAddOn]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Mozilla\Firefox\Extensions]
set "uBlock0@raymondhill.net.xpi" = "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\browser\extensions\uBlock0@raymondhill.net.xpi"

[Registry_DeleteAddOn]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Mozilla\Firefox\Extensions]
DeleteVar "uBlock0@raymondhill.net.xpi"

[Sub_SetSearchEngine]
Sub_SetSearchEngineVariables
Sub_AdditionalSearchEngine

[Sub_SetSearchEngineVariables]
if (GetProductProperty("searchprovider", "") = "DuckDuckGo")
  Set $Searchprovider$ = "DuckDuckGo"
EndIf

if (GetProductProperty("searchprovider", "") = "Ecosia")
  Set $Searchprovider$ = "Ecosia"
EndIf

if (GetProductProperty("searchprovider", "") = "fragFINN.de")
  Set $Searchprovider$ = "fragFINN.de"
EndIf

if (GetProductProperty("searchprovider", "") = "Google")
  Set $Searchprovider$ = "Google"
EndIf

[Sub_AdditionalSearchEngine]
if ($Searchprovider$ = "DuckDuckGo" OR $Searchprovider$ = "Ecosia" OR $Searchprovider$ = "Google")
  Registry_SetupSearchEngine
EndIf

; README für Vorlage, um weitere Suchmaschinen hinzuzufügen.
if (GetProductProperty("searchprovider", "") = "fragFINN.de")
  Registry_RemoveAdditionalSearchEngine  
  Registry_AddSearchEngine_fragFINN.de
  Registry_SetupSearchEngine
EndIf

[Registry_SetupSearchEngine]
; Set default search provider
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Policies\Mozilla\Firefox\SearchEngines]
set "Default"=REG_SZ:"$Searchprovider$"
set "DefaultSearchProviderEnabled"=REG_DWORD:1

[Registry_AddSearchEngine_fragFINN.de]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Policies\Mozilla\Firefox\SearchEngines\Add\1]
set "Name"=REG_SZ:"fragFINN.de"
set "URLTemplate"=REG_SZ:"https://www.fragfinn.de/?s={searchTerms}"
set "Method"=REG_SZ:"GET"
set "IconURL"=REG_SZ:"https://fragfinn.de/favicon.ico"
set "Alias"=REG_SZ:"fragFINN.de"
set "Description"=REG_SZ:"Die Suchmaschine für Kinder."
set "SuggestURLTemplate"=REG_SZ:"https://www.fragfinn.de/?s={searchTerms}&type=list"
set "PostData"=REG_SZ:"name=value&q={searchTerms}"

[Sub_SetDefault]
; Set Firefox as default browser if set in the web interface
Set $DefaultBrowser$ = GetProductProperty("defaultbrowser", "True")
if ($DefaultBrowser$ = "True")
  WinBatch_SetDefault
  Sub_HandleExitCode
endif

[WinBatch_SetDefault]
; Don't use "firefox.exe -silent -nosplash -setDefaultBrowser" to set the
; default browser - it is not necessarily silent.
"%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\uninstall\helper.exe" /SetAsDefaultAppGlobal

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "2")
  ; helper.exe returns exit code 2 for some reason
  ; seems to be by design, but is pretty much undocumented
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_SetSignOn]
Set $pwdMngr$ = GetProductProperty("disablePwdManager", "False")
if ($pwdMngr$ = "True")
  PatchTextFile_mozillacfg "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\mozilla.cfg"
endif

[PatchTextFile_mozillacfg]
Set_Mozilla_Pref("lockPref", "signon.rememberSignons", false)
Set_Mozilla_Pref("lockPref", "signon.prefillForms", false)

[Sub_SetHomepage]
if not(GetProductProperty("defaultStartpage", "") = "")
  Set $Homepage$ = GetProductProperty("defaultStartpage", "")
Else
  OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Servername
  Set $Servername$ = takeString(0, getReturnListFromSection("OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Servername"))
  Set $Homepage$ = "http://"+$Servername$+"/iserv/"
EndIf
PatchTextFile_homepage "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\mozilla.cfg"

[OpsiServiceCall_IservCfg_Servername]
"method": "iserv_cfg"
"params": [
      "Servername"
]

[PatchTextFile_homepage]
Set_Mozilla_Pref("defaultPref", "browser.startup.homepage", "data:text/plain,browser.startup.homepage=$Homepage$")

[Sub_SignAddons]
if GetProductProperty("requireSignedAddons", "False") = "False"
  PatchTextFile_Addons "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\mozilla.cfg"
endif

[PatchTextFile_Addons]
Set_Mozilla_Pref("pref", "xpinstall.signatures.required", false)

[Sub_3rdCookies]
if GetProductProperty("3rdcookies", "False") = "True"
  Registry_Setup3rdCookies
endif

[Registry_Setup3rdCookies]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Policies\Mozilla\Firefox\Cookies]
set "AcceptThirdParty"=REG_SZ:"always"

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Firefox.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif
endif

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Firefox"
  target: "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\firefox.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]

  if not(FileExists("%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\Uninstall\uninstall.log"))
    DosInAnIcon_CreateEmptyFile
  endif
  DosInAnIcon_KillFirefox
  WinBatch_Uninstall
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  sleepSeconds 30
  Registry_CleanupSearchEngines
  Files_Cleanup
endif

; Firefox needs to be killed to prevent a reboot dialog and to overwrite Adblock Plus.
taskkill /F /IM firefox.exe

"%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\Uninstall\helper.exe" -ms

; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

DeleteKey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Policies\Mozilla]

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\"
delete -sf "%CommonAppDataDir%\Mozilla-1de4eec8-1241-4177-a864-e594e8d1fb38\"

  Sub_HandleExitCode

  IsFatalError

    ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
    ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_CopyConfig]

  Files_CopyConfig
  Files_RemoveLocalConf
else
  LogWarning "Warning: Tried to copy config from Appdata but no BaseProperties.ser was found."
endif

[Files_CopyConfig]

[Files_RemoveLocalConf]

endif

  "Hostname"

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Arch$ = "x64"
if GetSystemType = "x86 System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
endif

Set $Path$ = "%ScriptPath%\data"
Switch GetProductProperty("version", "9.7")
  Case "9.1"
    Set $Path$ = $Path$ + "\9.1"
  EndCase
  Case "9.5"
    Set $Path$ = $Path$ + "\9.5"
  EndCase
  Case "9.6"
    Set $Path$ = $Path$ + "\9.6"
  EndCase
  Case "9.7"
    Set $Path$ = $Path$ + "\9.7"
  EndCase
  Case "andere"
    if FileExists("\\iserv\appdata\%installingProdName%\Version_" + $Arch$ + ".msi")
      Set $Path$ = "\\iserv\appdata\%installingProdName%"
    else
      LogError "Fatal: no installer found!"
      IsFatalError
    endif
  EndCase
EndSwitch

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "$Path$\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\Vision.ini" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
; Install command based on product documentation
msiexec /passive /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Vision_$Arch$.msi" /norestart

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Initial]
Message=Installiere NetOp Vision 9 - Lehrer...
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Path$
DefVar $Password$
DefVar $ProductKey$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "NetOp Vision 9"
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_Copy
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_LinkFolder
Files_Cleanup
ExitWindows /Reboot

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $ProductKey$ = GetProductProperty("productkey", "")
if $ProductKey$ = ""
  LogError "Fatal! No product key found!"
  IsFatalError
endif

Set $Arch$ = "x64"
if GetSystemType = "x86 System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x86"
endif

SetLogLevel=4
Set $Password$ = GetProductProperty("password", "")
SetConfidential $Password$
SetLogLevel=7

if not($Password$ = "" or $ProductKey$ = "")
  Patches_Config "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Vision.ini"
endif

Set $Path$ = "%ScriptPath%\data\"
Switch GetProductProperty("version", "9.7")
  Case "9.1"
    Set $Path$ = $Path$ + "\9.1"
  EndCase
  Case "9.5"
    Set $Path$ = $Path$ + "\9.5"
  EndCase
  Case "9.6"
    Set $Path$ = $Path$ + "\9.6"
  EndCase
  Case "9.7"
    Set $Path$ = $Path$ + "\9.7"
  EndCase
  Case "andere"
    if FileExists("\\iserv\appdata\%installingProdName%\Vision_" + $Arch$ + ".msi")
      Set $Path$ = "\\iserv\appdata\%installingProdName%"
    else
      LogError "Fatal: no installer found!"
      IsFatalError
    endif
  EndCase
EndSwitch

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "$Path$\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\Vision.ini" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Patches_Config]
set [PROPERTIES] MELICVISION=$ProductKey$
set [PROPERTIES] MEMASTERPASSWORD=$Password$

[WinBatch_Setup]
; Install command based on product documentation
msiexec /passive /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Vision_$Arch$.msi" /norestart

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Vision Lehrer"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Netop\Vision\XL\MeSuAx.exe"
  parameters: "/invokeVerb:OpenDashboard"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Vision Lehrer"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $ProductKey$ = GetProductProperty("productkey", "")
if $ProductKey$ = ""
  LogError "Fatal! No product key found!"
  IsFatalError
endif
Set $Arch$ = "x86"
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Patches_Config]
set [PROPERTIES] MELICVISION=$ProductKey$ 

[Sub_Password]

  Patches_Config2 "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Vision.ini"
endif

[Patches_Config2]
set [PROPERTIES] MEMASTERPASSWORD=$Password$

[WinBatch_Setup]
; Install command based on product documentation
msiexec /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Vision_$Arch$.msi" /qb! /norestart /l*v "%opsiLogDir%\%installingProdName%.log"

; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
    ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
else
    if $ExitCode$ = "3010"
        comment "Initiating request reboot..."
	ExitWindows /Reboot
    endif
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"
delete -f "%opsiLogDir%\%installingProdName%.log"

[Initial]

Set $name$ = GetProductProperty("name", "")
Set $serial$ = GetProductProperty("serial", "")
Set $max$ = GetProductProperty("max", "")
Set $date$ = GetProductProperty("date", "")
Set $code$ = GetProductProperty("code", "")
Set $room$ = GetProductProperty("room", "Eval")
Set $student$ = GetProductProperty("student", "true")
Set $teacher$ = GetProductProperty("teacher", "false")
Set $it$ = GetProductProperty("it", "false")

if ($name$ = "" or $serial$ = "" or $max$ = "" or $date$ = "" or $code$ = "")
    LogError "Fatal: Incomplete licence informations."
    IsFatalError
endif

if ($platform$ = "Nur Chrome Schüler")
  Set $student$ = "false"
else 
  if ($platform$ = "Nur Tablet Schüler")
    Set $student$ = "false"
    Set $it$ = "false"
  endif
endif

if ($student$ = "false" and $teacher$ = "false" and $it$ = "false")
    LogError "Fatal: No version selected."
    IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%ScriptPath%\install.exe" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\NetSupport School.msi" "$platform$" "$name$" "$serial$" "$max$" "$date$" "$code$" "$student$" "$teacher$" "$it$" "$room$"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Initial]
Message=Installiere National Instruments Multisim...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Name$
DefVar $Company$
DefVar $SerialNo$
DefVar $WinstRegKey$
DefVar $RebootFlag$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Multisim"
Sub_PrepareReboot
Sub_RebootUninstall
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_Copy
Patches_setup.txt "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\setup.txt"
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Files_Cleanup
Registry_RemoveBootFlag /32bit
Sub_Reboot

[Sub_PrepareReboot]
;To check if we ware before or after the reboot, this regKey is needed.
Set $WinstRegKey$ = "HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\"+"%installingProdName%"
Set $RebootFlag$ = GetRegistryStringValue32("["+$WinstRegKey$+"] "+"RebootFlag")

[Sub_RebootUninstall]
if FileExists("%ProgramFiles32Dir%\National Instruments\Shared\NIUninstaller\uninst.exe")
  if (not($RebootFlag$ = "1"))
    Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
    Set $RebootFlag$ = "1"
    Registry_SaveRebootFlag /32bit
    opsiservicecall_Reinstall
    Sub_ImmReboot
  endif
endif

[Registry_SaveRebootFlag]
openKey [$WinstRegKey$]
set "RebootFlag" = "$RebootFlag$"

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "setup"
]

[Sub_ImmReboot]
ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Name$ = GetProductProperty("name" , "")
Set $Company$ = GetProductProperty("company" , "")
Set $SerialNo$ = GetProductProperty("serialno" , "")
if ($SerialNo$ = "")
  LogError "Fatal! Serialnumber not found"
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"
copy "%ScriptPath%\setup.txt" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Patches_setup.txt]
set [UserInfo] Name=$Name$
set [UserInfo] Company=$Company$
set [UserInfo] SerialNo=$SerialNo$

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%ScriptDrive%\tools\AutoIt3.exe" "%ScriptPath%\install.au3" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\setup.exe" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\setup.txt"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Registry_RemoveBootFlag]
deletekey [$WinstRegKey$]

[Sub_Reboot]
;reboot after installation
ExitWindows /Reboot

EndIf

  Set $Ssl$ = "0"

EndIf

  Set $Proxy$ = GetProductProperty("proxy", "")
EndIf

EndIf
if not(GetProductProperty("proxyuser", "") = "")
  Set $ProxyUser$ = GetProductProperty("proxyuser", "")
EndIf
if not(GetProductProperty("proxypassword", "") = "")
  Set $ProxyPassword$ = GetProductProperty("proxypassword", "")
EndIf

if not(GetProductProperty("tag", "") = "")
  Set $Tag$ = GetProductProperty("tag", "")
endif

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\OCS-Windows-Agent-Setup-x64.exe" /S /server=$Server$ /ssl=$Ssl$ /ca=$CaPath$ /user=$ServerUser$ /pwd=$ServerPassword$ /proxy_type=$ProxyType$ /proxy=$Proxy$ /proxy_Port=$ProxyPort$ /proxy_user=$Proxyuser$ /proxy_pwd=$ProxyPassword$ /tag=$Tag$

; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode

if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "1605" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 1605 ERROR_UNKNOWN_PRODUCT

  IsFatalError

Set $Dir$ = "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\ojdkbuild"
ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramsFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"

if (GetSystemType = "64 Bit System")
  Set $Dir$ = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\ojdkbuild"
  ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramsFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"
endif

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramsFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "$Dir$"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

;
Set $NewJdkVersion$ = "jdk1.8.0_202"
Set $DirName$ = "jdk1.8"

WinBatch_Uninstall
Sub_HandleExitCode_Remove
Files_CleanupOld
Files_Copy32
WinBatch_Setup32

  Sub_HandleExitCode_Remove
  Files_CleanupOld64
  Files_Copy64
  WinBatch_Setup64
  Sub_HandleExitCode

if (GetProductProperty("docs", "False") = "True")
  Files_CopyDocs
endif

[Sub_DeletePreviousJDK]
Set $Path$ = EnvVar("Path")
; Remove all elements containing jdk1.8
DefStringList $Paths$
Set $Paths$ = splitString($Path$, ";")
Set $Paths$ = removeFromListByContaining("jdk1.8", $Paths$)
Set $Path$ = composeString($Paths$, ";")
Registry_DeleteJDK

[Registry_DeleteJDK]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\control\Session Manager\Environment]
DeleteVar "JDK_HOME"
DeleteVar "JDK32_HOME"
Set "Path" = '$Path$'

[Files_Copy32]

[Files_Copy64]

copy -se "%ScriptDrive%\install\oracle-java-jdk-8\data\$NewJdkVersion$_x64\" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\$NewJdkVersion$_x64\"

[WinBatch_Setup32]
; Logging aktivieren: /l*v C:\tmp\msi32.log
msiexec /passive /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\$NewJdkVersion$\$NewJdkVersion$.msi" INSTALLDIR="%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Java\$DirName$\"

[WinBatch_Setup64]
; Logging aktivieren: /l*v C:\tmp\msi64.log
msiexec /passive /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\$NewJdkVersion$_x64\$NewJdkVersion$64.msi" INSTALLDIR="%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Java\$DirName$\"

[Sub_RegisterJDK]
Set $Path$ = GetRegistrystringvalueSysNative("[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\control\Session Manager\Environment] Path")
Registry_RegisterJDK

[Registry_RegisterJDK]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\control\Session Manager\Environment]
set "JDK_HOME" = "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Java\$DirName$\"
set "JDK32_HOME" = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Java\$DirName$\"
set "Path" = '$Path$'
supp "Path"; "%JDK_HOME%bin"

[Files_CopyDocs]
copy -seu "\\iserv\appdata\oracle-java-jdk-8\docs\*" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Java\$DirName$\docs"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_HandleExitCode_Remove]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "1605" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 1605 ERROR_UNKNOWN_PRODUCT
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Files_CleanupOld]
delete -sf "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Java\$DirName$\"

[Files_CleanupOld64]
delete -sf "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Java\$DirName$\"

[Sub_PrepareUninstall]

  if not($RebootFlag$ = "1")
    Sub_UninstallOrange3
    sleepSeconds 120
    Sub_UninstallMiniconda3
    sleepSeconds 60
    LinkFolder_Delete
    Set $RebootFlag$ = "1"
    Registry_SaveRebootFlag /SysNative
    opsiservicecall_Reinstall
    ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot
  endif
endif
Registry_RemoveBootFlag /SysNative

  IsFatalError
endif

    LinkFolder_Delete
  endif

if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, ">=", "6.1")
  Set $LicensePath$ = "%SystemDrive%\ProgramData\Oriolus_Lernprogramme\Freischaltung\"
else
  Set $LicensePath$ = "%SystemDrive%\Oriolus\"
endif
Files_CopyLicense

[Files_CopyLicense]
copy "\\$Hostname$\appdata\oriolus\licenses\*.fsc" $LicensePath$

[PatchTextFile_Netzwerk.ini]
GoToTop
FindLine_StartingWith "LZKVERZEICHNIS="
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine "LZKVERZEICHNIS="

[PatchTextFile_Netzwerk.ini_Hostname]
GoToTop
FindLine_StartingWith "LZKVERZEICHNIS="
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine "LZKVERZEICHNIS=\\$Hostname$\appdata\oriolus\userdata"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

    ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
    ; 1605 ERROR_UNKNOWN_PRODUCT
    ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

################################################################################
PAKET: oriolus-foerderprogramm
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/oriolus-foerderprogramm/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Oriolus Modul - Förderprogramm...
DefVar $ExitCode$
Encoding=UTF-8

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Oriolus Modul - Förderprogramm"
Files_Copy
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_LinkFolder
Registry_Setup
Files_Cleanup

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\oriolus_foerderprogramm_setup.exe" /VERYSILENT /DIR="%Systemdrive%\Oriolus\FP"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Oriolus Förderprogramm"
  target: "%Systemdrive%\Oriolus\FP\oriolus_lernprogramme_starten.exe"
  parameters: '"%Systemdrive%\Oriolus\FP\Vorschule\vorschul.ori"'
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Oriolus Förderprogramm"

[Registry_Setup]
openkey [HKLM\Software\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\"Oriolus Förderprogramm" - DVD 63_is1]
set "DisplayName" = REG_SZ:"Oriolus Förderprogramm"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

################################################################################
ENDE: oriolus-foerderprogramm/install.ins
################################################################################

DefVar $ExitCode$

LinkFolder_Cleanup

[Sub_Uninstall]

    WinBatch_Uninstall

[WinBatch_Uninstall]

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Oriolus Lernprogramme...
DefVar $Hostname$
DefVar $LicensePath$
DefVar $OriolusAppdata$
DefVar $SchoolId$
DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Oriolus Lernprogramme"
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_CopyLauncher
Files_CopyAdd
Files_CopyNetwork
Sub_SetLocalInstall
Registry_Setup /SysNative
Sub_LinkFolder
Sub_License

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))
Set $OriolusAppdata$ = "\\"+$Hostname$+"\appdata\oriolus"
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion",  GetProductMap)
Set $SchoolId$ = GetProductProperty("schoolid", "")

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[Files_CopyLauncher]
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\oriolus_lernprogramme_starten.exe" "%SystemDrive%\Oriolus\"

[Files_CopyAdd]
copy -s "%ScriptPath%\data\add\*" "%SystemDrive%\Oriolus\"

[Files_CopyNetwork]
copy "$OriolusAppdata$\netzwerk.ini" "%SystemDrive%\Oriolus\"

[Sub_SetLocalInstall]
if GetProductProperty("localinst", "False") = "True"
  PatchTextFile_Network "%SystemDrive%\Oriolus\netzwerk.ini"
else
  PatchTextFile_Hostname "%SystemDrive%\Oriolus\netzwerk.ini"
endif

[Registry_Setup]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Oriolus Lernprogramme]
set "DisplayIcon" = REG_SZ:"%SystemDrive%\Oriolus\oriolus_lernprogramme_starten.exe"
set "DisplayName" = REG_SZ:"Oriolus Lernprogramme"
set "DisplayVersion" = REG_SZ:"$Version$"
set "HelpLink" = REG_EXPAND_SZ:"https://www.oriolus.de/index.php"
set "InstallLocation" = REG_SZ:"%SystemDrive%\Oriolus\oriolus_lernprogramme_starten.exe"
set "Publisher" = REG_SZ:"Oriolus Lernprogramme GmbH"
set "UninstallString" = REG_SZ:"%SystemDrive%\Oriolus\oriolus_lernprogramme_starten.exe"

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Startmenu

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Oriolus Lernprogramme.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif
endif

[LinkFolder_Startmenu]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Oriolus Lernprogramme"
  target: "%SystemDrive%\Oriolus\oriolus_lernprogramme_starten.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Oriolus Lernprogramme"
  target: "%SystemDrive%\Oriolus\oriolus_lernprogramme_starten.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Oriolus Lernprogramme"

[Sub_License]
;Copy license
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, ">=", "6.1")
  Set $LicensePath$ = "%CommonAppdataDir%\Oriolus_Lernprogramme\Freischaltung\"
else
  Set $LicensePath$ = "%SystemDrive%\Oriolus\"
endif
Files_CopyLicense

[Files_CopyLicense]
copy "\\$Hostname$\appdata\oriolus\licenses\*.fsc" $LicensePath$

[PatchTextFile_Network]
GoToTop
FindLine_StartingWith "LZKVERZEICHNIS="
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine "LZKVERZEICHNIS="

[PatchTextFile_Hostname]
GoToTop
FindLine_StartingWith "LZKVERZEICHNIS="
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine "LZKVERZEICHNIS=\\$Hostname$\appdata\oriolus\userdata"
FindLine_StartingWith "ORIOLUS_SCHUL_ID="
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine "ORIOLUS_SCHUL_ID=$SchoolId$"

ENDE: oriolus-main/install.ins
################################################################################


################################################################################
PAKET: oriolus-main
DATEI: remove.inc.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/oriolus-main/remove.inc.ins
################################################################################

Sub_Uninstall

[Sub_Uninstall]
if DirectoryExists("%SystemDrive%\Oriolus")
  Registry_Cleanup /SysNative
  Sub_LinkFolderUninst
  Files_Delete
endif

[Registry_Cleanup]
DeleteKey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Oriolus Lernprogramme]

[Sub_LinkFolderUninst]
if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Oriolus Lernprogramme.LNK")
  LinkFolder_RemoveDesktop
endif

if FileExists("%CommonProgramsDir%\Oriolus Lernprogramme.LNK")
  LinkFolder_RemoveStartmenu
endif

[LinkFolder_RemoveDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Oriolus Lernprogramme"

[LinkFolder_RemoveStartmenu]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Oriolus Lernprogramme"

[Files_Delete]
delete -sf "%SystemDrive%\Oriolus\"
delete -sf "%CommonAppdataDir%\Oriolus_Lernprogramme\"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\MAXON"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Paint.NET...
DefVar $DesktopIcon$

DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Paint.NET"
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub_HandleExitCode
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
;Needs .Net v4.5.2 or higher
if not(FileExists("C:\WINDOWS\Microsoft.NET\Framework\v4.0.30319"))
  LogError "Fatal: Microsoft .Net not installed!"
  IsFatalError
endif  

; Check if OS is newer or equal to Windows 7
if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "6.1") < "0")
  LogError "Minimum supported OS Version is Windows 7."
  IsFatalError
endif

Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)
If GetSystemType = "x86 System"
   LogError "Setup is only for 64 Bit systems!"
   IsFatalError
endif

Set $DesktopIcon$ = "0"
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  Set $DesktopIcon$ = "1"
endif

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /passive /i "%ScriptPath%\data\paint.net.$Version$.winmsi.x64.msi" DESKTOPSHORTCUT=$DesktopIcon$

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

################################################################################
PAKET: pdf-xchange-editor
DATEI: remove.inc.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/pdf-xchange-editor/remove.inc.ins
################################################################################

DefStringList $RegKeyList$
DefVar $RegKey$

Sub_PrepareUninstall

[Sub_PrepareUninstall]
Set $Arch$ = "x64"
if GetSystemType = "x86 System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x86"
endif

if $Arch$ = "x64"
  Sub_Uninstall64
else
  Sub_Uninstall86
endif

[Sub_Uninstall64]
if FileExists("%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Tracker Software\PDF Editor\PDFXEdit.exe")
  Set $RegKeyList$ = getRegistryKeyListSysnative("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall")
  for $64Key$ in $RegKeyList$ do Sub_CheckKey64
endif

[Sub_CheckKey64]
Set $RegKey$ = '$64Key$'
if RegVarExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\"+$RegKey$, "DisplayName")
  if contains(getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\"+$RegKey$, "DisplayName"), "PDF-XChange Editor")
    WinBatch_Uninstall
    Sub_HandleExitCodeUninst
    Sub_LinkFolderUninst
  endif
endif

[Sub_Uninstall86]
if FileExists("%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Tracker Software\PDF Editor\PDFXEdit.exe")
  Set $RegKeyList$ = getRegistryKeyListSysnative("HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall")
  for $86Key$ in $RegKeyList$ do Sub_CheckKey86
endif

[Sub_CheckKey86]
Set $RegKey$ = '$86Key$'
if RegVarExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\"+$RegKey$, "DisplayName")
  if contains(getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\"+$RegKey$, "DisplayName"), "PDF-XChange Editor")
    WinBatch_Uninstall
    Sub_HandleExitCodeUninst
    Sub_LinkFolderUninst
  endif
endif

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
msiexec /x $RegKey$ MSIRESTARTMANAGERCONTROL=Disable /passive
; 'MSIRESTARTMANAGERCONTROL=Disable' uninstall without explorer.exe crushed
; not possible: "%ScriptDrive%\tools\autoit\msiRemove_withLog.exe" "PDF-XChange Editor"

[Sub_HandleExitCodeUninst]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "1605" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
    ; 1605 ERROR_UNKNOWN_PRODUCT
    ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolderUninst]
if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\PDF-XChange Editor.LNK")
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere PHYWE measureAPP...
DefVar $ExitCode$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "PHYWE measureAPP"
WinBatch_Uninstall_Drv
Files_Cleanup
LinkFolder_Setup
ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"

[WinBatch_Uninstall_Drv]
msiexec /X{1A7ED989-C111-46A0-BEAE-9CA31EE53AE7} /passive

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\measureAPP\"

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "PHYWE"
delete_element "measureAPP"
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "measureAPP"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\PHYWE"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

  LogError "Fatal: name not set"
  IsFatalError

  LogError "Fatal: productkey not set"
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_HandleExitCode_Setup]

  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Registry_DeleteLicense]
; delete the old license information so that the activation is predictable

[Sub_HandleExitCode_Activate]

if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  if ($ExitCode$ = "4")
    LogWarning "Warning: Program didn't open, might be an error. Exit code: " + $ExitCode$
  else
    LogError "Fatal: activation returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
  endif
endif

Sub_HandleExitCode

  LogError "Fatal! No product key found!"
  IsFatalError

Set $Username$ = GetProductProperty("username", "")

[XMLPatch_License]
- warning_when_no_node_existing false
- create_when_node_not_existing false

  IsFatalError

[Sub_LinkFolder]

  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

  name: "Promethean ActivSuite"

  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Promethean ActivSuite\"

path = "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\ProSaldo"

  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If
