[Initial]
Message=Installiere Python...
DefStringList $Modules$
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $EnvironmentVariables$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Hostname$
DefVar $InstallPath$
DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Python"
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_Copy
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_PrepareModules
Registry_Setup /SysNative
Sub_LinkFolder
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)
Set $Arch$ = ""
Set $InstallPath$ = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Python314-32"
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "-amd64"
  Set $InstallPath$ = "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Python314"
endif

Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))

if GetProductProperty("environment_variables", "False") = "True"
  Set $EnvironmentVariables$ = "1"
else
  Set $EnvironmentVariables$ = "0"
endif

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[Files_Copy]
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
; https://docs.python.org/3/using/windows.html#installing-without-ui
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\python-$Version$$Arch$.exe" /quiet InstallAllUsers=1 DefaultAllUsersTargetDir="$InstallPath$" PrependPath=$EnvironmentVariables$ InstallLauncherAllUsers=1 Shortcuts=1 /log "%opsiLogDir%\python.txt"

[Sub_PrepareModules]
if FileExists("\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\python\requirements.txt")
  Files_CopyRequirements
else
  if not(GetProductProperty("modules", "") = "")
  set $Modules$ = splitString(GetProductProperty("modules", ""), "|")
    for $Module$ in $Modules$ do PatchTextFile_Requirements "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\requirements.txt"
  endif
endif
if FileExists("%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\requirements.txt")
  WinBatch_InstallModules
endif

[PatchTextFile_Requirements]
AddLine "$Module$"

[Files_CopyRequirements]
copy -s "\\$Hostname$\appdata\python\requirements.txt" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_InstallModules]
"$InstallPath$\python.exe" -m pip install --quiet -r "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\requirements.txt"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010" or $ExitCode$ = "2359302" or $ExitCode$ = "2359297")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  ; List of WUSA ExitCodes: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/kb/938205
  ; 2359297 (WUSA ExitCode, Hex: 0x240001) WU_S_SERVICE_STOP
  ; 2359302 (WUSA ExitCode, Hex: 0x00240006) WU_S_ALREADY_INSTALLED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Registry_Setup]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]
Set "InstallPath" = REG_SZ:"$InstallPath$"

OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Python]
Set "DisplayName" = REG_SZ:"Python"
Set "DisplayVersion" = REG_SZ:"$Version$"
Set "DisplayIcon" = REG_SZ:"$InstallPath$\python.exe"
Set "Publisher" = REG_SZ:"Python Software Foundation"
Set "UninstallString" = REG_SZ:"$InstallPath$\python.exe"

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Python.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif
endif

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Python"
  target: "$InstallPath$\python.exe"
  working_dir: "$InstallPath$"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Python"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

; -------------------------------------------------------------------

set_basefolder common_programs
delete_subfolder "Python 3.14"

[LinkFolder_RemoveDesktop]

PAKET: qgis
DATEI: remove.inc.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/qgis/remove.inc.ins
################################################################################

DefStringList $RegKeyList$
DefVar $InstVersion$
DefVar $RegKey$

Sub_PrepareUninstall

[Sub_PrepareUninstall]
if RegKeyExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%")
  Set $InstVersion$ = getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%", "InstalledVersion")
endif

Set $RegKeyList$ = getRegistryKeyListSysnative("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall")
for $Key$ in $RegKeyList$ do Sub_CheckKey

[Sub_CheckKey]
Set $RegKey$ = '$Key$'
if RegVarExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\"+$RegKey$, "DisplayName")
  if contains(getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\" + $RegKey$, "DisplayName"), "QGIS " + $InstVersion$)
    WinBatch_Uninstall
    Sub_HandleExitCodeUninst
    Sub_LinkFolderUninst
    Sub_Registry
    Sub_Cleanup
  endif
endif

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
msiexec /passive /x $RegKey$

[Sub_HandleExitCodeUninst]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolderUninst]
if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\QGIS.LNK")
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "QGIS"

[Sub_Registry]
if RegKeyExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%")
  Registry_Cleanup /SysNative
endif

[Registry_Cleanup]
DeleteKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]

[Sub_Cleanup]
if FileExists("%ProgramFiles64Dir%\QGIS "+$InstVersion$+"\bin\qgis-bin.exe")
  Files_Delete
endif

[Files_Delete]
delete -sf "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\QGIS $InstVersion$\"

Sub_HandleExitCode

Sub_LinkFolder
Files_Cleanup

copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)

  LogError "Fatal: setup only supports 64-bit systems!"
  IsFatalError
endif

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /passive /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\QGIS-OSGeo4W-$Version$-1.msi"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Registry_SetVersion]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]
Set "InstalledVersion" = REG_SZ:"$Version$"

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Cleanup

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_Cleanup]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
delete_subfolder "QGIS $Version$"

set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "QGIS LTS"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\QGIS $Version$\bin\qgis-ltr-bin.exe"
  working_dir: "%CommonProfileDir%\Documents"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "QGIS LTS"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

Sub_PatchTextFile
DosInAnIcon_Firewall
Sub_LinkFolder
Files_Cleanup

copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Files_CopyLicense]
copy "%ScriptPath%\add\RT6 LU.txt" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\RagTime 6.6\"

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)

[Sub_ValidateConfig]
Set $ProductKey$ = GetProductProperty("productkey", "")
Set $Username$ = GetProductProperty("username", "")
if $ProductKey$ = ""
  LogWarning "Productkey not set, program will run in free mode"
endif

[Sub_ValidateAddons]
if GetProductProperty("addons", "False") = "True"
  WinBatch_SetupAddOn_1_CSV
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  WinBatch_SetupAddOn_2_Johannes
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  WinBatch_SetupAddOn_3_MetaFormula
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  WinBatch_SetupAddOn_4_PalmDOC_Converter
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  WinBatch_SetupAddOn_5_PowerFunctions
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  WinBatch_SetupAddOn_6_RagTime_Connect_Pro
  Sub_HandleExitCode
else
endif

[WinBatch_SetupAddOn_1_CSV]
"%ScriptPath%\add\CSV_Converter\setup.exe" /S /v/qn

[WinBatch_SetupAddOn_2_Johannes]
"%ScriptPath%\add\Johannes\setup.exe" /S /v/qn

[WinBatch_SetupAddOn_3_MetaFormula]
"%ScriptPath%\add\MetaFormula\setup.exe" /S /v/qn

[WinBatch_SetupAddOn_4_PalmDOC_Converter]
"%ScriptPath%\add\PalmDOC_Converter\setup.exe" /S /v/qn

[WinBatch_SetupAddOn_5_PowerFunctions]
"%ScriptPath%\add\PowerFunctions\setup.exe" /S /v/qn

[WinBatch_SetupAddOn_6_RagTime_Connect_Pro]
"%ScriptPath%\add\RagTime_Connect_Pro\setup.exe" /S /v/qn

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /passive /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\RagTime $Version$.msi" ALLUSERS="1"

[Sub_PatchTextFile]
PatchTextFile_License "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\RagTime 6.6\RT6 LU.txt"

[PatchTextFile_License]
GoToTop
InsertLine "$ProductKey$#$Username$"

[DosInAnIcon_Firewall]
netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name="IServ RagTime 6"
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="IServ RagTime 6" protocol=TCP dir=in localip=any remoteip=any action=allow profile=domain program="%ProgramFiles32Dir%\RagTime 6.6\Win32\RagTime 6.6.exe"
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="IServ RagTime 6" protocol=UDP dir=in localip=any remoteip=any action=allow profile=domain program="%ProgramFiles32Dir%\RagTime 6.6\Win32\RagTime 6.6.exe"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
    ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "RagTime 6.6"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\RagTime 6.6\Win32\RagTime 6.6.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "RagTime 6.6"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

if not(GetSystemType = "64 Bit System")
  LogError "Fatal! Only for x64 Systems"
  isFatalError
endif

[DosInAnIcon_KillAutoSetup]
; If another version is installed and we removed that version, it will auto-open the installer in the background
taskkill /im "setup.exe" /f

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%ScriptDrive%\tools\AutoIt3.exe" "%ScriptPath%\install.au3" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Setup.exe"

[WinBatch_RemoveOldDriver]
"%ScriptDrive%\tools\AutoIt3.exe" "%ScriptPath%\removeDrivers.au3" "Audio, Video und Gamecontroller" "Realtek Semiconductor Corp."

[Sub_ImmReboot]
ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot

[Sub_Reboot]
ExitWindows /Reboot

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "setup"
]

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif
if ($ExitCode$ = "3010")
    opsiservicecall_Reinstall
    Sub_ImmReboot
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

  IsFatalError

################################################################################
PAKET: sap-gui
DATEI: remove.inc.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/sap-gui/remove.inc.ins
################################################################################

DefVar $RebootFlag$
Sub_PrepareUninstall
Sub_Uninstall

[Sub_PrepareUninstall]
if RegKeyExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%")
  Set $RebootFlag$ = getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%", "RebootFlag")
endif

[Sub_Uninstall]
if not($RebootFlag$ = "1")
  if FileExists("%ProgramFiles32Dir%\SAP\FrontEnd\SAPgui\saplogon.exe") OR FileExists("%ProgramFiles64Dir%\SAP\FrontEnd\SAPgui\saplogon.exe")
    WinBatch_Uninstall
    Sub_HandleExitCodeUninst
    Set $RebootFlag$ = "1"
    Registry_SaveRebootFlag /SysNative
    Files_Cleanup
    opsiservicecall_Reinstall
    ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot
  endif
endif

if $RebootFlag$ = "1"
  Registry_RemoveBootFlag /SysNative
endif

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
"%ProgramFiles32Dir%\SAP\SAPsetup\setup\NwSapSetup.exe" /all /Uninstall /noDlg

[Sub_HandleExitCodeUninst]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "144" or $ExitCode$ = "129")
  ; 129  Reboot is recommended
  ; 144  Process ended without any errors detected
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Registry_SaveRebootFlag]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]
Set "RebootFlag" = "$RebootFlag$"

[Registry_RemoveBootFlag]
DeleteKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "$ProductAction$"
]

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\SAP\"

[Initial]

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))
;USB-Driver cert has to be added to "trusted publishers"
DosBatch_ImportCert
if not(FileExists("\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\licenses\sbc-pg5-controls-suite-2\USER.KEY"))
  LogError "Fatal: license file USER.KEY not found!"
  IsFatalError
else
  Files_CopyUserKey
endif
if not(FileExists("\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\licenses\sbc-pg5-controls-suite-2\REGISTRATION.KEY"))
  LogError "Fatal: license file REGISTRATION.KEY not found!"
  IsFatalError
endif

Set $ActiveSetupVersion$ = "1"
if RegKeyExists("HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\sbc-pg5-controls-suite-2","Version")
        Set $ActiveSetupVersion$ = GetRegistryStringValueSysnative("[HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\sbc-pg5-controls-suite-2] "+"Version")
        Set $ActiveSetupVersion$ = calculate($ActiveSetupVersion$+"+1")
endif

Registry_ActiveSetup /SysNative

[Registry_ActiveSetup]
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\sbc-pg5-controls-suite-2]
set "StubPath"='cmd /c xcopy /Y /I /S "\\$Hostname$\appdata\licenses\sbc-pg5-controls-suite-2\REGISTRATION.KEY" "%UserProfile%\AppData\Local\SBC\PG5 V2.2.2xx\"'
Set "Version"="$ActiveSetupVersion$"

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[Files_CopyUserKey]
copy -se "\\$Hostname$\appdata\licenses\sbc-pg5-controls-suite-2\USER.KEY" "%AllUsersProfileDir%\SBC\PG5 V2.2.2xx\LocalDir"

[Files_UninstallSkript]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\uninstall.iss" "%AllUsersProfileDir%\SBC\PG5 V2.2.2xx\"

[DosBatch_ImportCert]
certutil -addstore "TrustedPublisher" "%ScriptPath%\certs\SaiaS-BusWinUsbDriver.cer"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Setup PG5 Suite V2.2.220 x64.exe" /s "/v/qn"

[LinkFolder_RemoveDesktopIcon]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "PG5 V2.2.220"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Schroedel"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

copy -se "\\iserv\appdata\schroedel-pusteblume-4\filme\*" "%ProgramFilesDir%\PBL4\filme\"
copy -se "\\iserv\appdata\schroedel-pusteblume-4\WIN\WIN\*" "%ProgramFilesDir%\PBL4\WIN\WIN\"
copy -se "\\iserv\appdata\schroedel-pusteblume-4\WIN\Xtras\*" "%ProgramFilesDir%\PBL4\WIN\Xtras\"
copy -se "\\iserv\appdata\schroedel-pusteblume-4\WIN\01aaPBL4.*" "%ProgramFilesDir%\PBL4\WIN\"
copy -se "\\iserv\appdata\schroedel-pusteblume-4\WIN\*.ico" "%ProgramFilesDir%\PBL4\WIN\"
copy -se "\\iserv\appdata\schroedel-pusteblume-4\WIN\PBL4.bmp" "%ProgramFilesDir%\PBL4\WIN\"
copy -se "\\iserv\appdata\schroedel-pusteblume-4\WIN\PBL4.exe" "%ProgramFilesDir%\PBL4\WIN\"
; This ini-file contains the link to \\iserv\appdata\[...]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\PBL4.ini" "%System%\"

[Patches_Licence]
set [Lizenz] Lizenz=$ProductKey$01

[Patches_Ini]
set [schroedel] path=%ProgramFilesDir%\PBL4\WIN

[LinkFolder_Startmenu]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Schroedel\Pusteblume 4"
set_link
  name: "Pusteblume 4"
  target: "%ProgramFilesDir%\PBL4\WIN\PBL4.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFilesDir%\PBL4\WIN\"
end_link

################################################################################
PAKET: schroedel-pusteblume-4
DATEI: remove.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/schroedel-pusteblume-4/remove.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere Schroedel Pusteblume 4...

[Aktionen]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Pusteblume 4"
Files_Delete
LinkFolder_Uninstall
ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"

[Files_Delete]
; Delete Program files
Delete -sf "%ProgramFilesDir%\PBL4\"
; Delete ini with settings
Delete -f "%System%\PBL4.ini"

[LinkFolder_Uninstall]
set_basefolder common_programs
delete_subfolder "Schroedel\Pusteblume 4"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Schroedel"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

################################################################################
PAKET: schroedel-rund-um-demokratie-heute-1-nrw
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/schroedel-rund-um-demokratie-heute-1-nrw/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Schroedel Rund um... Demokratie heute 1 NRW...
DefVar $ExitCode$

[Aktionen]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Rund um..."
Sub_CheckForPf2
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode

[Sub_CheckForPf2]
; check if Schroedel Pfadfinder 2.0 is installed on the machine
if not(FileExists("%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Pfadfinder 2.0\pf2.exe"))  and not(FileExists("%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Bildungshaus Schulbuch Verlage\Pfadfinder 2.0\ic2.exe"))
  LogError "Fatal: Schroedel Pfadfinder 2.0 not found!"
  IsFatalError
endif

[WinBatch_Setup]
; ALLUSERS=1 is needed to prevent an 1603 error
msiexec /passive /i "%ScriptPath%\data\Rund um (2.0) ... Demokratie heute 1 NW.msi" ALLUSERS=1 INSTALLLEVEL=101

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif


################################################################################
ENDE: schroedel-rund-um-demokratie-heute-1-nrw/install.ins
################################################################################


################################################################################
PAKET: schroedel-rund-um-demokratie-heute-1-nrw
DATEI: remove.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/schroedel-rund-um-demokratie-heute-1-nrw/remove.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere Schroedel Rund um... Demokratie heute 1 NRW...
DefVar $ExitCode$

[Aktionen]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Rund um..."
WinBatch_Uninstall
Sub_HandleExitCode

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
msiexec /passive /x "%ScriptPath%\data\Rund um (2.0) ... Demokratie heute 1 NW.msi"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010" or $ExitCode$ = "1605")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  ; 1605 ERROR_UNKNOWN_PRODUCT
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere Welt der Zahl 1 2017...
DefVar $ExitCode$

[Actions]

LinkFolder_Uninstall

[LinkFolder_Uninstall]
set_basefolder common_programs
delete_subfolder "Schroedel\Welt der Zahl 1"
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element Welt der Zahl 1

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Schroedel"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Scilab...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Scilab"
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_PrepareSetup
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_LinkFolder

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
; Check if OS is newer or equal to Windows 7
if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "6.1") < "0")
  LogError "Minimum supported OS Version is Windows 7."
  IsFatalError
endif

Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)
If GetSystemType = "x86 System"
   LogError "Setup is only for 64 Bit systems!"
   IsFatalError
endif

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%ScriptPath%\data\scilab-$Version$.bin.x64.exe" /SP- /VERYSILENT /NOCANCEL /SUPPRESSMSGBOXES /DIR="%ProgramFiles64Dir%\scilab" /NOICONS

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Cleanup

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_Cleanup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "scilab-$version$ (64-bit)"
delete_element "Uninstall Scilab"

set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "scilab-$version$ (64-Bit) Desktop"

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_link
  name: "Scilab"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\scilab\bin\WScilex.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Scilab"

################################################################################
ENDE: scilab/install.ins
################################################################################


################################################################################
PAKET: scilab
DATEI: remove.inc.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/scilab/remove.inc.ins
################################################################################

Sub_Uninstall
LinkFolder_Delete

[Sub_Uninstall]
KillTask "WScilex.exe"
WinBatch_Uninstall
Sub_HandleExitCodeUninstall

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
"%ScriptDrive%\tools\autoit\universalUninstall.exe" "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\scilab*\" "unins000.exe" "/SILENT" "True"

[Sub_HandleExitCodeUninstall]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[LinkFolder_Delete]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Scilab"

[Initial]

DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Arch$

DefVar $License$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Securepoint Antivirus Pro"
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
if $ExitCode$ = "3010"
    opsiservicecall_Reinstall
    ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot
endif
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_Copy
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
PatchTextFile_WhiteList "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Securepoint Antivirus Pro\conf\guardx.conf"
Files_Cleanup
Sub_Reboot

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "setup"
]

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $License$ = GetProductProperty("license", "")
if $License$ = ""
  LogError "Fatal: No license key set."
  IsFatalError
endif

Set $Arch$ = "x86"
if (GetSystemType = "64 Bit System")
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
endif

Set $Language$ = "de"
if GetProductProperty("language", "Deutsch") = "Englisch"
  Set $Language$ = "en"
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\SetupProjectSpav_$Arch$_$Language$.msi" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\SetupProjectSpav_$Arch$_$Language$.msi" TID=$License$ ACCEPTLICENSEAGREEMENT="yes" ACCEPTPRIVACYPOLICY="yes" /q

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
    ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[PatchTextFile_WhiteList]
; Add winexesvc.exe to whitelist.
;openNodeSet "exclusions"
;  SetAttribute "files" value="C:\Windows\winexesvc.exe"
GoToTop
FindLine_StartingWith '	files '
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine '	files "C:\Windows\winexesvc.exe"'

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Sub_Reboot]
if $ExitCode$ = "3010"
  ExitWindows /Reboot
endif

PAKET: siemens-license-manager
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/siemens-license-manager/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Siemens License Manager...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $WinstRegKey$
DefVar $RebootFlag$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "License"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub_CheckReboot
Files_Copy
Patches_Ini "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Ra_Auto.ini"
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Registry_RemoveBootFlag
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
if not(GetSystemType = "64 Bit System")
  LogError "Fatal: Setup requires a 64 bit system."
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"
copy "%ScriptPath%\Ra_Auto.ini" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Patches_Ini]
set [CopyPath] 1=%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\InstData\ALM64\setup\
set [CopyPath] 2=%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\InstData\VCREDIST\2015x64\
set [CopyPath] 3=%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\InstData\VCREDIST\2015x86\
set [CopyPath] 4=%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\SeCon
set [CopyFiles] 1=%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Setup.exe" /silent="%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Ra_Auto.ini"

[Sub_CheckReboot]
; Setup will break if there is a reboot pending, so we restart.
Set $WinstRegKey$ = "HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\"+"%installingProdName%"
Set $RebootFlag$ = GetRegistryStringValue32("["+$WinstRegKey$+"] "+"RebootFlag")
if (not($RebootFlag$ = "1"))
  Set $RebootFlag$ = "1"
  Registry_SaveRebootFlag /32bit
  opsiservicecall_Reinstall
  Sub_ImmReboot
endif

[Sub_ImmReboot]
ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "setup"
]

[Registry_SaveRebootFlag]
openKey [$WinstRegKey$]
set "RebootFlag" = "$RebootFlag$"

[Registry_RemoveBootFlag]
deletekey [$WinstRegKey$]

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "1641" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 1641 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_INITIATED
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

ENDE: siemens-license-manager/install.ins

DefVar $ExitCode$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "License"
Sub_Uninstall

  WinBatch_Uninstall

  IsFatalError

  LogError "Fatal: license file not found!"
  IsFatalError
endif

"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[Sub_HandleExitCode]

  IsFatalError
endif

[Registry_Setup]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\{E22B1137-664B-4061-A09C-1A837EBE93DE}_is1]

  LinkFolder_Cleanup
endif

  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\TopStart.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif
endif

  name: "TopStart"

  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\MTS\MTS CNC-System 9.0 (64-bit)"

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Siemens SinuTrain for SINUMERIK...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Flag$
DefVar $RegPath$
DefVar $RegVarName$
DefVar $RebootString$
DefVar $WinstRegKey$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Siemens SinuTrain for SINUMERIK Operate"
Sub_PrepareSetup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $WinstRegKey$ = "HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst"
Set $Flag$ = GetRegistryStringValue32("["+$WinstRegKey$+"] "+"RebootFlag")

if not ($Flag$ = "1")
  Sub_checkReboot
else
  Set $Flag$ = "0"
  Registry_SaveRebootFlag
  Sub_Install
endif

;The software wont install if the Key exists and is not empty.
[Sub_checkReboot]
Set $RegPath$ = "HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager"
Set $RegVarName$ = "PendingFileRenameOperations"
Set $RebootString$ = getRegistryStringValue("["+$RegPath$+"] " +  $RegVarName$)

;If the Key does not exist, the software can be installed.
;If the Key exists, but is empty, the software can be installed
;Else, the PC needs to be restarted.
if not(RegVarExists($RegPath$, $RegVarName$)) 
  Sub_Install 
else
  if $RebootString$ = ""
    Sub_Install
  else
    Set $Flag$ = "1"
    Registry_SaveRebootFlag
    opsiservicecall_Reinstall
    ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot
  endif
endif

[Sub_Install]
Files_Copy
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Files_Cleanup

[Registry_SaveRebootFlag]
openKey [$WinstRegKey$]
set "RebootFlag" = "$Flag$"

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
    "%installingProdName%",
    "",
    "setup"
]

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%ScriptDrive%\tools\AutoIt3.exe" "%ScriptPath%\install.au3" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\setup.exe" "/silentmode=%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Ra_Auto.ini"

[WinBatch_Uninstall_Redist2013]
"%CommonAppdataDir%\Package Cache\{f65db027-aff3-4070-886a-0d87064aabb1}\vcredist_x86.exe" /uninstall /quiet

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Initial]
Message=Installiere TIA Portal V19...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $RebootFlag$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "TIA Portal V19"
include_insert "%ScriptDrive%\tools\scripts\report-error-init.inc.ins"
Sub_Install
Sub_LinkFolder
ExitWindows /Reboot

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $RebootFlag$ = getRegistryValue("HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%", "RebootFlag")

[Sub_Install]
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub_CheckSpace

if $RebootFlag$ = ""
  Set $RebootFlag$ = "0"
endif

Switch $RebootFlag$
  Case "0"
    Files_Copy
    PowerShellCall('Expand-Archive -Force -LiteralPath "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\TIA Portal 19.zip" -DestinationPath "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\installer\"')
    Set $RebootFlag$ = "1"
    Registry_SaveRebootFlag /SysNative
    opsiservicecall_Reinstall
    ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot
  EndCase
  Case "1"
    DosInAnIcon_EnableFeatures
    WinBatch_Setup
    Sub_HandleExitCode
    Files_Cleanup
    Set $RebootFlag$ = "2"
    Registry_SaveRebootFlag /SysNative
    opsiservicecall_Reinstall
    ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot
  EndCase
  Case "2"
    Files_CopyALM
    WinBatch_RemoveALM
    Sub_HandleExitCode
    Set $RebootFlag$ = "3"
    Registry_SaveRebootFlag /SysNative
    opsiservicecall_Reinstall
    ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot
  EndCase
  Case "3"
    WinBatch_SetupALM
    Sub_HandleExitCode
    Registry_RemoveBootFlag /SysNative
    Files_Cleanup
  EndCase
EndSwitch

[Sub_CheckSpace]
if not(HasMinimumSpace("%Systemdrive%", "50 GB"))
  Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", "Die Software braucht mindestens 50GB freien Speicher.")
  Sub_ReportError
  LogError "Fatal: Setup requires at least 50GB free disk space!"
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\*.zip" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Files_CopyALM]
copy -s "%ScriptPath%\data\add\ALM\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Registry_SaveRebootFlag]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]
Set "RebootFlag" = REG_SZ:"$RebootFlag$"

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "setup"
]

[DosInAnIcon_EnableFeatures]
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Unrestricted -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName IIS-WebServerRole, IIS-CommonHttpFeatures, IIS-StaticContent, IIS-DefaultDocument, IIS-DirectoryBrowsing, IIS-HttpErrors, IIS-HttpLogging, IIS-RequestMonitor, IIS-HttpCompressionStatic, IIS-WindowsAuthentication, IIS-ManagementConsole -All"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\installer\Start.exe" /qb REBOOT=Suppress INSTALLLANGUAGE=1031 INSTALLLEVEL=Complete

[WinBatch_RemoveALM]
"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Common Files\Siemens\Bin\setupdeinstaller.exe" /qn /x {ECF3D5DB-4D60-4B48-BD1D-2655345153DF}

[WinBatch_SetupALM]
msiexec /passive /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\setup\Setup.msi" /norestart TRANSFORMS="%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\setup\1031.mst"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  if $ExitCode$ = "13010"
    Registry_RemoveBootFlag /SysNative
    opsiservicecall_Reinstall
    ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot
  else
    if $ExitCode$ = "5001"
      WinBatch_Setup
      Sub_HandleExitCode
    else
      ;0     SUCCESS
      ;3010  REBOOT_REQUIRED
      Set $incReportError$ = createStringList("-1", "Bei der Installation ist ein Fehler aufgetreten. Bitte installieren Sie den Client neu und versuchen die Installation dann erneut.")
      Sub_ReportError
      LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
      IsFatalError
    endif
  endif
endif

[Registry_RemoveBootFlag]
DeleteKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\%installingProdName%]

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "False"
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Automation License Manager"
delete_element "S7-PCT - Port Configuration Tool"
delete_element "TIA Administrator V3"
delete_element "TIA Portal V19"
delete_element "WinCC Audit Viewer"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

################################################################################
PAKET: smarttech-smart-notebook-21
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/smarttech-smart-notebook-21/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
; Doku: http://downloads.smarttech.com/media/sitecore/en/support/product/esi/esi2016/guides/guideadmin2016winv11aug16.pdf
; When updating, update the path in [Files_CopyQT] too.
Message=Installiere SMART Notebook 21...
DefVar $Driver$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $gallery$
DefVar $lat$
Defvar $ProductKey$
DefVar $RebootFlag$
DefVar $SmartInk$
DefVar $WinstRegKey$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "SMART Notebook 21"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_CheckReboot
Files_Copy
WinBatch_SetupNotebook
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_Linkfolder
Sub_ActivateNotebook
Sub_RemoveOldVersions
Files_CopyQT
Registry_RemoveBootFlag
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $ProductKey$ = GetProductProperty("productkey", "")
; Fail on Windows XP
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "<", "6.1")
   LogError "Fatal! Operating system not supported. Windows 7 SP1 or newer required."
   IsFatalError
endif
Set $gallery$ = "0"
if (GetProductProperty("gallery", "False") = "True")
  Set $gallery$ = "1"
endif
Set $lat$ = "0"
if (GetProductProperty("lat", "False") = "True")
  Set $lat$ = "1"
endif
set $Driver$ = '""'
if (GetProductProperty("driver", "True") = "True")
  Set $Driver$ = "1"
endif
Set $SmartInk$ = '""'
if (GetProductProperty("smartInk", "False") = "True")
  Set $SmartInk$ = "1"
endif

[Sub_CheckReboot]
; Setup will break if there is a reboot pending, so we restart.
Set $WinstRegKey$ = "HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\"+"%installingProdName%"
Set $RebootFlag$ = GetRegistryStringValue32("["+$WinstRegKey$+"] "+"RebootFlag")
if (not($RebootFlag$ = "1"))
  Set $RebootFlag$ = "1"
  Registry_SaveRebootFlag /32bit
  opsiservicecall_Reinstall
  Sub_ImmReboot
endif

[Sub_ImmReboot]
ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "setup"
]

[Registry_SaveRebootFlag]
openKey [$WinstRegKey$]
set "RebootFlag" = "$RebootFlag$"

[Registry_RemoveBootFlag]
deletekey [$WinstRegKey$]

[Sub_Linkfolder]
if (GetProductProperty("icon", "False") = "True")
  LinkFolder_Setup
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\SMART Notebook 21.1.LNK")
    LinkFolder_Remove
  endif
endif

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "SMART Notebook 21.1"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\SMART Technologies\Education Software\Notebook.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\SMART Technologies\Education Software\"
end_link

[LinkFolder_Remove]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "SMART Notebook 21.1"

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Files_Cleanup]
del -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Files_CopyQT]
copy -se "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\SMART Technologies\Education Software\QtPlugins\5.5.1\platforms\" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\SMART Technologies\Education Software\platforms\"

[WinBatch_SetupNotebook]
msiexec /qb! /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\SMARTLearningSuite.msi" INSTALL_BOARD=$Driver$ MSIFASTINSTALL=1 DISABLE_NAG=1 DESKTOP_ICONS="" NB_PROD_KEY=$ProductKey$ ACTIVATE_LICENSE=1 INSTALL_SPU=0 FULL_GALLERY=$gallery$ LAT_CONTENT=$lat$ INSTALL_INK=$SmartInk$ START_SNMP_SERVICE="" UNINSTALL_EXISTING=1

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_ActivateNotebook]
if not($ProductKey$ = "")
  if (FileExists("%ProgramFilesDir%\Common Files\SMART Technologies\SMART Activation Wizard\activationwizard.exe"))
    WinBatch_Activate1
  else
    WinBatch_Activate2
  endif
else
  LogError "No product key found! Product not activated."

[Initial]
; Doku: http://downloads.smarttech.com/media/sitecore/en/support/product/esi/esi2016/guides/guideadmin2016winv11aug16.pdf
; When updating, update the path in [Files_CopyQT] too.
Message=Installiere SMART Notebook 22...
DefVar $Driver$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $gallery$
DefVar $lat$
DefVar $ProductKey$
DefVar $RebootFlag$
DefVar $SmartInk$
DefVar $WinstRegKey$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "SMART Notebook 22"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_CheckReboot
Files_Copy
WinBatch_SetupNotebook
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_Linkfolder
Sub_ActivateNotebook
Sub_RemoveOldVersions
Files_CopyQT
Registry_RemoveBootFlag
LinkFolder_Cleanup
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $ProductKey$ = GetProductProperty("productkey", "")
; Fail on Windows XP
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "<", "6.1")
   LogError "Fatal! Operating system not supported. Windows 7 SP1 or newer required."
   IsFatalError
endif
Set $gallery$ = "0"
if (GetProductProperty("gallery", "False") = "True")
  Set $gallery$ = "1"
endif
Set $lat$ = "0"
if (GetProductProperty("lat", "False") = "True")
  Set $lat$ = "1"
endif
set $Driver$ = '""'
if (GetProductProperty("driver", "True") = "True")
  Set $Driver$ = "1"
endif
Set $SmartInk$ = '""'
if (GetProductProperty("smartInk", "False") = "True")
  Set $Driver$ = "1"
  Set $SmartInk$ = "1"
endif

[Sub_CheckReboot]
; Setup will break if there is a reboot pending, so we restart.
Set $WinstRegKey$ = "HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\"+"%installingProdName%"
Set $RebootFlag$ = GetRegistryStringValue32("["+$WinstRegKey$+"] "+"RebootFlag")
if (not($RebootFlag$ = "1"))
  Set $RebootFlag$ = "1"
  Registry_SaveRebootFlag /32bit
  opsiservicecall_Reinstall
  Sub_ImmReboot
endif

[Sub_ImmReboot]
ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "setup"
]

[Registry_SaveRebootFlag]
openKey [$WinstRegKey$]
set "RebootFlag" = "$RebootFlag$"

[Registry_RemoveBootFlag]
deletekey [$WinstRegKey$]

[Sub_Linkfolder]
if GetProductProperty("icon", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_Setup
else
  LinkFolder_Remove
endif

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "SMART Notebook 22.0"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\SMART Technologies\Education Software\Notebook.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\SMART Technologies\Education Software\"
end_link

[LinkFolder_Remove]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "SMART Notebook 22.0"

[LinkFolder_Cleanup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "SMART Technologies\SMART Werkzeuge"
delete_element "SMART Deinstallationsprogramm"

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Files_CopyQT]
copy -se "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\SMART Technologies\Education Software\QtPlugins\5.5.1\platforms\" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\SMART Technologies\Education Software\platforms\"

[WinBatch_SetupNotebook]
msiexec /qb! /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\SMARTLearningSuite.msi" INSTALL_BOARD=$Driver$ MSIFASTINSTALL=1 DISABLE_NAG=1 DESKTOP_ICONS="" NB_PROD_KEY=$ProductKey$ ACTIVATE_LICENSE=1 INSTALL_SPU=0 FULL_GALLERY=$gallery$ LAT_CONTENT=$lat$ INSTALL_INK=$SmartInk$ START_SNMP_SERVICE="" UNINSTALL_EXISTING=1

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_ActivateNotebook]
if not($ProductKey$ = "")
  if (FileExists("%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Common Files\SMART Technologies\SMART Activation Wizard\activationwizard.exe"))
    WinBatch_Activate1
  else
    WinBatch_Activate2
  endif
else
  LogError "No product key found! Product not activated."
endif

[WinBatch_Activate1]

WinBatch_SetupLanguage
Sub_HandleExitCode
WinBatch_SetupInk

[WinBatch_SetupCommonPlatform]

[WinBatch_SetupDrivers]
msiexec /passive /i "%ScriptPath%\data\SMART Product Drivers\SMART Product Drivers.msi" INSTALL_SPU=0 TRANSFORMS="%ScriptPath%\data\SMART Product Drivers\1031.mst" LOSU_BRDTOOLS=1 /norestart

[WinBatch_SetupInk]

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "1638" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 1638 ERROR_PRODUCT_VERSION
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

; remove desktop icon

set_subfolder ""
delete_element "SMART Ink Document Viewer"

[Registry_EnableAutostart]

PAKET: smile-lernprogramme
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/smile-lernprogramme/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere SMILE Lernprogramme...
DefStringList $Filenames$
DefStringList $FilenamesTeacher$
DefVar $Fn$
DefVar $Current$

[Aktionen]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "SMILE"
Sub_Install
Sub_InstallTeacher

[Files_Copy]
copy "\\iserv\appdata\smile-lernprogramme\*.exe" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\smile-lernprogramme\"
copy "\\iserv\appdata\smile-lernprogramme\CD\*.exe" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\smile-lernprogramme\CD\"

[Files_CopyTeacher]
copy "\\iserv\appdata\smile-lernprogramme\Lehrerprogramme\*.exe" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\smile-lernprogramme\Lehrerprogramme\"
copy "\\iserv\appdata\smile-lernprogramme\CD\Lehrerprogramme\*.exe" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\smile-lernprogramme\Lehrerprogramme\"

[Sub_Install]
Files_Copy
Set $Filenames$ = createStringList ('Lineal', 'Quadra', 'Strahl', 'Binomi', 'Kreuzung', 'Parabeln', 'Potenzen', 'Aequiva', 'centi')
; run all possible program names through a loop
For $var$ In $Filenames$ Do Sub_Link

[Sub_InstallTeacher]
if (GetProductProperty("teacher", "False") = "True")
  Files_CopyTeacher
  Set $FilenamesTeacher$ = createStringList ('Linilehr', 'Quadlehr', 'Strahllehr', 'potenzlehr', 'Binlehr', 'Kreuzlehr', 'Paralehr', 'Aequilehr', 'centilehr')
  For $var$ In $FilenamesTeacher$ Do Sub_LinkTeacher
endif

[Sub_Link]
Set $Current$ = "$var$"
Set $Fn$ = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\smile-lernprogramme\CD\" + lower("$var$") + ".exe"
if FileExists($Fn$)
  LinkFolder_Setup
else
  Set $Fn$ = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\smile-lernprogramme\$var$.exe"
  if FileExists($Fn$)
    LinkFolder_Setup
  endif
endif

[Sub_LinkTeacher]
Set $Current$ = "$var$"
Set $Fn$ = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\smile-lernprogramme\Lehrerprogramme\$var$.exe"
if FileExists($Fn$)
  LinkFolder_SetupTeacher
endif

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "SMILE"
set_link
  name: "$Current$"
  target: $Fn$
end_link

[LinkFolder_SetupTeacher]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "SMILE\Lehrerprogramme"
set_link
  name: "$Current$"
  target: $Fn$

[Initial]

DefStringList $RegKeyList$

DefVar $SubKey$

[Actions]

Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_Copy
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_License
Sub_Registry
Sub_LinkFolder
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /passive /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\softmaker-office-nx-64.msi" INSTALLLANG="DE"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_License]
if FileExists("\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\licenses\%installingProdName%\ofnx.lic")
  Set $LicPath$ = "\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\licenses\%installingProdName%"
  Files_CopyLicense
endif

[Files_CopyLicense]
copy "$LicPath$\ofnx.lic" "%CommonAppdataDir%\SoftMaker\"

[Sub_Registry]
if GetProductProperty("defaults", "False") = "True"
  Set $RegKeyList$ = getRegistryKeyListSysnative("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes")
  for $Key$ in $RegKeyList$ do Sub_GetSubKeyList
endif

[Sub_GetSubKeyList]
Set $RegKey$ = '$Key$'
if RegKeyExists("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\"+$RegKey$+"\OpenWithProgIds")
  Set $SubKeyList$ = getRegistryKeyListSysnative("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\"+$RegKey$+"\OpenWithProgIds")
  if not(count($SubKeyList$) = "0")
    for $SMKey$ in $SubKeyList$ do Sub_GetSubKey
  endif
endif

[Sub_GetSubKey]
Set $SubKey$ = '$SMKey$'
if contains($SubKey$, "Maker") OR contains($SubKey$, "Presentations")
  Registry_Setup /SysNative
endif

[Registry_Setup]
DeleteKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\$RegKey$\OpenWithProgIds]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\$RegKey$\OpenWithProgIds]
Set "$SubKey$" = REG_SZ:""

; Has to be here as OPSI won't execute it otherwise
[Registry_Cleanup]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\$RegKey$\OpenWithProgIds]
DeleteVar "$SubKey$"

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\BasicMakerNX.LNK")
  LinkFolder_Cleanup
endif

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_Cleanup]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "BasicMakerNX"
delete_element "PlanMakerNX"
delete_element "TextMakerNX"
delete_element "Presentations"

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "BasicMaker NX"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\SoftMaker Office NX\BasicMaker.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\SoftMaker Office NX\"
end_link
set_link
  name: "PlanMaker NX"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\SoftMaker Office NX\PlanMaker.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\SoftMaker Office NX\"
end_link
set_link
  name: "TextMaker NX"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\SoftMaker Office NX\TextMaker.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\SoftMaker Office NX\"
end_link
set_link
  name: "Presentations NX"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\SoftMaker Office NX\Presentations.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\SoftMaker Office NX\"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "BasicMaker NX"
delete_element "PlanMaker NX"
delete_element "TextMaker NX"
delete_element "Presentations NX"

  Set $SubKeyList$ = getRegistryVarListSysnative("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\"+$RegKey$+"\OpenWithProgIds")
  if not(count($SubKeyList$) = "0")
    for $SMKey$ in $SubKeyList$ do Sub_RegistryCleanup
  endif
endif

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere Steinberg Library Manager...
DefVar $ExitCode$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Steinberg Library Manager"
WinBatch_Uninstall
Sub_HandleExitCode
ExecWith_RemoveEmptySystemFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
msiexec /passive /x "%ScriptPath%\data\LibraryManager.msi"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "1605" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
    ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
    ; 1605 ERROR_UNKNOWN_PRODUCT
    ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptySystemFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Steinberg"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

PowerShellCall('Expand-Archive -Force -LiteralPath "%ScriptPath%\data\compasX30_1.zip" -DestinationPath "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Telenot\compasX"')

[Winbatch_Cert]
"cmd.exe" /c start /wait certutil -f -enterprise -addstore root "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Telenot\compasX\TELENOTsmartservicesRootCAV1.cer"

[Sub_Parameters]
; Expanding with PowerShell                          
; File extract with -x buggy
PowerShellCall('Expand-Archive -Force -LiteralPath "%ScriptPath%\data\Parametrierungen.zip" -DestinationPath "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Telenot\compasX\Parametrierungen"')

Set $ActiveSetupVersion$ = "1"
; checked HKLM path and increased variable when exists
; neede to compare HKLM with HKCU
; some informations in README
if RegKeyExists("HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\telenot-compasx","Version")
  Set $ActiveSetupVersion$ = GetRegistryStringValueSysnative("[HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\telenot-compasx] "+"Version")
  Set $ActiveSetupVersion$ = calculate($ActiveSetupVersion$+"+1")
endif

Registry_ActiveSetup /SysNative

[Registry_ActiveSetup]
; copy execute when 'Version' in HKCU<HKLM
; this check runs automatically in Active Setup
; some informations in README
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\telenot-compasx]
set "StubPath"='cmd /c xcopy /Y /I /S "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Telenot\compasX\Parametrierungen" "H:\Telenot\Parametrierungen"'
Set "Version"="$ActiveSetupVersion$"

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Telenot"
set_link
  name: "compasX"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Telenot\compasX\CompasX.exe"
end_link

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

PAKET: tightvnc
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/tightvnc/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere TightVNC...
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $Components$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Passwords$
DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "TightVNC"
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_PrepareSetup
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_LinkFolder

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "64"
else
  Set $Arch$ = "32"
endif

Set $Components$ = "Server,Viewer"
if GetProductProperty("components", "Both") = "Server"
  Set $Components$ = "Server"
endif
if GetProductProperty("components", "Both") = "Viewer"
  Set $Components$ = "Viewer"
endif

if not(GetProductProperty("controlpwd", "") = "")
  if not(strLength(reencodestr(GetProductProperty("controlpwd", ""), "UTF-8", "ISO-8859-1")) <= "8")
    LogError "Fatal: Control password length has to be 8 or less!"
    IsFatalError
  endif
endif
if not(GetProductProperty("primarypwd", "") = "")
  if not(strLength(reencodestr(GetProductProperty("primarypwd", ""), "UTF-8", "ISO-8859-1")) <= "8")
    LogError "Fatal: Primary password length has to be 8 or less!"
    IsFatalError
  endif
endif
if not(GetProductProperty("viewonlypwd", "") = "")
  if not(strLength(reencodestr(GetProductProperty("viewonlypwd", ""), "UTF-8", "ISO-8859-1")) <= "8")
    LogError "Fatal: View-only password length has to be 8 or less!"
    IsFatalError
  endif
endif

if not(GetProductProperty("controlpwd", "") = "")
  Set $Passwords$ = "SET_USECONTROLAUTHENTICATION=1 VALUE_OF_USECONTROLAUTHENTICATION=1 SET_CONTROLPASSWORD=1 VALUE_OF_CONTROLPASSWORD=" + GetProductProperty("controlpwd", "")
endif

if not(GetProductProperty("primarypwd", "") = "") or not(GetProductProperty("viewonlypwd", "") = "")
  Set $Passwords$ = $Passwords$ + " SET_USEVNCAUTHENTICATION=1 VALUE_OF_USEVNCAUTHENTICATION=1"

  if not(GetProductProperty("primarypwd", "") = "")
    Set $Passwords$ = $Passwords$ + " SET_PASSWORD=1 VALUE_OF_PASSWORD=" + GetProductProperty("primarypwd", "")
  endif
  if not(GetProductProperty("viewonlypwd", "") = "")
    Set $Passwords$ = $Passwords$ + " SET_VIEWONLYPASSWORD=1 VALUE_OF_VIEWONLYPASSWORD=" + GetProductProperty("viewonlypwd", "")
  endif
endif

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /passive /i "%ScriptPath%\data\tightvnc-$Version$-gpl-setup-$Arch$bit.msi" ADDLOCAL=$Components$ $Passwords$

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or  $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\TightVNC Viewer.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif
endif

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "TightVNC Viewer"
  target: "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\TightVNC\tvnviewer.exe"
  working_dir: "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\TightVNC\"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "TightVNC Viewer"

  SetLogLevel=4

DeleteTheLine
InsertLine "license.server="

[PatchTextFile_DeleteLicense]
FindLine_StartingWith "license.number="
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine "license.number="

  LogError "Fatal! Windows 7 or newer required."
  IsFatalError

  LogError "Fatal: Neither license key nor license server set."
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Copy]

  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_ApplyLicense]
if not($LicenseServer$ = "")
  PatchTextFile_Server "%CommonAppDataDir%\TI-Nspire CX-TE\res\settings.properties"
  PatchTextFile_Server "%CommonAppDataDir%\TI-Nspire CX CAS-TE\res\settings.properties"
else  
  if not($License$ = "")
;    PatchTextFile_License "%CommonAppDataDir%\TI-Nspire CX-TE\res\deployment.properties"
  PatchTextFile_License "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\deployment.properties"

    endif
  if not($LicenseCAS$ = "")
    PatchTextFile_LicenseCAS "%CommonAppDataDir%\TI-Nspire CX CAS-TE\res\deployment.properties"
  endif
endif
Files_CopySettingsFile
Files_CopyDeploymentFile

[Files_CopySettingsFile]
copy "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\settings.properties" "%CommonAppDataDir%\TI-Nspire CX-TE\res\"
copy "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\settings.properties" "%CommonAppDataDir%\TI-Nspire CX CAS-TE\res\"

[Files_CopyDeploymentFile]
copy "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\deployment.properties" "%CommonAppDataDir%\TI-Nspire CX-TE\res\"

InsertLine "license.server=$LicenseServer$"

[PatchTextFile_License]

DeleteTheLine

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Tintenklex 11...
DefVar $Hostname$

DefVar $TintenklexPath$

[Actions]

LinkFolder_Cleanup
Sub_ValidateConfig
Registry_Patch /32bit
Sub_SetLinks

[LinkFolder_Cleanup]
set_basefolder common_programs
delete_subfolder "Tintenklex 11"

[Sub_ValidateConfig]
Set $ProductKey$ = GetProductProperty("seriennummer", "")
if $ProductKey$ = ""
  LogError "Fatal: product key not found"
  IsFatalError
endif
Set $ProductKey_dikt$ = GetProductProperty("KlexdiktSeriennummer", "")
Set $ProductKey_gram$ = GetProductProperty("KlexgramSeriennummer", "")
Set $ProductKey_hex$ = GetProductProperty("KlexhexSeriennummer", "")
Set $ProductKey_voc$ = GetProductProperty("KlexvocSeriennummer", "")
; \\mein-iserv.de\appdata\tintenklex is mounted via login.bat as T:
; FIXME: Provide central network drive for appdata and use it (see
; https://redmine.iserv.eu/issues/22356#note-10)
;Set $TintenklexPath$ = "T:\"
Set $Hostname$ = Lower(Trim(TakeString(0, GetReturnListFromSection("opsiservicecall_GetHostname"))))
Set $TintenklexPath$ = "\\" + $Hostname$ + "\appdata\tintenklex\"

[opsiservicecall_GetHostname]
"method":"iserv_cfg"
"params":[
  "Hostname"
]

[Sub_SetLinks]
LinkFolder_Setup
if not($ProductKey_dikt$ = "")
  LinkFolder_SetupKlexdikt
endif
if not($ProductKey_gram$ = "")
  LinkFolder_SetupKlexgram
endif
if not($ProductKey_hex$ = "")
  LinkFolder_SetupKlexhex
endif
if not($ProductKey_voc$ = "")
  LinkFolder_SetupKlexvoc
endif

[Registry_Patch]
OpenKey [HKLM\Software\Tintenklex11]
Set "DataPath" = REG_SZ:"$TintenklexPath$"
Set "InstPath" = REG_SZ:"$TintenklexPath$"
Set "klex" = REG_SZ:"$ProductKey$"
Set "klexdikt" = REG_SZ:"$ProductKey_dikt$"
Set "klexgram" = REG_SZ:"$ProductKey_gram$"
Set "klexhex" = REG_SZ:"$ProductKey_hex$"
Set "klexvoc" = REG_SZ:"$ProductKey_voc$"

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Tintenklex 11"
set_link
  name: "Tintenklex"
  target: "$TintenklexPath$\klex.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_SetupKlexdikt]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Tintenklex 11"
set_link
  name: "Tintenklex-Diktat"
  target: "$TintenklexPath$\klexdikt.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_SetupKlexhex]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Tintenklex 11"
set_link
  name: "Tintenklex-Hexenklex"
  target: "$TintenklexPath$\klexhex.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_SetupKlexvoc]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Tintenklex 11"
set_link
  name: "Tintenklex-Vokabeltrainer"
  target: "$TintenklexPath$\klexvoc.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_SetupKlexgram]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Tintenklex 11"
set_link
  name: "Tintenklex-Grammatik"
  target: "$TintenklexPath$\klexgram.exe"
end_link

PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/tintenklex-lehrer/remove.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere Tintenklex (Lehrer)...

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Tintenklex"
LinkFolder_Remove
ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"
Registry_Remove

[LinkFolder_Remove]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Tintenklex 11"
delete_element "Klexmix"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Tintenklex 11"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[Registry_Remove]
openkey [HKLM\Software]
DeleteKey "Tintenklex11"

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Total Commander...

[Actions]

Files_Copy
Sub_PrepareSetup
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_LinkFolder
Files_Cleanup

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)
Set $Exe$ ="TOTALCMD.EXE"
Set $Arch$ = "x32"
if (GetSystemType = "64 Bit System")
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
  Set $Exe$ ="TOTALCMD64.EXE"
endif

[WinBatch_Setup]
; A=auto(=silent), H=NoGUI, U=Update, G0=No startmenu icons,  F=ignores old Folder
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\tcmd$Version$$Arch$.exe" /AHUG0F "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\totalcmd" 

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_Setup
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Total Commander.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif  
endif

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Total Commander"
set_link
  name: "Total Commander"
  target: "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\totalcmd\$Exe$"
  icon_file: "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\totalcmd\$Exe$"
end_link

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Total Commander"
  target: "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\totalcmd\$Exe$"
  icon_file: "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\totalcmd\$Exe$"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Total Commander"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

################################################################################

Sub_Uninstall
Sub_Registry_Cleanup
Sub_LinkFolder_Delete
Sub_Cleanup

[Sub_Uninstall]
If (FileExists("%Systemdrive%\totalcmd\TCUNINST.exe"))
  WinBatch_Uninstall_Old
  Sub_HandleExitCode
Endif

If (FileExists("%ProgramFiles32Dir%\totalcmd\TCUNINST.exe"))
  WinBatch_Uninstall_x32
  Sub_HandleExitCode
Endif

If (FileExists("%ProgramFiles64Dir%\totalcmd\tcunin64.exe"))
  WinBatch_Uninstall_x64
  Sub_HandleExitCode
Endif

[WinBatch_Uninstall_x32]
; No this is not a joke. /7 is silent to remove all totalcmd files.
"%ProgramFiles32Dir%\totalcmd\TCUNINST.exe" /7

[WinBatch_Uninstall_x64]
; No this is not a joke. /7 is silent to remove all totalcmd files.
"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\totalcmd\tcunin64.exe" /7

[WinBatch_Uninstall_Old]
; No this is not a joke. /7 is silent to remove all totalcmd files.
"%Systemdrive%\totalcmd\TCUNINST.exe" /7

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_Registry_Cleanup]
if RegKeyExists("HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Ghisler")
  Registry_Delete /SysNative /32bit
  Registry_Delete /SysNative /64bit
endif

[Registry_Delete]
DeleteKey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Ghisler]

[Sub_LinkFolder_Delete]
if DirectoryExists("%CommonProgramsDir%\Total Commander")
  LinkFolder_DeleteStartmenu
endif
if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Total Commander.LNK")
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_DeleteStartmenu]
set_basefolder common_programs
delete_subfolder "Total Commander"

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Total Commander"

[Sub_Cleanup]
if DirectoryExists("%CurrentAppDataDir%\GHISLER")
  Files_Delete
endif

[Files_Delete]
delete -sf "%CurrentAppDataDir%\GHISLER"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramsFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Unity"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

Sub_Uninstall
;sometimes files remain on the hard drive after uninstall
Files_Cleanup
ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"
ExecWith_RemoveEmptySystemFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"

[Sub_Uninstall]
if FileExists("%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Untis\2020\uninstall.exe")
  Set $Constants$ = "%ProgramFiles32Dir%"
  WinBatch_Uninstall
  Sub_HandleExitCode_Uninstall
  LinkFolder_Uninstall
endif
if FileExists("%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Untis\2020\uninstall.exe")
  Set $Constants$ = "%ProgramFiles64Dir%"
  WinBatch_Uninstall
  Sub_HandleExitCode_Uninstall
  LinkFolder_Uninstall
endif

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
"$Constants$\Untis\2020\uninstall.exe" /S

[Sub_HandleExitCode_Uninstall]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

[LinkFolder_Uninstall]
set_basefolder common_programs
delete_subfolder "Untis\2020"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Untis\2020\"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyProgramFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Untis"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptySystemFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "$Constants$\Untis"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

  Set $Arch$ = "32"
else
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
endif

set "DisplayIcon" = REG_SZ:"C:\Program Files\Untis\2024\Untis.exe"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code

if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

if (GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True")
         if (GetProductProperty("architecture" , "False") = "True")
         LinkFolder_Untis32
         else
         LinkFolder_Untis64
         endif
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

  name: "Untis 2024"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Untis\2024\Untis.exe"

PAKET: usbdlm
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/usbdlm/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere USBDLM - USB Drive Letter Manager...
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $ExitCode$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "USBDLM - USB Drive Letter Manager"
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_Setup
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Arch$ = "x64"
if GetSystemType = "x86 System"
  Set $Arch$ = "Win32"
endif

[Files_Setup]
; http://iserv.eu/doc/usbdlm/
; The file needs to be copied before USBDLM is installed, or we would have to
; restart it afterwards so that it would read the new file.
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\addusbdlm.ini" "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\USBDLM\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /passive /i "%ScriptPath%\data\usbdlm_$Arch$.msi"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

################################################################################
ENDE: usbdlm/install.ins
################################################################################


################################################################################
PAKET: usbdlm
DATEI: remove.inc.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/usbdlm/remove.inc.ins
################################################################################

Sub_Uninstall

[Sub_Uninstall]
if DirectoryExists("%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\USBDLM")
  WinBatch_Stop
  WinBatch_Uninstall
  Sub_HandleExitCode_Uninstall
  Files_Remove
endif

[WinBatch_Stop]
sc stop usbdlm

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
"%ScriptDrive%\tools\autoit\msiRemove_withLog.exe" "USB Drive Letter Manager"

[Files_Remove]
delete -sf "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\USBDLM\"

[Sub_HandleExitCode_Uninstall]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  ; 1605 ERROR_UNKNOWN_PRODUCT
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

################################################################################
PAKET: vernier-graphical-analysis
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/vernier-graphical-analysis/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Vernier Graphical Analysis...
DefVar $Arch$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $RebootFlag$
DefVar $Version$
DefVar $WinstRegKey$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Vernier Graphical Analysis"
Files_Copy
Sub_PrepareSetup
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCodeMSI
Registry_RemoveBootFlag /32bit
Sub_LinkFolder
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)
;Needs restart after patch ist installed
;To check if we ware before or after the reboot, this regKey is needed.
Set $WinstRegKey$ = "HKLM\SOFTWARE\opsi.org\winst\"+"%installingProdName%"
Set $RebootFlag$ = GetRegistryStringValue32("["+$WinstRegKey$+"] "+"RebootFlag")

;Wont work properly in one line
if (CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "6.1") = "0")
  if (not($RebootFlag$ = "1"))
    Sub_GetArch
    WinBatch_InstallPatch
    Sub_HandleExtiCode
    Set $RebootFlag$ = "1"
    Registry_SaveRebootFlag /32bit
    opsiservicecall_Reinstall
    Sub_ImmReboot
  endif
endif

[Sub_GetArch]
Set $Arch$ = "x86"
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
endif

;Setup uses SHA256 for code-signing and win7 does not recognize it without this patch.
;https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/kb/2921916
[WinBatch_InstallPatch]
wusa.exe "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Windows6.1-KB2921916-$Arch$.msu" /quiet /norestart

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
msiexec /i "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\Vernier-Graphical-Analysis-$Version$.msi" /passive

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_HandleExitCodeMSI]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "3010")
  ; 0    ERROR_SUCCESS
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_ImmReboot]
ExitWindows /ImmediateReboot

[opsiservicecall_Reinstall]
"method":"setProductActionRequest"
"params":[
  "%installingProdName%",
  "",
  "setup"
]

[Registry_SaveRebootFlag]
openKey [$WinstRegKey$]
set "RebootFlag" = "$RebootFlag$"

[Registry_RemoveBootFlag]
deletekey [$WinstRegKey$]

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
    LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_link
    name: "Vernier Graphical Analysis"
    target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Vernier Graphical Analysis\Vernier Graphical Analysis.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Vernier Graphical Analysis"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

################################################################################
ENDE: vernier-graphical-analysis/install.ins
################################################################################


################################################################################
PAKET: vernier-graphical-analysis
DATEI: remove.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/vernier-graphical-analysis/remove.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere Vernier Graphical Analysis...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Vernier Graphical Analysis"

Sub_Uninstall

[Sub_Uninstall]

  ; 1605 ERROR_UNKNOWN_PRODUCT
  ; 3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError

[Sub_CheckInstalled]
;It will fail if already "installed", so we simply try to start it. If exitcode is 0, it is already installed and works.
Set $Output$ = takeFirstStringContaining(shellCall('net start VCC_Remote_Shutdown'), 'Der Name')
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  if not($Output$ = "")
    ; Not installed
    DosInAnIcon_Setup
    Sub_HandleExitCode
    DosInAnIcon_Start
  endif
endif

[DosInAnIcon_Setup]
@echo off
"%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Visu Board Helper\InstallUtil.exe" "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\Visu Board Helper\VCC_Remote_Shutdown.exe"

[DosInAnIcon_Start]
net start VCC_Remote_Shutdown

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
    LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
    IsFatalError
endif

  IsFatalError

path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\Westermann"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

ENDE: windows-restrict-removables/install.ins

################################################################################
PAKET: windows-restrict-removables
DATEI: remove.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/windows-restrict-removables/remove.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Gebe Zugriff auf Wechseldatenträger frei...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Arch$
DefStringList $Res$

[Aktionen]
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_Copy
Registry_UnlockRemovables
Set $Res$ = GetOutStreamFromSection('DosBatch_ReAddDevices')
comment $Res$
Sub_HandleExitCode
Files_Delete
ExitWindows /Reboot

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Arch$ = "x86"
if GetSystemType = "64 Bit System"
  Set $Arch$ = "x64"
endif

[Registry_UnlockRemovables]
;openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\RemovableStorageDevices]
;Set "Deny_all" = REG_DWORD:0
DeleteKey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\RemovableStorageDevices]

[Files_Copy]
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\$Arch$\devcon.exe" "%opsiTmpDir%\"

[Files_Delete]
delete -f "%opsiTmpDir%\devcon.exe"

[DosBatch_ReAddDevices]
cd "%opsiTmpDir%"
devcon.exe remove =CDROM *
devcon.exe rescan

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Initial]

WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_LinkFolder

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion",  GetProductMap)

[DosInAnIcon_KillWinSCP]
;If process is running, the setup throws an error.
taskkill /f /im "WinSCP.exe"

[WinBatch_Setup]
; http://winscp.net/eng/docs/installation#automating_installation
"%ScriptPath%\data\WinSCP-$Version$-Setup.exe" /LANG=de /GROUP="WinSCP" /SILENT /NORESTART /NOCANCEL /ALLUSERS

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "WinSCP"
  target: "%ProgramFiles32Dir%\WinSCP\WinSCP.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "WinSCP"
