################################################################################
PAKET: wlan-setup
DATEI: install.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/wlan-setup/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=IServ WLAN einrichten...
DefVar $Auth$
DefVar $Conf_Encryption$
DefVar $Conf_Passphrase$
DefVar $Conf_SSID$
DefVar $Enc$
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $KeyType$
DefVar $Res$

; This script generates an XML WLAN profile according to the specification:
; http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/ms706965(v=vs.85).aspx
;
; Windows XP:
; wifi_config ( http://code.mincus.com/31/windows-wireless-api/ ) is used to
; import this file. Unfortunately, it doesn't support exit codes, so we have to
; parse its output. As opsi 3.4 doesn't have the necessary string functions, we
; just skip the error handling (yes, I'm lazy).
;
; Windows 7:
; Windows 7 can read the XML file natively with netsh wlan.

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "IServ WLAN einrichten"
Sub_ValidateConfig
Files_CopyXML
WinBatch_SetACL
SetLogLevel=0
XMLPatch_Setup "%Systemdrive%\tmp\setup.wlan"
SetLogLevel=2
Sub_SetupSharedKey
Sub_Setup
Sub_EnableOtherWifi
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_ValidateConfig]
Set $Conf_SSID$ = trim(GetProductProperty("ssid", ""))
Set $Conf_Encryption$ = trim(GetProductProperty("encryption", ""))
if $Conf_Encryption$ = ""
  Set $Conf_Encryption$ = "WPA2-PSK (AES)"
endif  
SetLogLevel=0
Set $Conf_Passphrase$ = trim(GetProductProperty("passphrase", ""))
SetConfidential $Conf_Passphrase$
SetLogLevel=2
; sanity checks
if $Conf_SSID$ = ""
  LogError "Fatal: no ssid given"
  IsFatalError
endif
if $Conf_Passphrase$ = "" and not($Conf_Encryption$ = "Keine")
  LogError "Fatal: no passphrase given"
  IsFatalError
endif
if contains($Conf_Passphrase$, '"')
  LogError 'Fatal: passphrase contains "'
  IsFatalError
endif
; encryption mapping
if $Conf_Encryption$ = "Keine"
  Set $Auth$ = "open"
  Set $Enc$ = "none"
endif
if $Conf_Encryption$ = "WEP"
  Set $Auth$ = "open"
  Set $Enc$ = "WEP"
  Set $KeyType$ = "networkKey"
endif
if $Conf_Encryption$ = "WPA-PSK" or $Conf_Encryption$ = "WPA-PSK (AES)"
  ; "WPA-PSK" was the old name for "WPA-PSK (AES)"
  Set $Auth$ = "WPAPSK"
  Set $Enc$ = "AES"
  Set $KeyType$ = "passPhrase"
endif
if $Conf_Encryption$ = "WPA2-PSK" or $Conf_Encryption$ = "WPA2-PSK (AES)"
  ; "WPA2-PSK" was the old name for "WPA2-PSK (AES)"
  Set $Auth$ = "WPA2PSK"
  Set $Enc$ = "AES"
  Set $KeyType$ = "passPhrase"
endif
if $Conf_Encryption$ = "WPA-PSK (TKIP)"
  Set $Auth$ = "WPAPSK"
  Set $Enc$ = "TKIP"
  Set $KeyType$ = "passPhrase"
endif
if $Conf_Encryption$ = "WPA2-PSK (TKIP)"
  Set $Auth$ = "WPA2PSK"
  Set $Enc$ = "TKIP"
  Set $KeyType$ = "passPhrase"
endif
if $Conf_Encryption$ = "WPA3-SAE (AES)"
  Set $Auth$ = "WPA3SAE"
  Set $Enc$ = "AES"
  Set $KeyType$ = "passPhrase"
endif
if $Conf_Encryption$ = "WPA3-SAE (TKIP)"
  Set $Auth$ = "WPA3SAE"
  Set $Enc$ = "TKIP"
  Set $KeyType$ = "passPhrase"
endif
if $Conf_Encryption$ = "WPA3-Enterprise (AES)"
  Set $Auth$ = "WPA3ENT"
  Set $Enc$ = "AES"
  Set $KeyType$ = "passPhrase"
endif
if $Conf_Encryption$ = "WPA3-Enterprise (TKIP)"
  Set $Auth$ = "WPA3ENT"
  Set $Enc$ = "TKIP"
  Set $KeyType$ = "passPhrase"
endif
if $Conf_Encryption$ = "WPA3-Enterprise 192bit (AES)"
  Set $Auth$ = "WPA3ENT192"
  Set $Enc$ = "AES"
  Set $KeyType$ = "passPhrase"
endif
if $Conf_Encryption$ = "WPA3-Enterprise 192bit (TKIP)"
  Set $Auth$ = "WPA3ENT192"
  Set $Enc$ = "TKIP"
  Set $KeyType$ = "passPhrase"
endif

[Files_CopyXML]
copy "%ScriptPath%\data\add\setup.wlan" "%Systemdrive%\tmp"

[WinBatch_SetACL]
; If this script fails, we don't want to leave a world-readable profile behind.
;
; remove inherited ACEs:
;   -actn setprot -op "dacl:p_nc;sacl:p_nc"
; add ACE for SYSTEM
;   -actn ace -ace "n:S-1-5-18;p:full"
; add ACE for Administrators:
;   -ace "n:S-1-5-32-544;p:full"
"%ScriptPath%\data\add\SetACL.exe" -on "%Systemdrive%\tmp\setup.wlan" -ot file -actn setprot -op "dacl:p_nc;sacl:p_nc" -actn ace -ace "n:S-1-5-18;p:full" -ace "n:S-1-5-32-544;p:full"

[XMLPatch_Setup]
; http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/ms706965(v=vs.85).aspx
- warning_when_no_node_existing false
- create_when_node_not_existing true
; profile name
OpenNodeSet "name"
SetText "$Conf_SSID$"
; the actual SSID
OpenNodeSet "SSIDConfig/SSID/name"
SetText "$Conf_SSID$"
; connect to hidden WiFis
OpenNodeSet "SSIDConfig/nonBroadcast"
SetText "true"
; infrastructure mode
OpenNodeSet "connectionType"
SetText "ESS"
; auth/encryption
OpenNodeSet "MSM/security/authEncryption/authentication"
SetText "$Auth$"
OpenNodeSet "MSM/security/authEncryption/encryption"
SetText "$Enc$"
OpenNodeSet "MSM/security/authEncryption/useOneX"
SetText "false"

[Sub_SetupSharedKey]
; add encryption settings when encryption is enabled
if not($Conf_Encryption$ = "Keine")
  SetLogLevel=0
  XMLPatch_SetupSharedKey "%Systemdrive%\tmp\setup.wlan"
  SetLogLevel=2
endif

[XMLPatch_SetupSharedKey]
- warning_when_no_node_existing false
- create_when_node_not_existing true
OpenNodeSet "MSM/security/sharedKey/keyType"
SetText "$KeyType$"
OpenNodeSet "MSM/security/sharedKey/protected"
SetText "false"
OpenNodeSet "MSM/security/sharedKey/keyMaterial"
SetText "$Conf_Passphrase$"

[Sub_Setup]
if CompareDotSeparatedNumbers(GetMsVersionInfo, "6") >= "0"
  ; Windows 7/8.1/10
  DosInAnIcon_netsh
  Sub_HandleExitCode
else
  ; Windows XP
  if not("%WinstVersion%" = "%"+"WinstVersion"+"%")
    ; opsi 4.0
    Set $Res$ = takeFirstStringContaining(GetOutStreamFromSection("DosInAnIcon_wifi_config"), "Added AP from file")
    if $Res$ = ""
      LogError "wifi_config failed"
      IsFatalError
    endif
  else
    ; opsi 3.4
    DosInAnIcon_wifi_config
  endif
endif

[DosInAnIcon_wifi_config]
; wifi_config doesn't have proper exit codes so we have to parse the output.
;
; output on success:
;  - Added AP from file 'C:\tmp\setup.wlan' to interface '{B77FAFAF-9382-4FD8-8902-B632183DAEB6}'.
; output on error:
;  - Error adding AP from file 'C:\tmp\setup.wlan' to interface '{B77FAFAF-9382-4FD8-8902-B632183DAEB6}': (262147)Invalid key length
"%ScriptPath%\data\wifi_config.exe" -add "%Systemdrive%\tmp\setup.wlan"

[DosInAnIcon_netsh]
netsh wlan add profile filename="%Systemdrive%\tmp\setup.wlan" user=all

[Sub_EnableOtherWifi]
if (GetProductProperty("enableotherwifi", "True") = "True")
  DosInAnIcon_EnableOtherWifi
  Registry_EnableOtherWifi
Else
  DosInAnIcon_DisableOtherWifi
  Registry_DisableOtherWifi
EndIf

[DosInAnIcon_DisableOtherWifi]
; Added Firewall Rule
netsh wlan add filter permission=allow ssid="$Conf_SSID$" networktype=infrastructure
netsh wlan add filter permission=denyall networktype=infrastructure
netsh wlan add filter permission=denyall networktype=adhoc

[DosInAnIcon_EnableOtherWifi]
; Remove Firewall Rule
netsh wlan delete filter permission=denyall networktype=infrastructure
netsh wlan delete filter permission=denyall networktype=adhoc

[Registry_EnableOtherWifi]
; Enable Hotspots
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Network Connections]
DeleteVar "NC_ShowSharedAccessUI"

[Registry_DisableOtherWifi]
; Disable Hotspots
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Network Connections]
set "NC_ShowSharedAccessUI"=REG_DWORD:0

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Cleanup]
delete "%Systemdrive%\tmp\setup.wlan"

################################################################################
ENDE: wlan-setup/install.ins
################################################################################

[Actions]

  LogError "Fatal: no ssid given"
  IsFatalError

[DosInAnIcon_EnableOtherWifi]

  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError

[Initial]
Message=Installiere XAMPP...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $TomcatAjpPort$
DefVar $TomcatHttpPort$
DefVar $TomcatMainPort$
DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "XAMPP"
Sub "%ScriptPath%\remove.inc.ins"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_Copy
Winbatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
DosInAnIcon_Firewall
Sub_HandleExitCode
Sub_FilesCopyConfig
Sub_PatchTextFiles
LinkFolder_Delete
LinkFolder_Create
Sub_LinkFolder
Files_Cleanup

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
Set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)
Set $TomcatMainPort$ = GetProductProperty("TomcatMainPort", "8005")
Set $TomcatAjpPort$ = GetProductProperty("TomcatAjpPort", "8009")
Set $TomcatHttpPort$ = GetProductProperty("TomcatHttpPort", "8080")

If GetSystemType = "x86 System"
   LogError "Setup is only for 64 Bit systems!"
   IsFatalError
endif

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\xampp-windows-x64-$Version$-0-VS16-installer.exe" --mode unattended

[DosInAnIcon_Firewall]
netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name="Apache HTTP Server"
netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name="FileZilla Server"
netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name="Mercury/32 Core Processing Module v4.62"
netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name="MySQL Server"
netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name="Oracle Java JRE"
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="Apache HTTP Server" profile=any enable=yes protocol=any dir=in action=allow program="C:\xampp\apache\bin\httpd.exe"
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="FileZilla Server" profile=any enable=yes protocol=any dir=in action=allow program="C:\xampp\filezillaftp\filezillaserver.exe"
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="Mercury/32 Core Processing Module v4.62" profile=any enable=yes protocol=any dir=in action=allow program="C:\xampp\mercurymail\mercury.exe"
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="MySQL Server" profile=any enable=yes protocol=any dir=in action=allow program="C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysqld.exe"
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="Oracle Java JRE" profile=any enable=yes protocol=any dir=in action=allow program="C:\Program Files\java\jre1.8\bin\java.exe"

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check exit code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
   LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
   IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_PatchTextFiles]
if GetProductProperty("LocalUse", "False") = "True"
   PatchTextFile_HttpdConf_local "%SystemDrive%\xampp\apache\conf\httpd.conf"
   PatchTextFile_HttpdSslConf_local "%SystemDrive%\xampp\apache\conf\extra\httpd-ssl.conf"
   PatchTextFile_HttpdXamppConf_local "%SystemDrive%\xampp\apache\conf\extra\httpd-xampp.conf"
   Patches_Xampp-Controll.Ini "%SystemDrive%\xampp\xampp-control.ini"
   ; infos in README.md #MY.INI
   PatchTextFile_MyIni64_local "%SystemDrive%\xampp\mysql\bin\my.ini"
else
   PatchTextFile_HttpdConf "%SystemDrive%\xampp\apache\conf\httpd.conf"
   PatchTextFile_HttpdSslConf "%SystemDrive%\xampp\apache\conf\extra\httpd-ssl.conf"
   PatchTextFile_HttpdXamppConf "%SystemDrive%\xampp\apache\conf\extra\httpd-xampp.conf"
   Patches_Xampp-Controll.Ini "%SystemDrive%\xampp\xampp-control.ini"
   ; infos in README.md #MY.INI
   PatchTextFile_MyIni64 "%SystemDrive%\xampp\mysql\bin\my.ini"
endif

; Roaming profiles
[PatchTextFile_HttpdConf]
FindLine_Containing "DocumentRoot "
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine 'DocumentRoot "H:/xampp/htdocs"'

FindLine_Containing "<Directory "
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine '<Directory "H:/xampp/htdocs">'

; Local user
[PatchTextFile_HttpdConf_local]
FindLine_Containing "DocumentRoot "
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine 'DocumentRoot "C:/xampp/htdocs"'

FindLine_Containing "<Directory "
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine '<Directory "C:/xampp/htdocs">'

; Roaming profiles
[PatchTextFile_HttpdSslConf]
FindLine_Containing "DocumentRoot "
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine 'DocumentRoot "H:/xampp/htdocs"'

; Local user
[PatchTextFile_HttpdSslConf_local]
FindLine_Containing "DocumentRoot "
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine 'DocumentRoot "C:/xampp/htdocs"'

; Roaming profiles
[PatchTextFile_HttpdXamppConf]
FindLine_Containing '<Directory "C:/xampp/htdocs/xampp">'
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine '<Directory "H:/xampp/htdocs/xampp">'

; Local user
[PatchTextFile_HttpdXamppConf_local]
FindLine_Containing '<Directory "C:/xampp/htdocs/xampp">'
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine '<Directory "C:/xampp/htdocs/xampp">'

; Roaming profiles
[PatchTextFile_MyIni64]
FindLine_Containing "datadir="
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine 'datadir="H:/xampp/mysql/data"'

FindLine_Containing "innodb_data_home_dir="
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine 'innodb_data_home_dir="H:/xampp/mysql/data"'

FindLine_Containing "innodb_log_group_home_dir="
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine 'innodb_log_group_home_dir="H:/xampp/mysql/data"'

; Local user
[PatchTextFile_MyIni64_local]
FindLine_Containing "datadir="
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine 'datadir="C:/xampp/mysql/data"'

FindLine_Containing "innodb_data_home_dir="
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine 'innodb_data_home_dir="C:/xampp/mysql/data"'

FindLine_Containing "innodb_log_group_home_dir="
DeleteTheLine
InsertLine 'innodb_log_group_home_dir="C:/xampp/mysql/data"'

[Patches_Xampp-Controll.Ini]
set [ServicePorts] Tomcat=$TomcatMainPort$
set [ServicePorts] TomcatAJP=$TomcatAjpPort$
set [ServicePorts] TomcatHTTP=$TomcatHttpPort$

[Sub_FilesCopyConfig]
Files_CopyBat
Files_XamppCFG

[Files_CopyBat]
copy "%ScriptPath%\StartXAMPP.bat" "%SystemDrive%\xampp\"

[Files_XamppCFG]
; README.md --> #xampp-control.ini
delete "%SystemDrive%\xampp\xampp-control.ini"
copy "%ScriptPath%\xampp-control.ini" "%SystemDrive%\xampp\"

[LinkFolder_Delete]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "XAMPP"
delete_element "XAMPP Control Panel"
delete_element "XAMPP htdocs folder"
delete_element "Uninstall XAMPP"

[LinkFolder_Create]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "XAMPP"
set_link
   name: "XAMPP Control Panel"
   target: "%SystemDrive%\xampp\StartXAMPP.bat"
   icon_file: "%SystemDrive%\xampp\xampp-control.exe"
end_link

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
   name: "XAMPP Control Panel"
   target: "%SystemDrive%\xampp\StartXAMPP.bat"
   icon_file: "%SystemDrive%\xampp\xampp-control.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "XAMPP Control Panel"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/xournal/install.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Installiere Xournal++...
DefVar $ExitCode$
DefVar $Version$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Xournal++"
Sub_PrepareSetup
Files_Copy
WinBatch_Setup
Sub_HandleExitCode
Registry_Setup /SysNative
Sub_LinkFolder

[Sub_PrepareSetup]
set $Version$ = GetValue("productversion", GetProductMap)
if GetProductProperty("redirectconf", "False") = "True"
  Registry_SetupEnv /SysNative
else
  if RegVarExists("HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Environment", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
    Registry_DeleteEnv /SysNative
  endif
endif

[Registry_SetupEnv]
OpenKey [HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Environment]
Set "XDG_CONFIG_HOME" = REG_SZ:"H:\Xournal++\config"
Set "XDG_CACHE_HOME" = REG_SZ:"H:\Xournal++\cache"

[Registry_DeleteEnv]
OpenKey [HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Environment]
DeleteVar "XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
DeleteVar "XDG_CACHE_HOME"

[Files_Copy]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\*" "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%"

[WinBatch_Setup]
"%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\xournalpp-$Version$-windows-setup-AMD64.exe" /S

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0" or $ExitCode$ = "-1073741819")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Registry_Setup]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\Xournal++]
Set "DisplayName" = REG_SZ:"Xournal++"
Set "DisplayVersion" = REG_SZ:"$Version$"
Set "DisplayIcon" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Xournal++\bin\xournalpp.exe"
Set "Publisher" = REG_SZ:"Xournal"
Set "UninstallString" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Xournal++\Uninstall.exe"
Set "SilentUninstallString" = REG_SZ:'"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Xournal++\Uninstall.exe" /S'

[Sub_LinkFolder]
LinkFolder_StartMenu

if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "True"
  LinkFolder_CreateDesktop
else
  if FileExists("%CommonDesktopDir%\Xournal++.LNK")
    LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
  endif
endif

[LinkFolder_StartMenu]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder "Xournal++"
set_link
  name: "Xournal++"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Xournal++\bin\xournalpp.exe"
end_link
delete_element "Uninstall" 

[LinkFolder_CreateDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "Xournal++"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Xournal++\bin\xournalpp.exe"
end_link

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Xournal++"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

  Set $Arch$ = "x86"
endif

[Files_Copy]

Sub_HandleExitCode
ExecWith_SetupRNDIS "%ScriptDrive%\tools\AutoIt3.exe"
Sub_HandleExitCode

[ExecWith_SetupCH341]
$pid = Run("%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\add\CH341\SETUP.EXE")
While ProcessExists($pid)
  ControlClick("DriverSetup(X64)", "INSTALL", "[CLASS:Button; INSTANCE:2]")
  Sleep(100)
  ControlClick("DriverSetup", "OK", "[CLASS:Button; INSTANCE:1]")
  WinClose("DriverSetup(X64)")
WEnd

[ExecWith_SetupRNDIS]
$pid = Run("%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\add\RNDIS\usb-driver-installer-$Arch$.exe")
While ProcessExists($pid)
  ControlClick("Gerätetreiberinstallations-Assistent", "&Weiter >", "[CLASS:Button; INSTANCE:2]")
  Sleep(100)
  ControlClick("Gerätetreiberinstallations-Assistent", "Fertig stellen", "[CLASS:Button; INSTANCE:7]")
WEnd

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "False"
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "xTool Creative Space"

[LinkFolder_Setup]
set_basefolder common_programs
set_subfolder ""
set_link
  name: "xTool Creative Space"
  target: "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Makeblock\xTool Creative Space\xTool Creative Space.exe"
end_link

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

set ""="%ProgramFiles64Dir%\yWorks\yEd\icons\yicon.ico"
openkey [HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Classes\yEd\shell\open\command]
set ""="%ProgramFiles64Dir%\yWorks\yEd\graphml.bat %1"

################################################################################
PAKET: yworks-yed-graph-editor
DATEI: remove.ins
PFAD : /srv/deploy/install/yworks-yed-graph-editor/remove.ins
################################################################################

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere yWork yEd Graph Editor...

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "yWork yEd Graph Editor"
Files_Remove
ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"
ExecWith_RemoveEmptySystemFolder "cscript" "//E:VBS"
Registry_Cleanup /SysNative
LinkFolder_Delete

[Files_Remove]
delete -sf "%ProgramFilesSysnativeDir%\yWorks\yEd\"

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptyFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = shell.SpecialFolders("AllUsersPrograms") & "\yWorks"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[ExecWith_RemoveEmptySystemFolder]
; deleting empty folders is not that easy in winst!
; https://forum.opsi.org/viewtopic.php?f=7&t=2475
Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
path = "%ProgramFiles64Dir%\yWorks"
If fso.FolderExists(path) Then
  Set d = fso.GetFolder(path)
  If d.Files.Count = 0 And d.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then
    fso.DeleteFolder(path)
  End If
End If

[Registry_Cleanup]
deletekey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\yWorks yEd Graph Editor]

[LinkFolder_Delete]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "yEd Graph Editor"
set_basefolder common_programs
delete_subfolder "yEd Graph Editor"

  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_Registry]
if GetProductProperty("connector", "False") = "True"
  if FileExists("%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\firefox.exe")
    Files_CopyAddon
    Registry_RegisterAddon /64Bit
    Registry_RegisterAddon /32Bit
  endif
else
  if FileExists("%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\browser\extensions\zotero@chnm.gmu.edu.xpi")
    Files_DeleteAddon
    Registry_DeleteAddon /64Bit
    Registry_DeleteAddon /32Bit
  endif
endif

[Files_CopyAddon]
copy -se "%ScriptPath%\data\add\*" "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\browser\extensions\"

[Files_DeleteAddon]
delete "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\browser\extensions\zotero@chnm.gmu.edu.xpi"

[Registry_RegisterAddon]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Mozilla\Firefox\Extensions]
Set "zotero@chnm.gmu.edu.xpi" = REG_SZ:"%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\browser\extensions\zotero@chnm.gmu.edu.xpi"

[Registry_DeleteAddon]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Mozilla\Firefox\Extensions]
DeleteVar "zotero@chnm.gmu.edu.xpi"

[Sub_LinkFolder]
if GetProductProperty("desktop", "False") = "False"
  LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop
endif

[LinkFolder_DeleteDesktop]
set_basefolder common_desktopdirectory
set_subfolder ""
delete_element "Zotero"

[Files_Cleanup]
delete -sf "%opsiTmpDir%\%installingProdName%\"

ENDE: zotero/install.ins

[Initial]
Message=Deinstalliere Zotero...
DefVar $ExitCode$

[Actions]
ShowBitmap "%ScriptPath%\logo.png" "Zotero"
Sub_Uninstall

[Sub_Uninstall]
if FileExists("%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Zotero\uninstall\helper.exe")
  WinBatch_Uninstall
  Sub_HandleExitCode
  Sub_DeleteAddon
endif

[WinBatch_Uninstall]
"%ProgramFiles64Dir%\Zotero\uninstall\helper.exe" /S

[Sub_HandleExitCode]
; check return code
Set $ExitCode$ = GetLastExitCode
comment "GetLastExitCode: " + $ExitCode$
if not($ExitCode$ = "0")
  LogError "Fatal: setup returned exit code " + $ExitCode$
  IsFatalError
endif

[Sub_DeleteAddon]
if FileExists("%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\browser\extensions\zotero@chnm.gmu.edu.xpi")
  Files_DeleteAddon
  Registry_DeleteAddon /64Bit
  Registry_DeleteAddon /32Bit
endif

[Registry_DeleteAddon]
OpenKey [HKLM\SOFTWARE\Mozilla\Firefox\Extensions]
DeleteVar "zotero@chnm.gmu.edu.xpi"

[Files_DeleteAddon]
delete "%ProgramFilesSysNativeDir%\Mozilla Firefox\browser\extensions\zotero@chnm.gmu.edu.xpi"
